title: Human-in-the-Loop NLP Architecture for Verifiable Certified Document Translation

detail.title: Human-in-the-Loop NLP Architecture for Verifiable Certified Document Translation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder/developer of Intento AI Technologies, the case-study platform discussed in this manuscript. No external organization influenced the manuscript’s conclusions. The manuscript is submitted as a system-design preprint and discloses this relationship for transparency.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This manuscript does not report a human-subject experiment, patient study, or controlled participant study. It is a system-design manuscript based on internal architecture review and platform development history. No customer documents, private personal records, or confidential customer data are disclosed.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no external funding. The manuscript is based on the author’s independent development and research work on Intento AI Technologies.

detail.abstract:
Certified translation of official documents is a high-stakes legal workflow that requires more than accurate sentence-level translation. A certified translation must preserve legally meaningful text, maintain the structural layout of the source document, provide human professional accountability through a licensed certifier, and remain verifiable after issuance. Existing neural machine translation systems are effective for general prose but remain insufficient for certified documents because they may alter named entities, dates, numerical values, legal terms, document structure, or formatting, and they cannot provide legal attestation. 
This paper presents a human-in-the-loop NLP architecture for verifiable certified document translation. The architecture decomposes the workflow into document upload, OCR/native extraction, semantic reconstruction, machine translation, layout-aware rendering, licensed certifier review, final PDF generation, certificate registry creation, and QR/certificate-ID-based public verification. Using Intento AI Technologies as a case-study implementation, the paper describes the staged pipeline, typed semantic-block editing model, certifier workspace, certificate registry, verification portal, and engineering pivots made during development. 
The central design lesson is that certified translation should not be treated as a simple machine translation task. Instead, it should be modeled as a controlled document-intelligence workflow where AI prepares a structured candidate translation and the human certifier performs legal review and attestation. Current implementation evidence supports the human-accountability and verification architecture, while empirical evaluation of linguistic fidelity, layout-fidelity, and human post-edit effort remains future work. The paper contributes a practical architecture for human-AI certified translation systems and defines a doctoral research roadmap using certifier edit-distance, Translation Edit Rate, layout-fidelity scoring, and verification integrity testing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种人机协同的NLP架构，用于可验证的认证文件翻译，将认证翻译建模为受控的文档智能工作流，而非简单的机器翻译任务。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个可验证、可问责的人机协同架构，实现法律认证文件的自动翻译与人工核验？
AI.motivation: 现有神经机器翻译系统在认证翻译场景中存在关键信息（实体、日期、数字、法律术语、文档结构）被篡改的风险，且无法提供法律认证与可验证性，亟需一种兼具AI效率与人工问责的架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人机协同（Human-in-the-loop）；受控文档智能工作流（Controlled Document-Intelligence Workflow）；语义块编辑模型（Semantic-block Editing Model）
AI.method: 提出分阶段NLP流水线架构，包括文档上传、OCR/原生提取、语义重建、机器翻译、布局感知渲染、持证译员审核、PDF生成、证书注册、二维码/ID公开验证。以Intento AI Technologies为案例实施。
AI.findings: 认证翻译应建模为受控文档智能工作流，AI生成结构化候选翻译，人类持证译员进行法律审核与认证。当前实施验证了问责与验证架构的可行性，但语言保真度、布局保真度、人工后编辑努力等仍为未来工作。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出认证翻译不应视为简单机器翻译任务，而应建模为人机协同的受控文档智能工作流，为NLP在合规性高敏感场景中的应用提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可实施的人机协同认证翻译系统架构，并规划了博士研究路线图（包括译员编辑距离、翻译编辑率、布局保真度评分、验证完整性测试等评估指标）。

title: Dual-Layer Network Embeddedness and Firm Productivity: The Interplay of Director and Institutional Investor Networks
affiliations: Inner Mongolia Normal University, Inner Mongolia Normal University and Inner Mongolia University of Technology

detail.title: Dual-Layer Network Embeddedness and Firm Productivity: The Interplay of Director and Institutional Investor Networks
detail.abstract: Improving firm total factor productivity (TFP) is crucial for fostering high-quality economic development in China. Firms are not standalone organizations; they are integrated within social networks, and their economic activities are inherently shaped and restricted by other members of the network. The enhancement of TFP is a method whereby enterprises get superior development by intricately integrating with both director and institutional investor networks. This study theoretically analyzes and empirically tests the influence of dual-layer network embeddedness on firm TFP and its underlying mechanisms, utilizing data from A-share listed firms on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets from 2010 to 2022. The findings indicate that: (1) The social networks of Chinese listed firms have been consistently expanding and fortifying; however, in contrast to firms embedded solely in a single-layer network, those linked through both director and institutional investor networks constitute a minority, suggesting a restricted prevalence of dual-layer network benefits. (2) Structural embeddedness in dual-layer networks allows firms to obtain superior information and resource benefits, consequently improving TFP. (3) Dual-layer network embeddedness primarily enhances TFP through two mechanisms: fostering technical innovation and mitigating financing restrictions. (4) The beneficial impact of dual-layer network embeddedness on TFP is markedly more pronounced for non-state-owned firms, non-high-tech firms, and firms situated in areas with less robust external governance frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2010-2022年中国A股上市公司数据，实证检验了董事网络和机构投资者网络构成的双层网络嵌入性对企业全要素生产率（TFP）的影响。研究发现，双层网络嵌入能通过促进技术创新和缓解融资约束来提升企业TFP，且这种效应在非国有企业、非高科技企业以及外部治理环境较弱的地区更为显著。
AI.research_question: 双层网络嵌入性（董事网络与机构投资者网络）如何影响企业全要素生产率（TFP）？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 提升企业全要素生产率对中国经济高质量发展至关重要，而企业嵌入社会网络会影响其经济行为。现有研究多关注单一网络的影响，缺乏对双重网络嵌入如何协同影响企业TFP的深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会网络理论；结构嵌入性理论；资源依赖理论
AI.method: 使用2010-2022年沪深A股上市公司数据，采用实证分析方法（如面板数据回归等）检验双层网络嵌入性（结构嵌入性）与企业TFP的关系及其作用机制。
AI.findings: (1)中国上市公司的社会网络持续扩张，但同时嵌入董事网络和机构投资者网络的企业仍占少数；(2)双层网络的结构嵌入性能使企业获得更优的信息和资源，进而提升TFP；(3)作用机制是促进技术创新和缓解融资约束；(4)这种效应对非国有企业、非高科技企业及外部治理较弱的地区更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了社会网络理论在企业生产率研究中的应用，揭示了双层网络嵌入性（而非单一网络）对企业TFP的协同作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业如何通过构建和利用双层网络（董事网络+机构投资者网络）提升全要素生产率提供实践指导；为政策制定者优化企业外部治理环境提供参考。

title: Forward and inverse joint-optimization-based supervisory control ofheating loads in Demand Response context
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Polytechnique Montreal, Université du Québec à Trois-Rivières, Université du Québec à Trois-Rivières and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Forward and inverse joint-optimization-based supervisory control ofheating loads in Demand Response context
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a user-comfort-aware and joint-optimization-based control algorithm to unlockthe flexibility potential of electric heating loads for demand response by enabling inverse modulationof their power consumption. It leverages the availability of real-time estimation and prediction ofresidual loads (thermal sub-loads), house states (temperatures), and heating demand (power) to enablebetter control of heating loads in response to the electricity price. The real-time predictive controlframework consists of a high-level controller (supervisory controller) that takes input on electricitytariffs and the comfort settings of each room in a house and generates optimal setpoint and/or dutycycleschedules to be applied to the space heaters’ thermostats. The controller embedded a nonlinearthermo-thermostatic model (thermal and thermostat model) of the house to emulate its thermaldynamics. The optimal setpoint schedules and/or duty cycles are generated by solving a nonlinearoptimization problem. Two approaches are proposed. The first approach, termed the forward approach,aims to produce optimal setpoint schedules through simulation-based optimization, using a dedicatedcost function to balance heaters’ operational cost and occupant comfort. The second approach, calledthe inverse approach, aims to recover an optimal power-consumption trajectory by determining theschedule of setpoints and/or duty cycles that allow this reconstruction. For the forward approach, onaverage, up to 32% of power consumption is reduced, and the comfort is improved by 22% comparedto the normal operating condition. An almost perfect tracking of optimal consumption was achievedin the inverse approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于用户舒适度感知和联合优化的控制算法，通过反向调制电加热负荷的功耗来释放其灵活性潜力，用于需求响应。该算法利用实时估计和预测残差负荷、房屋状态和供暖需求，在电价响应中实现更好的控制。提出了正向方法（通过仿真优化生成最优设定点计划）和逆向方法（通过恢复最优功耗轨迹）两种方案。正向方法平均减少32%的功耗并提升22%的舒适度；逆向方法实现了近乎完美的最优功耗跟踪。
AI.research_question: 如何通过用户舒适度感知的联合优化控制算法，实现对电加热负荷功耗的逆向调制，从而释放其在需求响应中的灵活性潜力？
AI.motivation: 电加热负荷具有灵活性潜力可用于需求响应，但现有控制方法未能充分利用实时估计和预测数据（如残差负荷、房屋温度、供暖需求）来优化功耗调制，同时兼顾用户舒适度和运行成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非线性热力-恒温模型（热力学和恒温器模型）、仿真优化方法、正向/逆向控制方法、实时预测控制框架（高层监督控制器）。
AI.method: 提出实时预测控制框架，包含高层监督控制器和嵌入非线性热力-恒温模型。采用两种方法：1）正向方法：通过仿真优化生成最优设定点时间表，平衡运行成本与用户舒适度；2）逆向方法：通过恢复最优功耗轨迹，反推设定点和/或占空比时间表。
AI.findings: 正向方法平均减少32%的功耗，同时提升22%的舒适度；逆向方法实现了对最优功耗轨迹的近乎完美跟踪。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了将用户舒适度感知与联合优化结合的电加热负荷控制框架；2）扩展了正向与逆向两种优化方法在热负荷控制中的应用；3）建立了非线性热力-恒温模型以精确模拟房屋热动力学。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为电力需求响应提供了高效的负荷灵活性释放方案；2）在降低能耗的同时显著提升用户舒适度；3）为智能家居和建筑能源管理系统提供了可实施的控制算法。

title: Secure Explainable Audit Trails for Workflows in Agentic AI
affiliations: University of Galway

detail.title: Secure Explainable Audit Trails for Workflows in Agentic AI
detail.abstract: An Explainable Audit Trail (EAT) records process execution traces of an agentic workflow. EAT can enable an organisation to efficiently remain compliant with regulations by presenting its audit results to it. However, current state of the art in EAT lacks privacy protection of agent's models which can be intellectual properties of the organisation. Exposing audit trails to external entities may facilitate orchestration of attacks on the agent's model. Auditing a complex workflow will require verification of dependencies among tasks as preconditions to execute a task. Further, it is necessary for the audit algorithm to ensure that a process execution trace follows the pre-planned process execution model for security reasons, i.e., audit should include functionality that can check if the agents have deviated from its planned process execution models. In this paper, we build a secure EAT that can address these gaps in the state of the art in EAT for agentic workflows. Our main contribution is the application of zero-knowledge-proof on verifying audit procedures. It proves the audit has validated correctness of chain-of-thoughts, the execution trace at the runtime matches the planned process execution , and  complete traceability among logs of a complex workflow involving dependencies among the tasks in terms of preconditions. Our solution provides a trust-less infrastructure to verify the audit results to external entities while not exposing the audit trails. We used lattice-based zero knowledge proof for this procedure. We provide an analysis on the EAT procedure. We show experimental evaluation of the EAT with workflow dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可解释审计追踪（EAT），通过格基零知识证明技术，在保护智能体模型知识产权（不暴露审计轨迹）的前提下，验证工作流执行轨迹的正确性、与预设流程的一致性以及任务间的依赖关系，实现了对代理工作流的安全、可信审计。
AI.research_question: 如何在不暴露智能体模型（知识产权）的前提下，实现对代理工作流执行过程的可解释、安全审计，包括验证链式思维的正确性、执行轨迹与计划流程的一致性，以及复杂工作流中任务依赖关系的完整可追溯性？
AI.motivation: 现有可解释审计追踪（EAT）缺乏对智能体模型的隐私保护，暴露审计轨迹可能引发模型攻击；此外，复杂工作流的审计需要验证任务间的依赖关系（前置条件），并确保执行轨迹遵循预定义的流程模型，现有方法未能同时解决这些安全问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 零知识证明（Zero-Knowledge Proof），格基密码学（Lattice-based Cryptography），工作流审计理论，可解释审计追踪。
AI.method: 提出基于格基零知识证明的安全EAT架构；设计审计算法验证链式思维正确性、运行时轨迹与计划流程匹配性、任务间依赖关系（前置条件）的完整追溯；构建去信任化基础设施，使外部实体可验证审计结果但不暴露原始审计轨迹；使用工作流数据集进行实验评估。
AI.findings: 所提出的安全EAT能够在保护智能体模型隐私的前提下，有效验证代理工作流的执行合规性；零知识证明机制成功实现了对链式思维正确性、流程一致性和任务依赖关系可追溯性的证明；实验结果表明该方案在实际工作流数据集中具有可行性和有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将零知识证明（尤其是格基零知识证明）应用于代理工作流审计场景，在理论上证明了在不暴露审计轨迹的前提下验证审计结果的可能性；为工作流审计中的隐私保护与可验证性之间的权衡提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 构建了一个去信任化的安全审计基础设施，使企业能够在保护智能体模型知识产权的同时满足监管合规要求；提供了对复杂工作流中任务依赖关系和流程偏差的自动化检测能力，降低了合规审计成本和安全风险。

title: A Network-constrained Continuous Trading Framework for Intraday Market Considering the Rolling Adjustment of Deviation Quantities
affiliations: Zhejiang University, Hangzhou City University, Zhejiang University, Zhejiang University, Zhejiang University and Zhejiang University

detail.title: A Network-constrained Continuous Trading Framework for Intraday Market Considering the Rolling Adjustment of Deviation Quantities
detail.abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy and the growth in load demand, forecast errors on both the generation and demand sides become more significant. Intraday market is used to adjust power deviations between day-ahead market and real-time market. However, existing intraday market is mainly financial and cannot ensure physical delivery in congested networks. To address the above issues, this paper proposes a continuous intraday market framework that considers network constraints and rolling adjustment of deviation quantities. In the proposed framework, market participants submit orders of deviation quantities based on the updated forecast to the shared order book (SOB), where two order types are adopted: immediate orders and partial orders. On this basis, a network-constrained clearing and matching model is then established to clear the orders in SOB for each trading period. This trading process is conducted in a rolling approach to adjust the deviation quantities of market participants, which can effectively reduce the system imbalance in the real-time market. Case studies based on the IEEE 118-bus system and a provincial network in southeast China demonstrate that the proposed intraday market can significantly reduce imbalance quantity and stabilize the profit of participants. Moreover, the intraday market mitigates the settlement risk while ensuring that the system merchandising surplus (SMS) remains zero.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种考虑网络约束和滚动调整的连续日内交易市场框架，通过订单簿清算和匹配模型，有效降低实时市场的不平衡量并稳定参与者收益。
AI.research_question: 如何在考虑网络约束的前提下设计连续日内交易市场框架，以有效调整发电侧和需求侧的预测偏差，降低系统实时不平衡量？
AI.motivation: 可再生能源渗透率提高和负荷增长导致发电侧与需求侧的预测误差加大；现有日内市场主要是金融性的，无法保证拥堵网络中的物理交付。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续交易机制、网络约束出清、滚动调整机制、订单簿匹配模型
AI.method: 提出考虑网络约束的连续日内市场框架，设计即时订单和部分订单两种订单类型，建立网络约束下的清算与匹配模型，采用滚动调整方式逐时段处理偏差，并在IEEE 118节点系统和中国东南某省级网络进行案例验证。
AI.findings: 1）所提日内市场能显著降低系统不平衡量；2）稳定市场参与者的收益；3）降低结算风险；4）保证系统商品盈余（SMS）为零。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将网络约束引入连续日内市场的订单簿清算与匹配机制，提出了滚动调整偏差量的理论框架，拓展了电力市场设计理论中关于日内市场物理交付保障的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电力市场运营商提供了可操作的连续日内市场设计方案，有助于高比例可再生能源接入场景下的系统平衡与风险管理，对中国的电力市场改革具有参考价值。

title: Optimal Planning of Heterogeneous Energy Storage in Renewable-rich Distribution System Against Multi-Timescale Power Imbalances Risks
affiliations: Hohai University, Hohai University, Southeast University - School of Electrical Engineering, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Hohai University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Hohai University

detail.title: Optimal Planning of Heterogeneous Energy Storage in Renewable-rich Distribution System Against Multi-Timescale Power Imbalances Risks
detail.abstract: High renewable penetration significantly amplifies multi-timescale power imbalance risks in distribution systems due to intraday fluctuations, seasonal mismatches, and consecutive low-output extreme events. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a multi-timescale imbalance risk-aware planning method, which jointly optimizes long-term seasonal storage, short-term storage and distributed renewable units to improve the system’s long-term balance performance. A reconstructed multi-timescale scenario reduction method is proposed, which aggregates typical-day scenarios capturing intraday source-load fluctuations, multi-day extreme scenarios representing prolonged low-renewable-output conditions, and long-term monthly scenarios reflecting seasonal variations. These scenarios are utilized to quantify short-term power imbalance, emergency supply shortage, and CVaR-based long-term imbalance energy deviation within a unified planning framework. A computation-efficient hybrid long- and short-term storage modeling technique is introduced to coordinate intraday power regulation, multi-day emergency support, and seasonal energy shifting, thereby exploiting the complementary scheduling flexibility of daily and seasonal storage to mitigate power imbalance risks across multiple timescales while accurately capturing their chronological SoC trajectories. In addition, an enhanced pairwise reformulation is developed to eliminate redundant binary variables and decrease the dimensionality of the planning model, which can improve computational efficiency without sacrificing solution accuracy. Simulation results validate the effectiveness the proposed planning method in reducing multi-timescale power imbalance risks, and enhancing the resilience of emergency power supply in renewable-rich distribution systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多时间尺度不平衡风险感知的规划方法，通过联合优化长期季节性储能、短期储能和分布式可再生能源，并采用重构的多时间尺度场景缩减方法和高效的混合储建模技术，降低高可再生能源渗透率配电系统中的多时间尺度功率不平衡风险。
AI.research_question: 如何在高可再生能源渗透率配电系统中，有效降低由日内波动、季节性错配和连续低出力极端事件引起的多时间尺度功率不平衡风险？
AI.motivation: 高可再生能源渗透率放大了配电系统中多时间尺度（日内、季节、极端事件）的功率不平衡风险，现有规划方法难以同时协调不同时间尺度的储能配置。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多时间尺度场景缩减方法、CVaR（条件风险价值）长期不平衡能量偏差量化、混合长短期储能建模、增强型成对重构规划模型。
AI.method: 提出重构的多时间尺度场景缩减方法（聚合典型日、多日极端场景和长期月度场景）；提出计算高效的混合长短期储能建模技术；开发增强型成对重构方法消除冗余二进制变量以降低模型维度。
AI.findings: 所提方法能有效降低多时间尺度功率不平衡风险，增强可再生富集配电系统中应急供电的韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出多时间尺度场景缩减与统一规划框架，将日内、极端事件和季节性场景纳入同一优化体系；提出混合储建模技术协调不同时间尺度的调度灵活性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高可再生能源渗透率的配电系统提供了一种计算高效、可实际部署的规划方法，能够同时降低短期功率不平衡、应急供应短缺和长期能量偏差风险。

title: Co-Optimizing the Design and Operation of an Integrated Pumped Hydro Reverse Osmosis System via a GA-MILP Framework: A Case Study for Andalusia, Spain
affiliations: Cornell University and

detail.title: Co-Optimizing the Design and Operation of an Integrated Pumped Hydro Reverse Osmosis System via a GA-MILP Framework: A Case Study for Andalusia, Spain

keywords: Integrated Pumped Hydro Reverse Osmosis System

detail.abstract: Integrated Pumped Hydro Reverse Osmosis Systems (IPHROS) co-locate seawater pumped storage hydropower (PSH) with reverse osmosis (RO) desalination behind a shared upper reservoir, simultaneously providing grid-scale energy storage and commercial-scale freshwater production. Prior work established the general multidisciplinary design optimization of IPHROS, but not how to design and operate the system for a specific location, where topography, environmental constraints, freshwater need, and the electricity grid all matter. This paper presents such a location-specific framework and demonstrates it for Andalusia, Spain. A site-selection methodology, combining a new A+ siting metric with QGIS-based natural-depression detection, identifies an upper reservoir in the Baetic Mountains along the Mediterranean coast. The design and operation of IPHROS are then co-optimized using a mixed-integer linear program nested within a genetic algorithm (GA-MILP), supported by new reverse osmosis, pretreatment, and turbocharger models, explicit treatment of GA MILP run time, and a Fourier-parameterized ocean-discharge salinity policy that respects Posidonia oceanica regulations. Maximizing net present value (NPV) under price-taker and representative week assumptions, the optimal IPHROS converges to an NPV of €1.09 billion (2023) over 30 years, a 28.4% improvement over a stand-alone PSH system, and reveals an emergent modified hydraulic short circuit (HSC) operating scheme essential to reaching this value.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对特定地点的集成抽水蓄能-反渗透海水淡化系统（IPHROS）设计与运行优化框架，并以西班牙安达卢西亚为例进行验证。通过遗传算法-混合整数线性规划（GA-MILP）联合优化，该系统在30年内的净现值（NPV）达10.9亿欧元，比单独抽水蓄能系统提升28.4%，并发现了一种改进的水力短路运行模式（HSC）是实现这一价值的关键。
AI.research_question: 如何在特定地理位置（考虑地形、环境约束、淡水需求和电网条件）设计并优化运行集成抽水蓄能与反渗透海水淡化系统（IPHROS）？
AI.motivation: 已有研究建立了IPHROS的一般性多学科设计优化方法，但尚未解决如何针对具体地点进行系统设计与运行优化，而实际部署中地形、环境法规、淡水需求及电网条件等因素至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多学科设计优化理论、遗传算法（GA）、混合整数线性规划（MILP）、净现值（NPV）分析、傅里叶参数化海洋排放盐度策略。
AI.method: 提出A+选址指标并结合QGIS自然洼地检测方法确定上水库位置；采用遗传算法嵌套混合整数线性规划（GA-MILP）对系统设计与运行进行联合优化；引入新的反渗透、预处理和涡轮增压器模型，以及明确的GA-MILP运行时间处理和傅里叶参数化海洋排放盐度策略。
AI.findings: 最佳IPHROS在30年内NPV达10.9亿欧元（2023年），比单独抽水蓄能系统提升28.4%；发现一种改进的水力短路（HSC）运行模式是该价值提升的关键。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个可迁移的特定地点IPHROS设计优化框架，将选址、设计与运行联合优化，并揭示了HSC运行模式的经济价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为IPHROS的实际部署提供了可操作的方法论，包括选址指标、优化算法框架和运行策略，有助于在气候干旱、淡水短缺且依赖可再生能源的地区推广该技术。

title: Meeting Temporal Renewable Energy Procurement Targets with Battery Storage: A Constrained MDP Approach
affiliations: , University of Twente and University of Twente

detail.title: Meeting Temporal Renewable Energy Procurement Targets with Battery Storage: A Constrained MDP Approach
detail.abstract: Renewable energy procurement targets are increasingly defined through matching requirements, which specify how electricity consumption must be matched with renewable supply over time. We study three requirements: (i) annual matching, which requires renewables to cover a target share of demand in aggregate; (ii) hourly energy matching, which imposes a renewable-share requirement in every period; and (iii) clean hours matching, which requires full renewable coverage in a target fraction of periods. We examine how these requirements affect cost, certificate use, and storage operation for a corporate consumer with a take-or-pay renewable PPA, grid access, energy attribute certificates, and battery storage under uncertain demand, renewable generation, and electricity market prices. We formulate the problem as an infinite-horizon constrained Markov decision process and solve the models exactly using an occupation-measure linear program. In a controlled fixed-market-price setting, we show that the requirements protect different dimensions of renewable performance: aggregate renewable share, worst-period renewable coverage, and the frequency of fully renewable operation do not improve together. Tighter targets also need not imply higher physical renewable use, as certificate reliance increases when storage and renewable availability are limited. In a varying-price setting, renewable deficit and state of charge define the main structure of storage decisions, while electricity price variation changes the timing and composition of storage use. These results support the design of renewable procurement targets whose reported performance better reflects the physical and operational pathways through which clean energy is supplied.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了三种可再生能源匹配要求（年度匹配、逐时能量匹配、清洁小时匹配）对成本、证书使用和储能运行的影响，发现不同要求保护了可再生能源绩效的不同维度，更严格的目标不一定带来更高的实际可再生能源使用量。
AI.research_question: 不同的可再生能源匹配要求（年度匹配、逐时能量匹配、清洁小时匹配）如何影响企业消费者的成本、证书使用和储能运行？
AI.motivation: 可再生能源采购目标越来越多地通过匹配要求来定义，但不同匹配要求对实际可再生能源使用、成本和储能策略的影响尚不明确，需要系统分析以支持更优的采购目标设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无限时域约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），占用测度线性规划
AI.method: 构建无限时域约束马尔可夫决策过程模型，采用占用测度线性规划精确求解。在固定市场价格和变化市场价格两种情景下分别分析三种匹配要求的影响。
AI.findings: （1）不同匹配要求保护了可再生能源绩效的不同维度，但总体可再生能源份额、最差时段可再生能源覆盖率和全可再生能源运行频率无法同时改善；（2）更严格的目标不一定带来更高的实际可再生能源使用量，当储能和可再生能源可用性有限时，证书依赖度会增加；（3）在价格变动情景下，可再生能源赤字和电荷状态决定了储能决策的主要结构，电价变化则改变了储能使用的时间和构成。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统比较了三种不同的可再生能源匹配要求对储能运行和证书使用的影响，揭示了匹配要求设计中的绩效维度权衡关系，为可再生能源采购目标的理论设计提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计可再生能源采购目标提供了实践指导，指出应选择能更好反映清洁能源实际物理和运营路径的匹配要求，避免更严格目标导致证书依赖增加而实际可再生能源使用未提升的问题。

title: Educated to Exploit? CEO Educational Backgrounds in Accounting and Finance and Workplace Misconduct
affiliations: University of Surrey, Loughborough University - Loughborough Business School, University of Sheffield and Bangor University

detail.title: Educated to Exploit? CEO Educational Backgrounds in Accounting and Finance and Workplace Misconduct
detail.abstract: This study examines the influence of CEO educational background on firm-level workplace misconduct. Using data on employment-related penalties imposed by regulatory authorities, we show that firms led by CEOs with backgrounds in accounting and/or finance exhibit a significantly higher incidence and severity of workplace misconduct. We conceptualize accounting and/or finance training as a form of managerial analytical capability that enhances the precision of cost–benefit calculations. In this framework, misconduct arises when the expected marginal benefits of cost reduction exceed the expected regulatory penalties. Consistent with this interpretation, we find that the effect is driven by reductions in discretionary employee-related R&D expenditure, a stronger emphasis on cost efficiency, and greater exposure to equity-based risk-taking incentives. Moreover, the effect is more pronounced for lower-severity violations and is attenuated for female CEOs and those with legal training. Finally, we find no evidence that workplace misconduct affects CEO turnover or compensation, suggesting limited personal accountability for such misconduct.

AI.tldr: 拥有会计/金融背景的CEO所在企业，其职场不当行为（如违反劳动法规）的发生率和严重程度显著更高。这是因为会计/金融训练增强了CEO的成本收益分析能力，使其在边际效益高于预期处罚时更倾向于采取不当行为。
AI.research_question: CEO的教育背景（尤其是会计/金融背景）如何影响企业层面的职场不当行为？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注CEO背景对企业财务决策的影响，但对其如何影响员工相关行为（如职场合规）关注不足。会计/金融训练可能强化CEO的成本效益思维，从而增加其在权衡中偏向成本削减而忽视员工权益的风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 会计/金融训练→管理分析能力→强化成本收益计算→当成本削减的边际收益>预期监管处罚的边际成本时，产生职场不当行为。
AI.method: 使用监管机构对雇佣相关处罚的数据，进行实证回归分析。检验了中介机制（ discretionary R&D支出、成本效率、股权激励）和调节效应（CEO性别、法律背景、违规严重程度）。
AI.findings: 1. 会计/金融背景CEO显著增加职场不当行为的发生率和严重性；2. 机制是削减员工相关研发支出、强调成本效率、以及股权风险激励；3. 低严重性违规更明显；4. 女性CEO和法律背景CEO有缓冲作用；5. 职场不当行为不影响CEO的离职或薪酬。
AI.theory_contributions: 将CEO教育背景与职场行为联系起来，拓展了高管特征对企业社会表现影响的理论，揭示了会计/金融训练可能带来的非预期负面后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提示企业在选拔CEO时需考虑其教育背景带来的潜在行为偏差；2. 为监管机构加强CEO个人问责提供依据；3. 建议完善公司治理机制（如加强法律合规、女性领导力）以制衡过度成本导向的管理风格。

title: Coal Phase-Out Roadmaps for South Korea: An Integrated Capacity Expansion Planning Approach with Endogenous Fuel Switching
affiliations: NEXT Group, NEXT Group and Chungnam National University

detail.title: Coal Phase-Out Roadmaps for South Korea: An Integrated Capacity Expansion Planning Approach with Endogenous Fuel Switching
detail.abstract: Phasing out coal-fired generation is central to power-sector decarbonization, yet many coal-dependent systems still lack a concrete, fleet-wide schedule specifying when each unit should retire or convert. This study develops an integrated capacity expansion model that endogenously represents fuel switching and early retirement of existing coal units, including the associated decommissioning cost. Long-term capacity planning is coupled with short-term mixed-integer unit-commitment operation through an iterative planning–operation algorithm. Because the fuel-transition options are defined separately from the country-specific input data, the formulation is transferable to other coal-dependent power systems. Applied to a 12-node representation of the South Korean power system from 2025 to 2050, the model phases out coal by 2040 across all three renewable scenarios examined, and as early as 2035 under accelerated renewable expansion with revisable conversion schedules, while renewables remain the main source of emission reductions. For fuel switching, the model selects LNG conversion as the main pathway and adds no coal–ammonia co-firing beyond a small pre-scheduled conversion. A roadmap that meets the annual emission targets in long-term planning can still violate a later target once short-term operation is represented; the iterative algorithm restores compliance through operational screening.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个综合容量扩展模型，内生化燃料转换和燃煤机组提前退役决策，并耦合长期规划与短期机组组合运行。应用于韩国电力系统（2025-2050年），模型显示在三种可再生能源情景下均能在2040年前淘汰煤电，燃料转换以LNG为主要路径，且长期规划满足排放目标不代表短期运行也能达标，需通过迭代算法确保合规。
AI.research_question: 如何为依赖煤电的电力系统制定具体的、覆盖全机队的煤电机组退役或转换时间表？
AI.motivation: 许多依赖煤电的系统缺乏具体的全系统机组退役/转换时间表，且现有模型未能同时内生表示燃料转换、提前退役及退役成本，也缺乏对长期规划与短期运行约束的耦合分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合容量扩展模型、混合整数机组组合模型、迭代规划-运行算法
AI.method: 开发了内生化燃料转换与提前退役（含退役成本）的容量扩展模型，并通过迭代规划-运行算法将长期容量规划与短期混合整数机组组合运行相耦合。模型设定与国别数据解耦，具有可转移性。
AI.findings: 1) 在三种可再生能源情景下，韩国煤电均能在2040年前淘汰，加速可再生能源扩张且可修订转换计划时可提前至2035年。2) 可再生能源是减排主力。3) 燃料转换以LNG为主，煤氨混烧仅在小规模预调度转换中出现。4) 长期规划满足排放目标可能因未考虑短期运行约束而违规，迭代算法可通过运行筛查恢复合规。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了将长期容量规划与短期机组组合运行相耦合的迭代算法，揭示了长期排放目标在短期运行约束下可能被违反的机制，并提出了修正方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国等依赖煤电的系统提供了具体的煤电淘汰时间表和可行路径（LNG转换为主），支持政策制定者制定兼顾长期规划与短期运行可行性的退煤路线图。

title: Production Network Position and Inventory Management Efficiency
affiliations: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE), Renmin University of China, Renmin University of China and Durham University Business School, Finance and Economics

detail.title: Production Network Position and Inventory Management Efficiency
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether a firm’s sectoral position in the production network affects its inventory management efficiency. Using China’s input–output tables, we construct an inter-sector network and measure sector centrality using closeness centrality. We find that firms operating in more central sectors exhibit significantly higher inventory turnover, with a stronger effect among non-state-owned and more diversified firms, as well as under higher demand uncertainty, greater supply chain disruption risks, and more intense market competition. Our findings identify production network centrality as an important determinant of inventory efficiency and highlight the role of information embedded in production networks in shaping firms’ operational outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国投入产出表构建产业间生产网络，发现处于网络中心度更高的行业中的企业，其存货周转率显著更高，且该效应在非国有企业、多元化企业、高需求不确定性、高供应链中断风险及激烈市场竞争环境下更为明显。
AI.research_question: 企业在生产网络中的部门位置（中心度）是否以及如何影响其存货管理效率？
AI.motivation: 已有研究多关注企业内部因素对存货管理的影响，较少从生产网络这一外部结构视角探讨企业存货效率的决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产网络理论、信息嵌入理论、供应链管理理论
AI.method: 利用中国投入产出表构建产业间网络，以紧密中心度衡量行业中心度，采用回归分析检验中心度与存货周转率的关系，并进行异质性分析。
AI.findings: 处于更中心行业的企业存货周转率更高；该效应在非国有企业、多元化企业、需求不确定性高、供应链中断风险高及市场竞争激烈的条件下更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了生产网络中心度是存货效率的重要决定因素，拓展了生产网络理论在运营管理领域的应用，强调了网络中嵌入的信息对企业运营结果的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业优化存货管理策略提供了新视角——关注自身在生产网络中的位置；为供应链风险管理和政策制定提供了网络层面的参考依据。

title: A techno-economic analysis of the integration of edge data centres into urban energy systems
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Birmingham and Swiss Federal Laboratories for Material Science and Technology (EMPA)

detail.title: A techno-economic analysis of the integration of edge data centres into urban energy systems
detail.abstract: The rapid growth of digital services and artificial intelligence is driving increased deployment of edge data centres within urban environments, creating new opportunities to integrate their electricity demand and recoverable waste heat within local building energy systems. This study presents a techno-economic analysis of integrating edge data centres into tertiary buildings with a less varied heat and electricity demand, with a focus on the additive impacts of waste heat recovery, renewable energy coupling, district heating network integration, and demand-side flexibility. A mixed integer linear programming optimisation model is used to identify the optimal sizing, layout, and operation of the system, at an hourly resolution over a yearly horizon, given a defined set of boundary conditions and technology parameters. This model is applied across multiple scenarios to evaluate system design and operation. Results show that integrating a small 20 kW edge data centre as an active energy system component consistently reduces total annualised cost in all scenarios considered, with waste heat recovery alone yielding a 9.6\% decrease, reduces reliance on conventional heating technologies and enables system downsizing. The addition of photovoltaic generation and battery energy systems further decreases grid dependence, although its impact is limited by seasonal variability. Coupling with a district heating network enhances economic performance by providing external flexibility, and omits the need for thermal energy storage at medium and high temperature levels. Across all scenarios, high levels of heat recovery utilisation is maintained, covering around 40\% of the total demand. The findings demonstrate that edge data centres can function not only as energy consumers but also as providers of heat and flexibility, enabling sector coupling between electricity and heat. The study demonstrates that co-optimising the sizing and operation of a building-integrated edge data centre with the host building's energy system can unlock economic and operational benefits that would not be captured by sizing or evaluating the data centre in isolation, particularly through waste heat recovery and demand-side flexibility. These findings underscore the importance of integrated system design in urban energy systems incorporating small-scale edge data centres.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了将小型边缘数据中心（20kW）集成到商业建筑能源系统中的技术经济性，发现通过余热回收、光伏发电、电池储能和区域供热网络耦合，可降低总年化成本9.6%，减少对传统供热依赖，并实现电热部门耦合。
AI.research_question: 将边缘数据中心集成到商业建筑能源系统中，通过余热回收、可再生能源耦合、区域供热网络集成和需求侧灵活性，如何在技术和经济上实现最优的系统设计和运营？
AI.motivation: 数字服务和人工智能的快速增长促使边缘数据中心在城市环境中加速部署，这为将其电力需求和可回收余热整合到本地建筑能源系统创造了新机遇。现有研究多聚焦大型数据中心或单独评估边缘数据中心，缺乏对建筑集成式边缘数据中心能源系统的协同优化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合整数线性规划（MILP）优化模型；技术经济分析框架；部门耦合（电-热）理论；分布式能源系统集成理论。
AI.method: 构建混合整数线性规划（MILP）优化模型，以小时为分辨率、年度为时间跨度，对系统容量配置、布局和运营进行协同优化。通过多场景对比分析（涵盖余热回收、光伏+电池、区域供热网络耦合等组合），评估不同技术方案的经济和能源绩效。
AI.findings: （1）集成20kW边缘数据中心在所有场景下均降低总年化成本，仅余热回收即可降低9.6%；（2）光伏+电池可降低电网依赖，但受季节性限制；（3）区域供热网络耦合可提升经济性，并消除中高温热储能需求；（4）余热回收可满足约40%的总热需求；（5）边缘数据中心不仅是能源消费者，还可作为热量和灵活性的提供者，实现电热部门耦合。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了边缘数据中心与建筑能源系统的协同优化（而非孤立设计）能够解锁单独评估无法实现的经济和运营效益；为部门耦合理论在边缘数据中心场景下提供了实证支持；扩展了建筑集成式数据中心能源系统优化的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者和建筑能源管理者提供了边缘数据中心集成设计的量化依据（如9.6%成本节约、40%热需求覆盖）；指导了余热回收、光伏储能和区域供热网络耦合的最优配置策略；强调了在城市能源系统中将小型边缘数据中心视为主动能源组件的设计理念。

title: Intergenerational Leadership and Strategic Transformation: Evidence from Emerging Economy Family Businesses
affiliations: Wuhan University

detail.title: Intergenerational Leadership and Strategic Transformation: Evidence from Emerging Economy Family Businesses
detail.abstract: Family firms are crucial to the economy of developing countries but are faced with unique problems with their leadership and their evolution. This paper examines how second-generation leadership can develop new strategies, how the quality of institutions and family socioemotional wealth (SEW) can affect this, and how intergenerational leadership can facilitate strategic change. This research employs a quantitative approach and a multi-country dataset, covering 1,245 publicly listed family firms in the major developing countries across (China, India, and Brazil, and Southeast Asia) during the 2015-2024 period. This research employs fixed-effects regression models complemented by Heckman's two-step procedure and propensity score matching to control for the endogeneity problem. The results indicate intergenerational leadership will accelerate strategic changes, especially in digital and global outreach. The conclusion asserts second-generation leaders, who are often more educated and trained abroad, have been the catalysts for readying family firms for the modern era. This research primarily focuses on upper echelons and institutional theory, and provides family-run businesses and policymaker’s insights in how to modernize family-led firms to assist transitions of the economy.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于1245家来自中国、印度、巴西及东南亚的上市家族企业数据（2015-2024），发现第二代领导层显著加速了家族企业的战略变革（尤其数字化与全球化），制度质量与家族社会情感财富（SEW）对这一过程起调节作用。
AI.research_question: 第二代家族企业领导层如何制定新战略？制度质量与家族社会情感财富（SEW）如何影响这一过程？代际领导如何促进战略变革？
AI.motivation: 家族企业对发展中国家经济至关重要，但其在领导层更迭与演化中面临独特问题。现有研究对第二代领导如何推动战略变革、以及制度环境与家族情感财富在其中扮演的角色缺乏充分实证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高层梯队理论（Upper Echelons Theory）与制度理论（Institutional Theory），并结合家族社会情感财富（SEW）视角。
AI.method: 定量研究方法，基于2015-2024年1245家上市家族企业的多国面板数据，采用固定效应回归模型，辅以Heckman两步法与倾向得分匹配（PSM）控制内生性问题。
AI.findings: 代际领导（尤其是第二代）显著加速了战略变革，特别是在数字化与全球拓展方面。第二代领导者通常受教育程度更高且有海外经历，是推动家族企业现代化的关键催化剂。
AI.theory_contributions: 将高层梯队理论与制度理论整合应用于家族企业代际传承情境，揭示了第二代领导者特征（教育背景、海外经历）与制度环境如何共同影响战略变革，丰富了家族企业治理与战略变革的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为家族企业管理者提供代际传承中如何利用第二代领导优势实现现代化转型的实操建议；为政策制定者提供如何通过改善制度环境支持家族企业战略升级的启示。

title: Predictive Data-Driven Inverse Design for Tailored Processing of Carbon/Epoxy Unidirectional Prepreg
affiliations: Government of Islamic Republic of Iran - Iran Polymer and Petrochemical Institute, Government of Islamic Republic of Iran - Iran Polymer and Petrochemical Institute and Government of Islamic Republic of Iran - Iran Polymer and Petrochemical Institute

detail.title: Predictive Data-Driven Inverse Design for Tailored Processing of Carbon/Epoxy Unidirectional Prepreg
detail.abstract: The high-demand commercial unidirectional carbon/epoxy composite prepregs are only customized for general applications. The influence of complex prepregging process parameters is still poorly understood. Prior studies largely neglect a systematic and quantitative linkage between process parameters and the resulting geometrical, mechanical, and constituent properties of prepregs. This study contributes by proposing an efficient data-driven framework to optimize critical prepregging parameters for personalized prepregs. A Taguchi design combined with signal-to-noise ratio analysis and analysis of variance was employed to evaluate the effects of doctor blade gap, fiber tension, and line speed. The results show that the doctor blade gap predominantly governs thickness, fiber volume content, lead-in strain, and stiffness. Fiber tension mainly affects width, fiber areal mass, and modulus ratio. Pre-cure degree and volatile content were insensitive. Microscopic examinations have verified the proper quality of manufactured prepregs by observing the uniform distribution of fibers with minimal defects. Inverse mixed-effects linear models identified optimal settings of a 0.07 mm gap, 14.5 N fiber tension, and 116 cm/min line speed, providing predictive guidelines for robust, tailored prepreg manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数据驱动框架，通过田口设计等方法系统优化碳/环氧预浸料的关键工艺参数（刮刀间隙、纤维张力、线速度），实现了个性化预浸料的定制化制造。
AI.research_question: 如何系统且定量地建立预浸料工艺参数与最终几何、力学及组成性能之间的关联，并实现关键参数的优化？
AI.motivation: 高需求的商业单向碳/环氧预浸料仅为通用应用定制，复杂工艺参数的影响尚不明确，现有研究缺乏系统且定量的工艺-性能关联分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 田口设计方法、信噪比分析、方差分析、混合效应线性模型。
AI.method: 采用田口设计结合信噪比分析和方差分析，评估刮刀间隙、纤维张力和线速度对预浸料性能的影响，并通过逆向混合效应线性模型识别最优工艺参数组合。
AI.findings: 刮刀间隙主要决定厚度、纤维体积含量、导入应变和刚度；纤维张力主要影响宽度、纤维面密度和模量比；预固化度和挥发物含量对工艺参数不敏感；最优参数为0.07 mm间隙、14.5 N纤维张力、116 cm/min线速度。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了一个系统、定量的数据驱动框架，填补了预浸料工艺参数与性能之间关联的研究空白，为个性化预浸料制造提供了预测性指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了明确的最优工艺参数组合，有助于实现稳健、定制化的预浸料生产，提升产品质量与一致性。

title: Graph Neural Network-Based Smoothing Method for 3D Hexahedral Meshes
affiliations: Yantai University, Yantai University, Yantai University, Yantai University, Yantai University and Yantai University

detail.title: Graph Neural Network-Based Smoothing Method for 3D Hexahedral Meshes
detail.abstract: Mesh quality has a critical impact on the accuracy, convergence, and computational efficiency of numerical simulations. This paper addresses the smoothing problem of three-dimensional hexahedral structured meshes and proposes a mesh smoothing method based on Graph Neural Networks, abbreviated as GNN smoothing. The method formulates mesh smoothing as a regression problem of nodal displacement prediction: it takes interior free nodes and their local subgraphs as input, uses displacements derived from Jacobian-based optimization as supervised labels, and trains a GNN model to directly predict the optimal nodal movements. Employing the Jacobian ratio as the mesh quality metric, numerical experiments are conducted on four representative three-dimensional hexahedral mesh models: a flange, a R-type part, a shaft, and a wrench. The results demonstrate that the proposed GNN smoothing method can effectively improve the initial mesh quality, achieving mesh quality comparable to that of traditional optimization-based methods while offering significantly faster computational speed, which validates the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图神经网络的六面体结构化网格平滑方法（GNN平滑），将网格平滑问题转化为节点位移回归预测任务，利用雅可比优化生成监督标签，在四个三维网格模型上验证了该方法在保持网格质量的同时大幅提升计算速度的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用图神经网络高效地对三维六面体结构化网格进行平滑处理，以在保证网格质量的同时提升计算效率？
AI.motivation: 网格质量对数值模拟的精度、收敛性和计算效率至关重要，而传统基于优化的网格平滑方法虽然效果好但计算速度慢，亟需一种兼顾质量与效率的新型平滑方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图神经网络（GNN）、网格平滑、雅可比比率质量度量、节点位移回归预测。
AI.method: 将网格平滑建模为节点位移预测的回归问题：以内部自由节点及其局部子图作为输入，将基于雅可比优化的位移作为监督标签，训练GNN模型直接预测最优节点移动量，并以雅可比比率作为网格质量评估指标。
AI.findings: 在法兰、R型零件、轴和扳手四个三维六面体网格模型上，GNN平滑方法能有效提升初始网格质量，达到与传统优化方法相当的网格质量水平，但计算速度显著更快。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将图神经网络应用于三维六面体结构化网格平滑问题，为网格质量优化提供了一种数据驱动的新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种兼具高网格质量和快速计算能力的实用网格平滑工具，可显著提升数值模拟前处理的效率。

title: Machine Learning-Based Multivariate Model for OptimizingRenewable Hydrogen Production via Biomass Gasification and Pyrolysis
affiliations: Rio de Janeiro State University, Rio de Janeiro State University and Rio de Janeiro State University

detail.title: Machine Learning-Based Multivariate Model for OptimizingRenewable Hydrogen Production via Biomass Gasification and Pyrolysis

keywords.keywords: Machine Learning · LightGBM · Biomass Gasification · Pyrolysis · Sustainable Hydrogen · SHAP Interpretability · Process Optimization

detail.abstract: Sustainable hydrogen (H₂) is a key vector in the decarbonization of industrial and transport sectors. Biomass gasification and pyrolysis are promising thermochemical routes for its production, yet the multi-variable nature of these processes demands advanced predictive tools. This study developed and validated a machine learning (ML) predictive model to optimize renewable H₂ yield from biomass thermochemical conversion. An extensive experimental dataset was subjected to exploratory data analysis (EDA) followed by preprocessing stages comprising k-NN imputation, one-hot encoding, outlier capping and Z-score normalization. Five supervised regression algorithms were trained and benchmarked on an independent test set: Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN). The LightGBM model, after hyperparameter optimization via 5-fold cross-validated Grid Search, achieved the best performance (R² = 0.935, MAE = 0.258, RMSE = 0.258 on the test set). SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) analysis revealed that reactor atmosphere (N₂), operating temperature and vapour residence time are the dominant process drivers, while nonlinear interactions — including the catalytic effect of stainless-steel fluidized-bed reactors and a cellulose saturation phenomenon in ash-rich feedstocks such as rice husk — significantly modulate H₂ yield. The optimized model identified a peak operating configuration of 600 °C with corncob feedstock, yielding an estimated 36.6% (v/v) H₂ in the synthesis gas. The data-driven approach demonstrated here has the potential to substantially reduce experimental campaigns and accelerate process design for sustainable hydrogen production.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并验证了基于LightGBM的机器学习模型，用于优化生物质热化学转化制氢工艺，在测试集上达到R²=0.935的优异性能，并通过SHAP分析揭示反应器气氛、操作温度和蒸汽停留时间是主要过程驱动因素，确定600°C下玉米芯原料为最优配置，可产出36.6%（v/v）的氢气。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习模型预测并优化生物质热化学转化（气化与热解）过程中的可再生氢气产率？
AI.motivation: 可持续氢气是工业和交通部门脱碳的关键载体，生物质气化和热解是前景广阔的热化学制氢路线，但这些过程的多变量特性需要先进的预测工具来减少实验工作量并加速工艺设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习预测建模（监督回归算法）、SHAP可解释性分析、生物质热化学转化（气化/热解）工程原理。
AI.method: 收集大量实验数据集，经过EDA分析、k-NN插补、独热编码、异常值封顶和Z-score标准化等预处理后，训练并比较五种监督回归模型（SVM、随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM、ANN），通过5折交叉验证网格搜索优化超参数，最佳模型LightGBM结合SHAP进行特征重要性解释。
AI.findings: LightGBM模型表现最佳（测试集R²=0.935, MAE=0.258, RMSE=0.258）；SHAP分析表明反应器气氛（N₂）、操作温度和蒸汽停留时间是主要驱动因素；发现了不锈钢流化床反应器的催化效应以及灰分含量高的原料（如稻壳）中的纤维素饱和现象等非线性交互作用；最优配置为600°C下使用玉米芯原料，产气中H₂含量达36.6%（v/v）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将LightGBM与SHAP相结合系统解析生物质热化学转化制氢的多变量非线性交互机制，揭示了不锈钢反应器催化效应和灰分原料纤维素饱和等新现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个高精度可解释的机器学习预测工具，能够大幅减少实验次数、加速可再生氢气生产的工艺设计与优化，并明确了最优操作条件（600°C/玉米芯）。

title: Understanding electricity consumption behaviour through Inverse Reinforcement Learning
affiliations: Polytechnic University of Milan, RFF-CMCC European Institute on Economics and the Environment, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and RFF-CMCC European Institute on Economics and the Environment

detail.title: Understanding electricity consumption behaviour through Inverse Reinforcement Learning
detail.abstract: Understanding how households consume electricity in response to socioeconomic and climatic drivers is important for decision-makers designing energy policies in a changing climate and under geopolitical tensions. Consumers respond differently to thermal stress depending on income, consumption habits and the surrounding built environment, a nonlinear behaviour that most approaches oversimplify.In this study, households are treated as agents interacting with complex environments, and Inverse Reinforcement Learning is used to represent their consumption behaviour as model-implied reward functions. Specifically, we observe how these reward functions change when households undergo socioeconomic and climatic shocks.The framework is tested on different clusters of electricity consumption profiles in Italy. Clusters' reward functions are retrieved and used to understand how cooling behaviour changes from summer 2021 to summer 2022 and 2023, before, during and after the energy crisis and a heatwave. We find that these shocks reshaped cooling behaviour heterogeneously across consumer groups, in directions conditioned by their prior habits and built environment. Across the 2021–2023 summers, we identify a spectrum of responses: transient adjustments that receded as the shocks eased, durable shifts persisting into 2023, and consumers exhibiting negligible change. At the sub-daily scale, groups comparable in socioeconomic and environmental context but differing in their daily timing of consumption responded distinctly, identifying time-of-use as a separate dimension of behavioural heterogeneity. Energy policies and demand-response schemes should therefore account not only for who consumers are and where they live, but for when they consume and whether their response to a shock persists.

AI.tldr: 本文利用逆强化学习将意大利家庭用电行为建模为隐含奖励函数，发现2021-2023年间能源危机和热浪冲击对不同消费者群体的降温行为产生了异质性影响，且响应类型包括暂时调整、持久转变和无显著变化。
AI.research_question: 家庭用电行为如何在社会经济和气候冲击下发生变化？不同消费者群体对这些冲击的响应是否存在异质性？
AI.motivation: 传统方法过于简化消费者对热应力的非线性响应行为，缺乏对家庭用电行为在冲击下动态变化的细致理解，这不利于决策者在气候变化和地缘政治紧张背景下设计有效的能源政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 逆强化学习（Inverse Reinforcement Learning）；家庭作为智能体与复杂环境交互的行为建模。
AI.method: 采用逆强化学习将家庭用电消费行为表示为模型隐含的奖励函数，观察这些奖励函数在社会经济和气候冲击下的变化；基于意大利不同电力消费聚类群体进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）2021-2023年夏季，能源危机和热浪冲击对不同消费者群体的降温行为产生了异质性重塑；（2）响应类型呈现谱系特征：暂时性调整（冲击缓解后消退）、持久性转变（持续到2023年）、以及无明显变化；（3）在日内尺度上，社会经济和环境背景相似的群体因用电时段不同而表现迥异，表明用电时间是一个独立的行为异质性维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将逆强化学习方法引入家庭用电行为分析，揭示了冲击下消费者响应的非线性、异质性和持续性特征，并识别出用电时间作为行为异质性的新维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源政策和需求响应方案设计提供指导：政策制定不仅需要考虑消费者是谁、住在哪里，还需关注其何时用电以及冲击响应是否具有持续性。

title: Edge Noise Limits Graph Neural Networks for Encrypted Traffic Classification: A Tabular-First Protocol
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Edge Noise Limits Graph Neural Networks for Encrypted Traffic Classification: A Tabular-First Protocol
detail.abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have been widely adopted for encrypted traffic classification, with recent work reporting accuracy exceeding 95% on standard benchmarks. Whether graph-based representations genuinely improve classification, however, remains poorly understood. This paper presents a systematic empirical study across three encrypted traffic datasets—ISCX VPN-nonVPN, Tor-nonTor, and CSTNET-TLS1.3—comparing five GNN variants, five graph construction strategies, and an MLP baseline, all sharing an identical residual encoder backbone for controlled comparison. The central finding is that GNN-based methods consistently underperform a simple Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) trained on the same handcrafted tabular features, with degradation ranging from 2.1 to 47.5 percentage points at full convergence. The root cause is edge noise: over 60% of heuristically constructed record-graph edges connect sessions from different application classes, causing message passing to homogenize rather than enrich discriminative features. Edge purity (𝜌)—the fraction of within-batch edges connecting same-class nodes—is introduced as a zero-cost pre-training diagnostic; across 14 (strategy, dataset) pairs, strategies with 𝜌 < 0.4 rarely benefit from GNN message passing, and GNN degradation is monotonic in 𝜌 where the 𝜌 range is sufficiently wide. A protocol disentanglement experiment shows that the bottleneck is edge noise, not optimization: the same cosine-annealing change that improves single-model MLP accuracy by 19.4 percentage points yields only a 0.1-point gain for GCN. A 7-MLP soft-voting ensemble reaches 91.0% test accuracy, while a 7-GCN ensemble provides negligible benefit—because edge noise forces all random initializations to near-identical low-quality solutions. Five design guidelines, anchored to a Tabular-First Protocol, distill these findings into practice: train an MLP baseline, compute edge purity before committing to GNN training, and proceed with graph-based methods only when they convincingly outperform the tabular baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统实验发现，在加密流量分类任务中，GNN方法实际上不如简单MLP，原因是基于启发式构建的图中超过60%的边连接了不同类别的节点，导致消息传递反而削弱了判别特征。作者引入边纯度（ρ）作为零成本预训练诊断指标，并提出以表格优先协议为核心的五条设计准则。
AI.research_question: 图神经网络是否真正提升了加密流量分类的性能？
AI.motivation: 尽管GNN在加密流量分类中被广泛采用且报告了高准确率，但其性能提升的真正来源尚不清楚，需要系统性的实证研究来揭示图表示是否真的带来改进。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图神经网络消息传递机制、边噪声理论、边纯度（ρ）诊断指标、表格优先协议
AI.method: 系统实证研究：在三个数据集上比较五种GNN变体、五种图构建策略和MLP基线；引入边纯度（ρ）作为诊断指标；进行协议解缠实验和集成学习实验。
AI.findings: GNN方法在全部数据集上一致性地劣于MLP（退化2.1-47.5个百分点）；根因是边噪声——超过60%的边连接了不同类别的会话；边纯度ρ<0.4时GNN难以获益；瓶颈在于边噪声而非优化问题；7-MLP软投票集成达到91.0%准确率，而7-GCN集成几乎没有增益。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了GNN在加密流量分类任务中性能退化的根本机制（边噪声导致消息传递同质化）；提出了边纯度（ρ）作为预训练诊断指标；建立了GNN退化程度与边纯度之间的单调关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了"表格优先协议"的五条设计准则：先训练MLP基线、在训练GNN前计算边纯度、仅当图方法显著优于表格基线时才采用；为研究人员避免GNN在加密流量分类中的无效使用提供了实用指南。

title: Synthetic Data and Tail-Risk Pricing

detail.title: Synthetic Data and Tail-Risk Pricing
detail.abstract: Banks and insurers hold capital against tail losses they have almost no data toestimate, and they increasingly fill the gap with AI-generated syntheticscenarios. Because each version of the generative model is trained partly on theoutput of the previous one, the estimated tail probability drifts below its truevalue. A synthetic sample of a rare event usually contains no event, so eachretraining round understates the tail and passes the lower estimate to the nextround. The gap grows with the ratio of synthetic to real data. This bias passesinto prices, and spreads on credit and catastrophe bonds compress until they nolonger separate safe issuers from risky ones. The problem compounds, because realtail data arrives only when losses occur. In calm periods the share of real datafalls, reliance on synthetic draws rises, and spreads tighten further, until themarket can reach a low-information state that only a wave of realized lossesreverses. The paper sets out policies to limit the bias and keep pricesinformative.

AI.tldr: 金融行业使用AI生成的合成数据来估算尾部风险，但由于生成模型迭代训练中真实数据不足，尾部概率被持续低估，导致信用和巨灾债券价差失真，市场可能陷入低信息均衡状态，只有实际损失才能逆转这一过程。
AI.research_question: 使用AI生成的合成场景数据来估算尾部损失时，是否存在系统性偏差？这种偏差如何影响金融市场的定价和信息效率？
AI.motivation: 银行和保险公司持有资本以应对尾部损失，但几乎缺乏相关数据；业界越来越多地使用AI生成合成数据来填补这一空白，但这种做法可能带来尚未被充分认识的系统性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 尾部风险估计、生成模型偏差传播、市场信息效率理论
AI.method: 理论模型分析，研究生成模型迭代训练过程中尾部概率估计的偏差动态，以及这种偏差在市场价格中的传导效应。
AI.findings: 合成数据比例越高，尾部概率低估越严重；这种低估传导至定价，导致信用和巨灾债券利差压缩，无法区分安全与风险主体；在平静期，真实数据占比下降，合成数据依赖上升，利差进一步收紧，市场可能陷入低信息状态，只有实际损失才能逆转。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI生成数据在尾部风险估计中产生系统性低估偏差的机制（迭代训练导致偏差逐轮累积）；提出"低信息状态"概念，描述市场在缺乏真实尾部数据时可能陷入的均衡陷阱。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和金融机构提供了限制合成数据偏差的政策建议，以维持价格信息含量和市场风险定价的有效性。

title: The Disaggregated Effects of Macroprudential Policy on Sovereign Risk: Evidence from Cross-Country Panel Data
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Disaggregated Effects of Macroprudential Policy on Sovereign Risk: Evidence from Cross-Country Panel Data
detail.abstract: While tighter aggregate macroprudential policies are associated with reductions in sovereign credit risk, the transmission of disaggregated macroprudential policy instruments remains less clear in the literature. Using cross-country panel regressions, this paper documents substantial heterogeneity in how specific macroprudential categories relate to sovereign bond markets across Fixed-Effects and System GMM specifications. Borrower-based tools are consistently associated with reductions in sovereign risk, suggesting a more direct transmission channel through credit conditions. In contrast, other instruments, such as capital-based, liquidity/funding and FX-related measures, do not exhibit robust or consistently identifiable effects. At the same time, the aggregate macroprudential stance remains significantly associated with sovereign risk even when controlling for individual tools. These findings suggest that macroprudential policy affects sovereign risk through both instrument-specific channels, whose strength depends on the directness of transmission, and broader policy-stance effects, while also showing the limits of identification in cross-country analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文使用跨国面板回归，发现宏观审慎政策整体上能降低主权信用风险，但不同政策工具的效果存在显著异质性：基于借款人的工具效果稳健，而资本、流动性、外汇相关工具效果不稳健。宏观审慎政策通过特定工具渠道和整体政策立场两种机制影响主权风险。
AI.research_question: 不同类型的宏观审慎政策工具如何影响主权债券市场（主权信用风险）？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对宏观审慎政策整体收紧与主权信用风险降低之间的关系已有共识，但对不同政策工具（如借款人导向、资本导向、流动性/融资和外汇相关措施）的异质性传导机制尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观审慎政策通过两条渠道影响主权风险：（1）特定工具渠道——不同工具通过不同机制传导，其效果取决于传导的直接性；（2）整体政策立场渠道——宏观审慎政策的总基调（stance）本身也会影响市场信心和主权风险溢价。
AI.method: 跨国面板回归，采用固定效应（Fixed-Effects）和系统GMM（System GMM）两种规范进行估计。
AI.findings: （1）借款人导向工具（如贷款价值比上限等）与主权风险降低稳健相关；（2）资本导向、流动性/融资和外汇相关工具的效果不稳健或不显著；（3）即使控制了各类具体工具，宏观审慎政策整体立场仍与主权风险显著相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了宏观审慎政策影响主权风险的双重机制（工具特定传导与整体政策立场效应），并指出不同工具的异质性取决于其传导渠道的直接性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计宏观审慎政策框架提供了参考：借款人导向工具在降低主权风险方面更为有效，而其他工具的效果有限；同时，政策整体立场本身也具有独立的风险缓释效应。

title: Economic Policy Uncertainty, Exports, and Investment:,Theory and Evidence
affiliations: Nagasaki University, Nagasaki University and Nagasaki University

detail.title: Economic Policy Uncertainty, Exports, and Investment:,Theory and Evidence
detail.abstract: Economic policy uncertainty (EPU) has risen markedly across many countries, yet how it shapes firms’ exports remains incompletely understood. This paper identifies an investment channel: because exporting is capital-intensive and entry is sunk, uncertainty-driven delays in irreversible investment erode the capital that sustains it. We develop a dynamic firm model that links capital accumulation to the export decision through convex and irreversible capital-adjustment costs. Estimated by the simulated method of moments on approximately 3,600 Japanese listed firms over 1998–2022, the model produces a joint contraction after an uncertainty (second-moment) shock: investment and export participation fall together and, because re-entry is costly, recover only slowly. We complement it with a reduced-form instrumental-variable strategy that uses cabinet approval ratings as a plausibly exogenous instrument for domestic EPU. These estimates corroborate the structural findings, showing that higher EPU significantly depresses both the extensive and intensive margins of trade. These results identify sunk and irreversible costs as the amplifiers of uncertainty’s trade consequences, underscoring the value of stable, predictable policy for firms’ long-term international engagement.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建动态企业模型，利用日本上市公司数据，揭示了经济政策不确定性（EPU）通过抑制企业资本投资进而减少出口的机制。研究发现，EPU冲击导致企业投资和出口参与同时下降，且由于重新进入成本高昂，恢复缓慢。不可逆投资成本放大了不确定性对贸易的负面影响。
AI.research_question: 经济政策不确定性如何影响企业的出口行为，其传导机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 虽然全球多国经济政策不确定性显著上升，但其如何塑造企业出口行为仍不完全清楚。现有研究缺乏对不确定性通过资本投资渠道影响出口的微观机制分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态企业模型，结合凸性和不可逆的资本调整成本，将资本积累与出口决策联系起来。
AI.method: 模拟矩估计法（SMM）应用于约3600家日本上市公司1998-2022年数据；辅以工具变量法（利用内阁支持率作为国内EPU的工具变量）进行简化式估计。
AI.findings: 不确定性（二阶矩）冲击导致投资和出口参与同时下降；由于重新进入成本高昂，恢复缓慢；EPU显著抑制了贸易的广延边际和集约边际；沉没成本和不可逆成本是不确定性放大贸易后果的关键机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别了经济政策不确定性影响出口的"投资渠道"机制；将资本调整成本（凸性与不可逆性）纳入不确定性-贸易分析框架；揭示了沉没成本作为不确定性放大器的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了稳定、可预测的政策环境对企业长期国际参与的重要性；为政策制定者提供了降低不确定性以促进出口的实证依据。

title: Conceptualizing Digitally-Enabled Circular Economy Transitions for Developmental Contexts: Pathways, Capabilities, and Practices
affiliations: HEC Montreal, affiliation not provided to SSRN and HEC Montreal

detail.title: Conceptualizing Digitally-Enabled Circular Economy Transitions for Developmental Contexts: Pathways, Capabilities, and Practices
detail.abstract: The circular economy (CE) enabled by digital transformation is integral to sustainable development strategies. Yet, the body of empirical evidence shows that digitally-enabled CE outcomes remain uneven across countries and industrial systems. Research often assumes that digital technologies automatically enable circularity and frequently derive their conceptual models from frontier economies. This paper challenges these assumptions by conceptualizing digitally-enabled CE transitions through a developmental lens. Building on insights from the innovation systems, capability and sustainability transition literature, we extend an existing systematic literature review of studies examining digital technological capabilities (DTCs) and CE outcomes in manufacturing contexts. The analysis reveals that CE outcomes emerge not only from the adoption of digital technologies but also from the interaction among DTC development, organizational and inter-organizational capabilities, and the transition pathways followed by industrial systems. The findings suggest that in many catching-up economies, digital technologies are frequently deployed to improve operational efficiency without fundamentally transforming production systems or enabling systemic resource circulation. We therefore propose a framework that conceptualizes digitally-enabled CE transitions as capability-driven, path-dependent processes shaped by distinct developmental contexts. This perspective highlights the importance of capability building, practice transformation, and system coordination in enabling circular transitions in developing-country manufacturing systems.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了"数字技术自动实现循环经济"的假设，提出数字赋能的循环经济转型是能力驱动、路径依赖的发展过程，在追赶型经济体中，数字技术更多被用于提升运营效率而非实现系统性资源循环。
AI.research_question: 在制造业背景下，数字技术能力与循环经济成果之间如何相互作用？不同发展阶段国家的数字化转型如何影响循环经济转型路径？
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多假设数字技术会自动带来循环经济成果，且概念模型多源自前沿经济体，忽视了发展中国家追赶型经济体的特殊发展情境。实证证据表明不同国家的数字赋能循环经济成果存在差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新系统理论、能力理论、可持续转型理论
AI.method: 基于现有系统文献综述的扩展分析，结合创新系统、能力理论和可持续转型文献的见解
AI.findings: 循环经济成果不仅来自数字技术采纳，还来自数字技术能力发展、组织与跨组织能力、产业系统转型路径三者的交互作用。在许多追赶型经济体中，数字技术主要用于提升运营效率，而非根本性改变生产系统或实现系统性资源循环。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出数字赋能循环经济转型是能力驱动、路径依赖、受发展情境塑造的过程框架，挑战了数字技术自动实现循环性的主流假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了能力建设、实践转型和系统协调对发展中国家制造业实现循环转型的重要性，为追赶型经济体制定数字化转型与循环经济政策提供了理论指导。

title: LIBS determination of major and minor elements in airborne rock particles using a Transformer-Res-CNN deep network

detail.title: LIBS determination of major and minor elements in airborne rock particles using a Transformer-Res-CNN deep network
detail.abstract: Direct monitoring and analysis of major and minor elements in airborne mineral particles are vital for industrial process controls and material processing. Major elements such as Al, Si, and Fe are directly related to ore grade, mineral composition, and the industrial value of mineral feedstocks, while minor elements such as Ca, K, and Ti provide important information on fluxing behavior, alkali-related process stability, mineral discrimination. Laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS) enables such determination to be performed in situ or online with naturally occurring rock particles without additional sample preparation, yet severe spectral fluctuation due to the stochastic nature of laser-particle interaction poses significant challenges. In particular for data processing, classical shallow machine-learning models often rely on preprocessing, which can include normalization, data fold alignment and feature selection, designed according to physical prior and practical allowance. The pertinence of such preprocessing can be limited by designers’ understanding of the specific physical processes involved which can be greatly complex, as in the case of laser-particle interaction. In addition, the limited modeling capacity, particularly when dealing with highly complex nonlinear dependencies as in the case of a shallow neural network, makes the overall predictive performance heavily dependent on the preprocessing applied. This situation can result in overfitting to the training dataset with a specific preprocessing and poor generalizability when the models are applied outside their original training context. This work addresses the above challenges by introducing a data processing approach based on a Transformer-Res-CNN architecture, a hybrid deep learning framework that integrates a 1D-ResNet with a Transformer module. Res-CNN naturally handles raw spectral data, automatically learns low-level features, especially weak emission lines from minor elements. The self-attention mechanism of Transformer captures long-range dependencies, that can be of various types with multi-head attention, and global spectral contexts. The combined hybrid architecture is thus more resilient to noise and distribution shifts, lowering the need for extensive data cleaning or normalization. The experiment was performed using 48 rock particle samples with a size distribution ranging from 1 µm to 1000 µm, resulted from mechanical crushing. Their mineral compositions offer a good representation of rocks and minerals usually encountered in industrial and geological applications. The particles were airborne-transported through the LIBS interaction zone, within a negative-pressure particle-flow system developed in our previous works. Experimental raw spectra were directly processed with the developed Transformer-Res-CNN method. The obtained analytical performances were compared with those obtained with classical machine-learning models with back-propagation neural networks (BPNN) and random forest (RF) algorithms coupled with suitable data preprocessing. AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer-Res-CNN混合深度学习架构的数据处理方法，用于直接分析空气中矿物颗粒的LIBS光谱，无需复杂预处理即可实现对主量元素（Al₂O₃、SiO₂、TFe₂O₃）和微量元素（Ca、K、Ti）的精准预测，性能显著优于传统机器学习模型。
AI.research_question: 如何在不依赖复杂数据预处理的前提下，利用LIBS技术实现对空气中矿物颗粒中主量和微量元素的高精度、鲁棒性在线分析？
AI.motivation: 传统浅层机器学习模型在处理LIBS光谱时严重依赖基于物理先验的预处理（如归一化、对齐、特征选择），但这些预处理因激光-粒子相互作用的复杂性而容易导致过拟合和泛化能力不足；同时浅层模型对高度非线性依赖的建模能力有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: Transformer-Res-CNN混合深度学习架构：1D-ResNet自动学习原始光谱的低层特征（尤其是微量元素的弱发射线）；Transformer的多头自注意力机制捕捉长程依赖和全局光谱上下文。
AI.method: 使用48个粒径1-1000 µm的岩石颗粒样品，在负压气流系统中通过LIBS获取原始光谱；直接输入Transformer-Res-CNN模型进行预测；与BPNN和随机森林（带预处理）进行对比。
AI.findings: 主量元素Al₂O₃、SiO₂、TFe₂O₃的RMSEP分别为0.62 wt%、1.38 wt%、0.98 wt%，REP分别为3.5%、3.4%、6.8%；微量元素也取得了良好预测精度，RMSEP分别为0.79 wt%、0.90 wt%、0.11 wt%。该方法显著优于传统机器学习模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了混合深度学习架构（Res-CNN + Transformer）在原始LIBS光谱直接分析中的有效性，克服了传统方法对预处理的依赖，为复杂物理过程中的光谱建模提供了新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业过程控制和矿物加工提供了一种可在线、原位、免样品制备的颗粒元素分析方法，降低了预处理的人工成本和过拟合风险，提升了模型在实际场景中的泛化能力。

title: Interpretable Multi-Scale CBAM-Transformer for Nondestructive Traceability of Hazelnut Year, Origin, and Variety via Near-Infrared Spectroscopy
affiliations: Northeast Forestry University, Northeast Forestry University, Northeast Forestry University, Northeast Forestry University and Northeast Forestry University

detail.title: Interpretable Multi-Scale CBAM-Transformer for Nondestructive Traceability of Hazelnut Year, Origin, and Variety via Near-Infrared Spectroscopy
detail.abstract: The storage year, geographical origin, and variety of hazelnuts are core attributes determining their economic value and quality. Due to complex physical scattering and the class imbalance prevalent in real-world agricultural data, traditional near-infrared (NIR) spectroscopy detection models are frequently subjected to high-frequency noise interference and are prone to majority-class dominance bias. To this end, this study constructed a deep learning classification model integrating multi-scale feature extraction and a channel-spatial dual attention mechanism to achieve high-precision simultaneous traceability of the three major hazelnut attributes. Initially, an independent test set was strictly partitioned and fixed using the Kennard-Stone algorithm based on Standard Normal Variate (SNV) transformation, ensuring strict single-variable control for comparative experiments. Experimental results demonstrate that the multi-scale tokenizer and the CBAM dual attention module not only effectively mitigated the high-frequency instrumental noise amplified by the first-derivative preprocessing but also precisely located key absorption bands, fully leveraging the representational capacity of derivative spectra in sharpening overlapping peaks. Simultaneously, the introduction of dynamic class penalty weights effectively resolved the 1:10 extreme data imbalance problem. The final model achieved an overall accuracy of 99.26% and a macro-average F1-score of 98.85% on the independent test set. Furthermore, spectral saliency mapping calculated via backpropagation revealed the physicochemical interpretability of the deep learning model: it automatically ignored overlapping spectral regions with high absorbance but low discriminative power, and precisely anchored on the core chemical bands of water (O-H bonds at 1400–1480 nm) and lipids (C-H bonds at 1600–1700 nm), which dictate hazelnut storage degradation and varietal differences. This study not only provides a new high-precision methodological reference for the joint nondestructive evaluation of complex agricultural multi-attributes but also provides a novel chemometric perspective for deciphering the opaque decision-making mechanisms of deep learning.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种集成多尺度特征提取与通道-空间双注意力的深度学习分类模型，结合动态类别惩罚权重，用于榛子的贮藏年份、地理起源和品种三大属性的近红外光谱高精度同步追溯，最终在独立测试集上达到99.26%的准确率和98.85%的宏平均F1分数，并通过光谱显著性映射揭示了模型的物化可解释性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用近红外光谱结合深度学习实现榛子贮藏年份、地理起源和品种三大属性的高精度同步追溯，并解决光谱噪声干扰和类别不平衡问题？
AI.motivation: 榛子的贮藏年份、地理起源和品种是决定其经济价值和品质的核心属性，但传统近红外光谱检测模型受高频噪声干扰和多数类主导偏差影响，难以同时实现高精度多属性追溯。需要一种能够有效处理复杂物理散射和类别不平衡问题的新方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多尺度特征提取、通道-空间双注意力机制（CBAM）、动态类别惩罚权重、光谱显著性映射
AI.method: 基于Kennard-Stone算法划分独立测试集，经标准正态变量变换预处理，构建集成多尺度tokenizer和CBAM双注意力模块的深度学习分类模型，引入动态类别惩罚权重解决1:10极端数据不平衡问题，并通过反向传播计算光谱显著性映射进行可解释性分析。
AI.findings: 模型在独立测试集上达到99.26%的总体准确率和98.85%的宏平均F1分数；多尺度tokenizer和CBAM双注意力模块有效抑制了一阶导数预处理放大的高频仪器噪声，并精确定位关键吸收带；动态类别惩罚权重有效解决了1:10极端数据不平衡问题；光谱显著性映射显示模型自动忽略高吸光度但低区分度的重叠光谱区域，精确锚定水（1400-1480 nm的O-H键）和脂质（1600-1700 nm的C-H键）的核心化学波段。
AI.theory_contributions: 为复杂农业多属性联合无损评估提供了新的高精度方法学参考；为解码深度学习不透明决策机制提供了新的化学计量学视角，证明了通过光谱显著性映射可以揭示模型关注的核心化学波段。
AI.practical_contributions: 实现了榛子三大核心属性的高精度同步追溯，可应用于农产品质量检测与真实性鉴别领域；为处理实际农业数据中普遍存在的类别不平衡问题提供了有效解决方案。

title: AM-YOLO: Efficient Linear-Complexity Global Context Modeling for UAV Multi-Object Tracking

detail.title: AM-YOLO: Efficient Linear-Complexity Global Context Modeling for UAV Multi-Object Tracking
detail.abstract: Multi-object tracking (MOT) from unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) requires joint target detection and identity maintenance across complex aerial video sequences. Although global self-attention mechanisms excel at context modeling, their quadratic computational complexity O(N^2) presents severe bottlenecks for deployment on resource-constrained onboard UAV hardware. To bridge this gap, we introduce AeroMamba-YOLO (AM-YOLO), an efficient tracking-by-detection framework that integrates a Mamba-enhanced backbone into an anchor-free YOLO architecture. Specifically, we propose two novel modules, SPPCSMamba and C2CSMamba, which embed linear-complexity O(N) selective state-space modeling into the feature extraction network. These modules adaptively fuse local and global spatial contexts, significantly improving the robustness of feature representations against severe occlusions and scale variations inherent to small targets. Evaluated on a challenging multi-drone RGB–thermal aerial tracking benchmark using BoT-SORT, AM-YOLO delivers state-ofthe-art performance, achieving 69.2 HOTA/95.1 IDF1/90.8 MOTA on Drone 1, and 70.6 HOTA/91.5 IDF1/92.2 MOTA on Drone 2. Comprehensive ablation studies demonstrate the complementary nature of our proposed modules and verify that the performance gains are fundamentally driven by selective state-space modeling rather than a mere increase in parameter capacity

AI.tldr: 本文提出AM-YOLO框架，将线性复杂度的选择性状态空间模型（Mamba）嵌入YOLO骨干网络，通过SPPCSMamba和C2CSMamba模块高效融合局部与全局空间上下文，在资源受限的无人机平台上实现高性能多目标跟踪，在RGB-热成像双无人机基准上达到SOTA结果。
AI.research_question: 如何在资源受限的无人机嵌入式硬件上，实现高效且高性能的多目标跟踪（MOT），克服全局自注意力机制二次计算复杂度O(N²)的瓶颈？
AI.motivation: 无人机多目标跟踪需要同时进行目标检测和身份维持，但全局自注意力机制的计算复杂度为O(N²)，严重限制了其在资源受限的机载硬件上的部署。现有方法在计算效率与跟踪精度之间难以取得平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 选择性状态空间模型（Selective State-Space Modeling, Mamba）；线性复杂度O(N)的特征建模；锚点自由YOLO检测架构；跟踪-检测范式（tracking-by-detection）。
AI.method: 提出AM-YOLO框架，核心包括两个新模块：（1）SPPCSMamba——将Mamba状态空间建模嵌入空间金字塔池化结构；（2）C2CSMamba——将Mamba模块嵌入跨阶段局部特征融合结构。两者均实现线性复杂度O(N)，自适应融合局部和全局空间上下文，增强对小目标、严重遮挡和尺度变化的特征鲁棒性。使用BoT-SORT跟踪器进行评估。
AI.findings: 在多无人机RGB-热成像跟踪基准上，Drone 1达到69.2 HOTA/95.1 IDF1/90.8 MOTA，Drone 2达到70.6 HOTA/91.5 IDF1/92.2 MOTA。消融实验证明两个模块具有互补性，性能提升根本驱动力来自选择性状态空间建模，而非参数量的简单增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将Mamba选择性状态空间模型引入无人机多目标跟踪领域，设计了SPPCSMamba和C2CSMamba两种线性复杂度模块，为在资源受限设备上高效建模全局上下文提供了新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出的AM-YOLO框架实现了计算效率与跟踪精度之间的有效平衡，适合部署在资源受限的无人机机载硬件上，在复杂空中视频场景中显著提升小目标跟踪的鲁棒性。

title: How Community Attachment Shapes Residents' Support for Sustainable Rural Tourism: Evidence from Andean Communities in Peru
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Universidad de Córdoba and Cordoba University

detail.title: How Community Attachment Shapes Residents' Support for Sustainable Rural Tourism: Evidence from Andean Communities in Peru
detail.abstract: This study analyzes how residents’ emotional and social ties to their community shape their support for sustainable tourism initiatives in rural destinations. Particular attention is given to the role of perceived tourism impacts and their implications for local well-being and social sustainability. Social exchange theory and ideas about the bond people have with their community were used to develop a model using the CB-SEM (covariance-based structural equation modelling) technique. Data were obtained from 225 residents living in three rural communities in the Cusco region of Peru, where community-based tourism represents an important economic activity. The empirical results indicate that a stronger sense of community attachment may have a greater influence on perceptions of both the positive and negative consequences of sustainable tourism development. Residents who perceived greater benefits expressed high levels of support, whilst perceptions of adverse impacts reduced support. No statistically significant direct relationship was found between community attachment and support for sustainable tourism, suggesting that residents’ assessments of the outcomes of tourism play a key role in shaping their attitudes. These findings highlight that attachment to place does not automatically translate into support for tourism initiatives. Instead, residents’ interpretations of tourism-related changes act as a key mechanism through which attachment influences support. The study contributes empirical evidence from rural Andean communities and offers insights for designing tourism policies that encourage local engagement while strengthening social sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了居民社区情感与社会纽带如何影响其对乡村可持续旅游的支持，发现社区依恋通过影响居民对旅游影响的感知（而非直接作用）来塑造支持态度，并基于秘鲁库斯科地区三个乡村社区的225份问卷数据进行了实证检验。
AI.research_question: 居民对社区的情感依恋和社会纽带如何影响其对乡村可持续旅游倡议的支持？居民感知到的旅游影响在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 在乡村地区，社区依恋对可持续旅游支持的影响机制尚不明确，尤其是居民对旅游影响的感知在其中是否发挥中介作用。理解这一机制对推动乡村社会可持续性和居民福祉具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会交换理论（Social Exchange Theory）和社区依恋（Community Attachment）理论。
AI.method: 基于协方差的结构方程模型（CB-SEM）；数据来自秘鲁库斯科地区三个乡村社区的225名居民。
AI.findings: （1）社区依恋越强，居民对可持续旅游发展的正面和负面后果的感知越强；（2）感知到更多利益的居民对旅游表现出更高支持，而感知到负面影响的居民支持度降低；（3）社区依恋与旅游支持之间无显著的直接关系，居民对旅游成果的评估在两者之间起关键中介作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了社区依恋通过居民对旅游影响的感知间接影响支持态度的机制，丰富了社会交换理论在乡村旅游情境中的应用，表明依恋并不自动转化为支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乡村可持续旅游政策制定提供了实证依据，提示政策制定者应关注居民对旅游影响的感知和沟通，通过增强居民对正面成果的认知来促进本地参与和社会可持续性。

title: Biomechanically Constrained Spatiotemporal 3D Human Pose Estimation and Temporal Error Feedback for Classical Dance Using Deep Learning Techniques
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Guntur Engineering College, Malla Reddy University, Koneru Lakshmaiah Education Foundation and AVN Institute of Engineering and Technology

detail.title: Biomechanically Constrained Spatiotemporal 3D Human Pose Estimation and Temporal Error Feedback for Classical Dance Using Deep Learning Techniques
detail.abstract: Designing efficient convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture for the dance analysis has become problematic because of optimization of model parameters across different motion-analysis tasks. Traditional methods depend on fixed architectures and select the hyperparameters manually, which restricts their flexibility, especially in the case of classical dances. In this study we are presenting a deep learning framework for biomechanically constrained 3D human pose estimation and fine-grained error detection in Bharatanatyam dance with monocular video sequences. This model combines spatiotemporal feature extraction, biomechanical constraint enforcement, forward kinematics-based 3D reconstruction, and Dynamic Time Warping (DTW)-based temporal alignment for accurate movement analysis and finally feedback generation. The outcomes of this work gives good performance compared to MediaPipe, OpenPose, and VideoPose3D in terms of pose accuracy and temporal consistency. The Architectures utilize 21 joints and 57 angular parameters across 16-frame dance sequences and is trained with synthetic error injection to progress robustness. The planned design achieved an MPJPE of 18.5 mm, an angle error of 6.2°, a DTW alignment score of 0.91, and an overall accuracy of 94.3%, signifying its efficacy for classical dance analysis and corrective motion feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向婆罗多舞（Bharatanatyam）的深度学习框架，结合生物力学约束、时空特征提取和动态时间规整，实现了高精度的3D人体姿态估计与错误检测，在多个指标上优于MediaPipe、OpenPose等现有方法。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个高效、精准的深度学习框架，用于经典舞蹈（以婆罗多舞为例）的3D人体姿态估计和细粒度错误检测？
AI.motivation: 传统CNN架构在舞蹈分析中依赖固定结构和手动超参数选择，灵活性差；现有姿态估计方法（如MediaPipe、OpenPose）在经典舞蹈的精细动作分析上精度不足，难以提供有效的矫正反馈。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生物力学约束、前向运动学、动态时间规整（DTW）、时空特征提取
AI.method: 结合时空特征提取、生物力学约束强制执行、基于前向运动学的3D重建、DTW时间对齐的深度学习框架；使用21个关节点和57个角度参数，16帧舞蹈序列训练，并注入合成错误以提升鲁棒性。
AI.findings: MPJPE为18.5mm，角度误差6.2°，DTW对齐得分0.91，总体准确率94.3%，在姿态精度和时间一致性上均优于MediaPipe、OpenPose和VideoPose3D。
AI.theory_contributions: 将生物力学约束与深度学习相结合，提出了面向经典舞蹈的精细化姿态估计与错误检测框架，丰富了舞蹈分析领域的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经典舞蹈教学和训练提供了高精度的自动化动作分析与矫正反馈工具，可辅助舞者提升动作规范性。
