detail.title: Responsible Digital Transformation in Emerging Markets: How Corporate Digital Responsibility Shapes Sustainable Competitive Advantage in China through Serial Mediations
detail.abstract: This study is rooted in China’s digital transformation and unique institutional context, exploring how corporate digital responsibility empowers sustainable competitive advantage through the serial mediating roles of responsible AI innovation and data resource integration, with digital trust exerting a positive moderating effect. Mixed surveys collected data from 523 local firms, and multiple econometric models verified the hypotheses. Integrating institutional and CSR theories, this paper supplements indigenous evidence for emerging markets and offers localized references for domestic corporate digital governance and relevant policy formulation.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨中国企业数字责任如何通过负责任AI创新和数据资源整合的链式中介作用，以及数字信任的调节作用，来提升可持续竞争优势。
AI.research_question: 企业数字责任如何赋能可持续竞争优势？负责任AI创新与数据资源整合是否发挥链式中介作用？数字信任是否起到调节作用？
AI.motivation: 在中国数字化转型与独特制度背景下，探索企业数字责任对可持续竞争优势的影响机制，为新兴市场提供本土化证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论、企业社会责任理论
AI.method: 混合调查法，收集523家本土企业数据，运用多种计量经济模型验证假设。
AI.findings: 企业数字责任通过负责任AI创新与数据资源整合的链式中介作用赋能可持续竞争优势，数字信任发挥正向调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合制度理论与CSR理论，为新兴市场数字责任与竞争优势关系提供本土化理论证据，拓展了数字责任研究的情境边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国内企业数字治理及相关政策制定提供本土化参考，指导企业通过负责任AI和数据整合构建可持续竞争优势。

title: A Cost-Optimization Framework for Assessing Green Ammonia Regional Maritime Demand and Bunkering
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Kedge Business School Bordeaux, Kedge Business School Bordeaux, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Adolfo Ibanez University

detail.title: A Cost-Optimization Framework for Assessing Green Ammonia Regional Maritime Demand and Bunkering
detail.abstract: We develop a methodology to endogenously estimate green ammonia demand based on a spatial optimization model and demonstrate its application by assessing Chile’s potential role as a green ammonia supplier for maritime transport. The model simultaneously determines the optimal location and capacity of bunkering facilities, vessel retrofitting decisions, and fuel supply flows while minimizing the total annualized system cost. Results indicate that carbon prices below 230USD/tCO2 are insufficient to trigger investment in green ammonia infrastructure under baseline cost assumptions, highlighting the importance of market-based measures for maritime decarbonization. Sensitivity analyses show that fuel production costs strongly influence both the carbon-price threshold required for market uptake and Chile’s competitiveness. Relatively small production cost advantages substantially increase its market share and can eventually enable Chile to become the dominant supplier. The proposed framework provides a quantitative tool to evaluate carbon-pricing policies, infrastructure deployment, and the competitiveness of emerging green fuel exporters

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种基于空间优化模型的内生性绿色氨需求方法，评估智利作为海运绿色氨供应商的潜力。研究发现碳价需超过230美元/吨CO2才能触发绿色氨基础设施投资，且燃料生产成本优势对智利的市场竞争力至关重要。
AI.research_question: 如何评估绿色氨在海运脱碳中的需求潜力，以及智利作为绿色氨供应商的竞争角色？
AI.motivation: 海运脱碳需要替代燃料，绿色氨作为一种有前景的零碳燃料，但其需求受碳价、基础设施和成本等多因素影响。现有研究缺乏对绿色氨需求的内生性估计以及对新兴燃料出口国竞争力的系统性评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间优化模型；系统成本最小化框架
AI.method: 建立空间优化模型，同时确定加注设施的最优位置与容量、船舶改造决策和燃料供应流，以最小化年化系统总成本，并进行敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 1) 基线成本假设下，碳价低于230美元/吨CO2不足以触发绿色氨基础设施投资；2) 燃料生产成本显著影响碳价阈值和智利的竞争力；3) 较小的生产成本优势即可大幅提升智利的市场份额，甚至使其成为主导供应商。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了内生性估计绿色氨需求的方法论框架，将碳定价政策、基础设施部署与燃料出口竞争力纳入统一分析模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估碳定价政策有效性和绿色氨基础设施投资的定量工具；为智利等潜在绿色燃料出口国提供了竞争力分析依据。

title: The Post-multi-fiber Arrangement Dynamics of Apparel Trade under the African Growth and Opportunity Act

detail.title: The Post-multi-fiber Arrangement Dynamics of Apparel Trade under the African Growth and Opportunity Act

declarations.funderStatement: The author did not receive funding for this research.

detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the impact of the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) on United States (US) apparel imports from Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), with particular emphasis on the period following the 2005 expiration of the Multi-Fiber Arrangement (MFA). To identify the causal effects of AGOA, I employ a Triple-Difference (TD) estimator with a rich set of fixed effects, exploiting variation across countries, products, and time. By simultaneously comparing changes along these three dimensions, the TD framework accounts for unobserved factors that may bias conventional Difference-inDifferences estimates and provides a more credible identification of the trade effects of AGOA. The results indicate that AGOA increased US apparel imports from SSA by approximately 90%, a finding that is broadly consistent with the projections of the legislation. However, the expiration of the MFA intensified competition in global apparel markets, leading to a moderation in export growth among AGOA beneficiaries. The adverse effects were particularly pronounced among non-least developed countries in western and southern Africa, which faced greater challenges competing with low-cost apparel exporters. Conversely, eastern African countries were relatively resilient to the post-MFA competitive pressures, potentially reflecting their comparative advantage in labor-intensive apparel production, supported by abundant low-cost labor and growing integration into global apparel value chains.

AI.tldr: 本文利用三重差分法评估AGOA对美国从撒哈拉以南非洲进口服装的影响，发现AGOA使进口增长约90%，但MFA到期后竞争加剧，非最不发达国家受影响较大，东非国家相对更具韧性。
AI.research_question: AGOA如何影响美国从撒哈拉以南非洲的服装进口？MFA到期后这种影响如何变化？
AI.motivation: AGOA是重要的贸易优惠法案，但MFA于2005年到期后全球服装市场竞争加剧，需评估AGOA的实际贸易效应及其在不同条件下的异质性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易优惠政策理论、比较优势理论、三重差分识别策略
AI.method: 采用三重差分估计量，利用国家、产品和时间三个维度的变异，纳入丰富的固定效应进行因果识别。
AI.findings: AGOA使美国从SSA的服装进口增加约90%；MFA到期后出口增速放缓；西非和南非的非最不发达国家受到更大冲击；东非国家因劳动力成本优势和全球价值链整合而更具韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次利用三重差分法更可信地识别AGOA的因果贸易效应，克服了传统双重差分可能存在的偏误；揭示了贸易优惠政策与全球贸易自由化（MFA到期）之间的交互效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估AGOA有效性提供量化依据；提示针对不同发展水平和区域的国家应采取差异化支持策略；强调劳动力成本优势和全球价值链整合对贸易优惠政策效果的重要性。

title: Who Gets the Oil? Strategic Petroleum Reserve Exchanges, Political Donations, and the Risk of Public-Asset Capture
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Who Gets the Oil? Strategic Petroleum Reserve Exchanges, Political Donations, and the Risk of Public-Asset Capture
detail.abstract:
The U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve (SPR) was created as an emergency national-security asset, not as ordinary commercial inventory. In 2026, the Trump administration authorized the release of 172 million barrels from the SPR as part of a coordinated 400-million-barrel International Energy Agency action responding to global oil-supply disruption. Large portions of the U.S. release were structured as exchanges: private firms received public crude immediately and agreed to return crude later with premium barrels. This structure may improve inventory accounting over time, but it does not answer the central public-integrity question: who received the oil, on what terms, with what restrictions, and with what measurable public benefit while the reserve was depleted? 
This paper argues that SPR exchanges should be evaluated not only by barrel repayment but also by public-value accounting. Public-value accounting asks whether recipient firms were selected through transparent criteria; whether politically connected companies received favorable access; whether recipient-specific terms differed by crude grade, delivery site, repayment premium, delivery window, or Jones Act waiver benefit; whether commodity traders were restricted from resale, export, swaps, or arbitrage gains; and whether the Department of Energy screened campaign donations, inauguration funding, ballroom-related donations, lobbying, prior enforcement history, and conflicts involving senior officials. 
The paper does not allege that any SPR recipient acted illegally, that campaign donations caused specific contract awards, or that a criminal quid pro quo occurred. It makes a narrower governance claim: the current public record is insufficient to rule out donor preference, insider advantage, or public-asset capture. Because the SPR is a public emergency asset, the government should disclose enough to make corruption unlikely, detectable, and punishable. The paper proposes a recipient-level SPR exchange ledger, donor-conflict certification, anti-arbitrage conditions, domestic-consumer benefit reporting, independent GAO or Inspector General review, and a statutory strategic floor requiring congressional authorization before the reserve is depleted below a defined minimum.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨美国战略石油储备（SPR）在2026年大规模释放中采用的"交换"结构，指出当前信息披露不足以排除捐赠者偏袒、内部人优势或公共资产被捕获的风险，并提出公共价值会计框架及多项透明度改革建议。
AI.research_question: 在SPR交换机制下，谁获得了石油、以何种条款、附带哪些限制、以及在储备被消耗期间产生了哪些可衡量的公共利益？
AI.motivation: SPR作为国家紧急安全资产，其大规模释放采用交换结构（私人企业先获得公共原油，日后归还并支付溢价），但现有信息披露不足以回答公共诚信的核心问题，存在捐赠者偏袒和公共资产捕获的风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共价值会计（Public-Value Accounting），用于评估SPR交换是否满足透明标准、是否存在政治关联企业获得优惠待遇、是否对商品交易商施加了反套利限制等。
AI.method: 规范性分析与治理框架构建，提出公共价值会计的多维度评估标准，并基于现有公开记录不足进行治理论证。
AI.findings: 当前公开记录不足以排除捐赠者偏袒、内部人优势或公共资产被捕获的可能性；SPR交换虽改善库存会计，但未回答公共诚信核心问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"公共价值会计"概念，将公共资产管理的评估标准从单纯的实物偿还扩展至透明度、政治关联、反套利、公共利益可衡量性等多维治理维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议建立SPR交换接收方级别的分类账、捐赠者冲突认证、反套利条件、国内消费者利益报告、GAO或监察长独立审查，以及要求国会授权才能将储备消耗至法定最低水平以下的战略底线。

title: Revitalising Britain with Self-Governing Cities

detail.title: Revitalising Britain with Self-Governing Cities
detail.abstract: Freeports have been promoted as a tool for attracting investment, boosting trade, and supporting regional economic growth. This policy paper examines the opportunities and challenges associated with freeport policies, moving beyond purely economic measures to consider their implications for governance, regulation, and public accountability. Drawing on liberal economic perspectives and contemporary debates on economic reform, the paper assesses whether freeports can deliver sustainable and inclusive development. It argues that their success depends not only on tax incentives and regulatory flexibility but also on strong institutions, transparency, and effective oversight. The paper concludes with recommendations to ensure that freeports contribute to long-term economic development while maintaining public trust and accountability.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了自由港政策在促进投资、贸易和区域经济增长方面的机遇与挑战，强调其成功不仅依赖于税收优惠和监管灵活性，更需要强大的制度、透明度和有效监督，以实现可持续和包容性发展。
AI.research_question: 自由港政策能否实现可持续和包容性发展？其成功的关键条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 自由港被推广为吸引投资和促进经济增长的工具，但现有分析多局限于经济层面，忽视了治理、监管和公共问责等更广泛的制度因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自由主义经济视角；经济改革相关当代论述
AI.method: 政策分析（政策论文/观点评论）
AI.findings: 自由港的成功不仅依赖税收优惠和监管灵活性，还需要强大的制度、透明度和有效监督；自由港要实现可持续和包容性发展，必须兼顾经济激励与治理质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自由港分析从纯粹经济维度拓展至治理、监管和公共问责等制度维度，丰富了自由港政策研究的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于自由港设计的建议，强调在税收与监管优惠之外，必须强化制度建设、透明度和监督机制，以维护公众信任和长期经济发展。

title: The Democratic Paradox: A Boolean Approach to Voted Legitimacy and its Application to Electoral System Design
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Democratic Paradox: A Boolean Approach to Voted Legitimacy and its Application to Electoral System Design

declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper identifies the "democratic paradox" as a systemic flaw in contemporary electoral systems, where legitimacy is presupposed as a scalar (100%) rather than treated as a Boolean type (True/False). Using set theory, it demonstrates that the current political offer is logically incomplete without the explicit option of conscious rejection (the "No Legitimacy" vote-NL). Redefining legitimacy as a voted Boolean value enables a single-round, de facto two-phase process: a primary referendum on system legitimacy and a secondary choice within accepted legitimacy. The proposed innovation is a dynamic parliament, whose capacity and mandate duration are scaled to the achieved legitimacy level. Analogous to game-theoretic breakthroughs like Fischer's clock and Chess 960, this model transforms passive abstention into an active political corrective mechanism. The result is rigorous selection of elites, unleashed creative potential of the sovereign people, and revitalization of democracy through a direct, reciprocal feedback loop between voters and governance architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现代选举制度存在"民主悖论"——将合法性预设为100%的标量而非布尔值。通过集合论证明，当前政治供给缺乏"拒绝授权"（NL）选项是不完整的。提出以布尔投票重新定义合法性，实现单轮双阶段投票：合法性公投+合法范围内的选择。创新点在于动态议会——其席位和任期随合法性水平动态调整。类比棋类规则革命，将被动弃权转化为主动政治矫正机制，最终实现精英筛选、主权激活与民主复兴。
AI.research_question: 如何通过重构投票机制解决现代民主制度中"合法性预设为100%"这一系统性缺陷？
AI.motivation: 现有选举制度将合法性视为必然成立的标量（100%），导致选民无法表达"拒绝授权"的立场，弃权票无法形成有效的政治反馈。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集合论（论证政治供给的不完备性）、布尔逻辑（合法性应取True/False而非标量）、博弈论类比（Fischer计时制、Chess 960）。
AI.method: 逻辑论证与形式化建模：利用集合论证明当前投票选项空间的不完备性，提出NL（No Legitimacy）选项填补逻辑缺口，设计动态议会机制作为制度创新。
AI.findings: 1. 合法性应定义为被投票的布尔值（True/False），而非默认标量。2. 单轮双阶段投票可自然实现。3. 动态议会的席位与任期与得票合法性正相关。4. 弃权可转化为主动否决机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将合法性的概念从预设标量重新界定为被投票生成的布尔值，为民主理论提供了更严谨的逻辑基础；引入集合论和布尔逻辑分析政治制度。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了可操作的投票制度创新（NL选项+动态议会），为解决选民疏离感、低投票率、政治精英固化等现实问题提供了制度设计方案。

title: Beyond Grade and Tonnage: AI-based Planning Considering Resource Economics and Sustainability
affiliations: , King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals (KFUPM), Stanford University and Stanford University

detail.title: Beyond Grade and Tonnage: AI-based Planning Considering Resource Economics and Sustainability
detail.abstract: The global energy transition requires increased production of critical minerals. However, selecting which target deposits to explore and subsequently to develop into active mines is a staged process: each exploration action generates new observations that reduce uncertainty and inform the next decision, whether to commit capital, delay, or abandon a target. Project viability is further constrained by socio-environmental factors that can also evolve as projects progress. Because decisions unfold incrementally, with each choice contingent on information from prior stages, this is inherently a sequential decision-making problem; we propose a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) framework to optimize mineral exploration and mine development strategies across multiple targets. Our model explicitly incorporates uncertainties in ore grade, tonnage, deposit depth, and commodity price, alongside a dynamic sustainability score that imposes escalating penalties when mining activities breach environmental and social license thresholds. By generating observations through exploration, the planner updates its belief state, weighing the value of new information against the options to proceed, delay, or abandon a target. We evaluate this belief-aware AI planner on synthetic multi-target scenarios, comparing its performance against a baseline AI planner that ignores early-stage sustainability metrics and a traditional multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) agent that strictly maximizes Net Present Value. The results demonstrate that the proposed planner optimally balances profitability and risk, actively avoiding severe sustainability penalties even at the cost of abandoning high-grade or high-tonnage targets. Ultimately, this framework provides a strategic tool for aligning economic objectives with environmental stewardship and social acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）的AI规划框架，用于优化多目标矿产勘探与矿山开发策略，该框架通过动态可持续性评分和环境-社会许可阈值，在不确定条件下平衡经济效益与可持续性风险，优于忽视可持续性的传统方法。
AI.research_question: 如何在不确定条件下，优化多目标矿产勘探与矿山开发的序贯决策，以同时实现经济收益最大化与社会环境可持续性？
AI.motivation: 全球能源转型对关键矿产需求激增，但矿产项目从勘探到开发涉及多阶段序贯决策，且面临矿石品位、储量、深度、价格等不确定性，以及社会环境许可的动态约束。现有方法未充分整合这些不确定性及可持续性指标的动态演化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）；序贯决策理论；可持续性评分（动态社会-环境许可证阈值）。
AI.method: 构建POMDP模型，将矿石品位、吨位、深度、价格等不确定性纳入信念状态更新；引入动态可持续性评分，对超出环境与社会许可阈值的行为施加递增惩罚；通过探索获取观测以更新信念，在推进、延迟、放弃之间优化选择；在合成多目标场景中，与忽视早期可持续性的基线AI规划者和仅最大化净现值的传统MCDM方法进行对比。
AI.findings: 所提出的信念感知AI规划者在平衡盈利能力和风险方面表现最优，能主动避免严重的可持续性惩罚，即使这意味着放弃高品位或高吨位的目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 将POMDP框架引入矿产勘探与开发的序贯决策领域，系统整合了多重不确定性与动态可持续性约束，拓展了决策理论在资源管理中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为矿业企业和政策制定者提供了战略性决策工具，能够在多目标场景中权衡经济效益与环境社会责任，推动矿产资源开发与全球能源转型目标的协调。

title: Structural Transformation and Female Labour Participation in Agriculture: Evidence from Mexico, 1900–2024

detail.title: Structural Transformation and Female Labour Participation in Agriculture: Evidence from Mexico, 1900–2024

declarations.funderStatement: I would like to thank the University of Guadalajara for the funding provided to conduct this research.

detail.abstract: This paper offers an in-depth analysis of female labour participation in Mexico's agricultural sector. Using probit regressions and microdata from labour force surveys between 2005 and 2019, it finds that women report a low likelihood of labour force participation in Mexico's agricultural regions. Notably, these results do not stem from any underestimation of women's agricultural work. This prompts a critical question: why is female labour participation so low in Mexican agriculture? Using data from the 2022 Mexican Agricultural Census and the Central Bank of Mexico, the research explores three potential mechanisms associated with low female labour participation in agriculture. First, a supply-side mechanism: the influx of remittances from Mexicans in the USA is lowering women's labour supply in rural areas. Second, a demand-side mechanism: the use of machinery in Mexican agriculture is reducing labour demand for female workers. Third, the draught-animal mechanism: if agricultural activities employ animal traction, they become male-dominated because of the upper-body strength required to control the animals. Nevertheless, the exploratory analysis shows that the low female labour participation in Mexican agriculture did not start recently as a consequence of any of these mechanisms. Instead, the paper documents Mexico's structural transformation from 1900 to 2024 and finds that the share of women in the agricultural workforce has been consistently low since the early twentieth century, when Mexico was still a predominantly agrarian economy. Therefore, the paper concludes that low female labour participation in Mexican agriculture is not a recent development but, rather, a persistent historical pattern.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Probit回归、劳动力调查微观数据、农业普查和央行数据，分析了1900-2024年墨西哥农业中女性劳动参与率持续偏低的现象，发现这并非近期因素（如汇款、机械化、畜力使用）导致，而是一个自20世纪初就已存在的长期历史模式。
AI.research_question: 为什么墨西哥农业部门的女性劳动参与率如此之低？
AI.motivation: 现有文献可能低估了女性农业劳动，但本文发现即便不存在低估问题，墨西哥农业女性参与率仍然很低，这促使作者探究背后的深层原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供给侧机制（汇款降低女性劳动供给）、需求侧机制（机械化减少对女性劳动力的需求）、畜力机制（使用动物牵引使农业工作男性化）。
AI.method: 采用Probit回归分析2005-2019年劳动力调查微观数据；利用2022年墨西哥农业普查和墨西哥央行数据探索三种机制；并利用1900-2024年的历史数据做结构性变迁分析。
AI.findings: 墨西哥农业女性劳动参与率偏低并非由汇款流入、机械化或畜力使用等近期因素导致；自20世纪初墨西哥仍以农业为主的时期起，女性在农业劳动力中的占比就一直处于低水平，这是一个长期的历史持续性模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"低估女性农业劳动"的主流解释，提出并验证了历史持续性视角；系统评估了三种可能的机制（汇款、机械化、畜力）并排除了其作为近期成因的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者，墨西哥农业女性劳动参与率低是一个根深蒂固的结构性问题，短期干预（如控制汇款或机械化）难以扭转，需从更长期的社会文化视角制定策略。

title: Is There a Social Stigma Against Working Wives?

detail.title: Is There a Social Stigma Against Working Wives?

declarations.funderStatement: I would like to thank the University of Guadalajara for the funding provided to conduct this research.

detail.abstract: Goldin (1994) argued that low female labour force participation rates (FLPRs) in middle-income countries like Mexico might be related to the expansion of industrial activities, combined with a strong social stigma against wives working in blue-collar jobs. This paper offers the first empirical evaluation of three interrelated hypotheses derived from this social stigma theory using Mexican labour force surveys from 2016-2019. Although Mexico has the highest share of industrial jobs in Latin America and one of the lowest FLPRs in the region, the negative association between marriage and female employment is not confined to blue-collar jobs. Instead, Mexican wives exhibit a homogeneous lower likelihood of working across agriculture, industry, formal services and informal services. An extension of this analysis finds that Mexican women consistently report a strong negative relationship between having a partner and working across different types of industries, white-collar activities, whitecollar occupations as well as high-skill and low-skill service jobs. The evidence also shows that marriage is one of the main reasons why women report having left their last job. Therefore, this paper challenges the social stigma hypothesis, since the results indicate that Mexican wives are consistently less likely to work than single women, regardless of whether it is a bluecollar or a white-collar job.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2016-2019年墨西哥劳动力调查数据，首次对Goldin（1994）提出的社会污名理论进行实证检验。研究发现，墨西哥已婚女性的低就业率并非如该理论所预测的那样仅局限于蓝领工作，而是在农业、工业、正式服务和非正式服务等所有行业以及白领、蓝领各类职业中普遍存在。婚姻是女性离职的主要原因之一。因此，本文挑战了社会污名假说。
AI.research_question: 墨西哥已婚女性的低劳动参与率是否如社会污名理论所预测的那样，主要源于对蓝领工作的社会污名？
AI.motivation: Goldin（1994）提出社会污名理论解释中等收入国家（如墨西哥）的低女性劳动参与率，但该理论从未得到严格的实证检验。墨西哥拥有拉丁美洲最高的工业就业占比和最低的女性劳动参与率之一，是检验该理论的理想情境。
AI.theoretical_framework: Goldin（1994）的社会污名理论：认为在中等收入国家，工业活动扩张与社会对已婚女性从事蓝领工作的污名化并存，导致女性劳动参与率偏低。
AI.method: 使用2016-2019年墨西哥劳动力调查数据，通过比较已婚女性与单身女性在不同行业（农业、工业、正式服务、非正式服务）、不同职业类型（蓝领、白领、高技能、低技能）中的就业概率差异，对三个相互关联的假设进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 1. 婚姻与女性就业的负相关关系并非仅限于蓝领工作，而是在农业、工业、正式服务和非正式服务等所有行业中一致存在。2. 墨西哥已婚女性在白领活动、白领职业以及高技能和低技能服务工作中均表现出更低的就业概率。3. 婚姻是女性报告离职的主要原因之一。这些发现挑战了社会污名假说。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对Goldin（1994）的社会污名理论进行系统性实证检验，并基于证据对该理论提出挑战，表明社会污名假说可能无法解释墨西哥已婚女性普遍偏低的劳动参与率。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了墨西哥女性劳动参与率低的关键障碍——婚姻本身而非特定行业污名，为制定针对性政策（如改善已婚女性的工作条件、提供育儿支持等）提供了实证依据。

title: Decentralization: the Search for a Legal Definition

detail.title: Decentralization: the Search for a Legal Definition
detail.abstract: Decentralization is the defining feature of decentralized finance, yet no legally workable definition of the concept exists. Regulatory instrumentsmost notably the MiCA Regulation-invoke decentralization as a threshold criterion for exemption from the regulatory perimeter, without specifying its content. Academic literature has developed sophisticated measurement tools, but these are inherently static and probabilistic, and cannot produce the binary determinations that legal qualification requires. This paper argues that the definitional gap is not a secondary problem: it is the root cause of the persistent uncertainty surrounding the regulatory treatment of decentralized protocols. Without a precise and verifiable definition, it is impossible to determine, in any concrete case, whether a given system qualifies as decentralized-and therefore whether the associated exemptions apply. To fill that gap, the paper proposes a legal definition built on three cumulative and verifiable criteria. The first is the presence of at least three independent decision-making centers-the minimum number that allows collective governance without degenerating into unilateral control or mutual veto. The second is the structural interdependence of participants within a protocol-governed framework, which distinguishes decentralized systems from traditional intermediated relationships. The third is the non-custodial nature of the infrastructure, understood as the structural renunciation of control over users' assets by any single entity. These three criteria are non-mathematical but operationally verifiable. They are cumulative: the absence of any one of them is sufficient to bring a system within the scope of traditional regulatory categories. Together, they provide a minimum normative threshold that is both theoretically grounded and practically applicable by regulatory authorities and courts.

AI.tldr: 本文指出DeFi缺乏可操作的法律定义，并提出基于三个累积性可验证标准（至少三个独立决策中心、协议治理下的结构互依性、非托管基础设施）的法律定义，以解决监管不确定性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个在监管和司法实践中可操作的去中心化法律定义？
AI.motivation: 尽管去中心化是DeFi的核心特征，但现有法律框架（如MiCA）将其作为监管豁免的门槛标准却未明确其内涵；学术测量工具是静态和概率性的，无法产生法律定性所需的二元判断。
AI.theoretical_framework: （1）去中心化的法律定义理论；（2）集体治理与决策中心理论（至少需三个独立中心以防止单边控制或相互否决）；（3）协议治理的结构互依性理论；（4）非托管基础设施理论。
AI.method: 规范分析法与理论构建法，结合现有法律监管框架（MiCA）与现实实践问题，提出三个累积性可验证标准。
AI.findings: 定义缺失是DeFi监管不确定性的根本原因；三个累积性标准（至少三个独立决策中心、协议治理下的结构互依性、非托管基础设施）可提供理论扎实且实践可行的最低规范性阈值。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了去中心化的法律定义空白，将抽象的"去中心化"概念转化为操作上可验证的法律标准，为监管豁免的二元判断提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和法院提供了可直接适用的判定标准：三个条件缺一不可，任一条件缺失即应纳入传统监管范畴，有助于解决MiCA等法规的适用模糊问题。

title:
Navigating Chokepoints: Reforming Force Majeure and
Hardship Frameworks in International Commercial Arbitration Amidst Geopolitical Maritime Disruptions

detail.title:
Navigating Chokepoints: Reforming Force Majeure and
Hardship Frameworks in International Commercial Arbitration Amidst Geopolitical Maritime Disruptions
detail.abstract: The contemporary architecture of international commerce remains profoundly dependent upon a limited number of maritime chokepoints whose uninterrupted operation underpins the stability of global supply chains. Recent geopolitical crises affecting the Suez Canal, the Bab-el-Mandeb Strait, and the Strait of Hormuz have exposed the fragility of this architecture by transforming localized security disruptions into systemic economic shocks. The resurgence of armed conflict, maritime attacks, state-sponsored interdictions, and strategic blockades has compelled commercial vessels to undertake lengthy diversions around the Cape of Good Hope, frequently increasing voyage durations by ten to fourteen days and generating substantial increases in fuel consumption, insurance premiums, freight rates, and delivery uncertainty. These developments have generated a fundamental legal dilemma within international commercial law: when contractual performance remains physically possible but becomes significantly more burdensome and economically distorted, should the resulting disruption be characterized as force majeure, hardship, or merely an ordinary commercial risk allocated to contracting parties? This paper argues that existing contractual frameworks remain inadequately equipped to address the realities of persistent geopolitical instability. Traditional force majeure doctrines operate through binary allocations of risk, excusing performance only when impossibility thresholds are satisfied, while hardship mechanisms remain inconsistently recognized across jurisdictions. The resulting legal gap leaves parties exposed to prolonged uncertainty and costly disputes. To address this deficiency, the paper proposes a Dynamic Risk-Apportionment and Automated Mitigation Clause (DRAAMC), a data-driven contractual mechanism designed to facilitate calibrated risk redistribution rather than wholesale contractual discharge. By integrating objective maritime indicators, automated cost-sharing formulas, and expedited arbitral procedures, the proposed framework seeks to preserve contractual equilibrium while strengthening commercial resilience. The paper contributes to contemporary debates concerning force majeure, hardship, and international commercial arbitration by advocating a transition from rigid binary doctrines toward adaptive legal architectures capable of responding to chronic geopolitical maritime disruptions.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，全球贸易高度依赖少数海上咽喉要道（如苏伊士运河、曼德海峡、霍尔木兹海峡），地缘政治危机已将局部安全事件转化为系统性经济冲击。现有合同法中的不可抗力与艰难情势原则无法有效应对持续性航线中断导致的履约成本激增问题。作者提出动态风险分摊与自动化缓解条款（DRAAMC），通过引入客观航运指标、自动成本分摊公式与快速仲裁程序，实现风险的弹性再分配，以维护合同均衡并增强商业韧性。
AI.research_question: 当海上航运因持续性地缘政治危机中断，导致合同履行虽物理上可能但经济负担显著加重时，该情形应被定性为不可抗力、艰难情势，还是普通商业风险？现有合同框架能否妥善应对这一新型挑战？
AI.motivation: 近年苏伊士运河、曼德海峡、霍尔木兹海峡等地缘政治危机频发，导致商业船舶需绕行好望角，航程延长10-14天，燃油费、保险费、运费大幅上升，交付不确定性激增。这种持续性、非突发性的中断引发了合同法领域的基础性困境，现有不可抗力与艰难情势条款均无法充分应对，暴露了法律架构的脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不可抗力原则（force majeure，二元风险分配逻辑，要求履行不可能）、艰难情势原则（hardship，救济门槛高且各国认可度不一）、国际商事仲裁理论、合同均衡理论、风险分配理论。
AI.method: 规范分析与制度设计：批判性审视现有不可抗力与艰难情势原则的不足，提出新型合同机制（DRAAMC）——一种数据驱动的动态风险分摊与自动化缓解条款，整合客观航运指标、自动成本分摊公式与快速仲裁程序。
AI.findings: 1. 现有的不可抗力原则采用二元（全有或全无）风险分配逻辑，要求履行达到不可能标准，无法适用于"可行但经济负担剧增"的情形；2. 艰难情势原则在不同法域中认可程度不统一，法律确定性不足；3. 上述法律空白使合同当事方暴露于长期不确定性和昂贵诉讼中；4. DRAAMC条款通过数据驱动的弹性机制，以校准的风险再分配替代全盘解除合同，能够更有效地维持合同均衡与商业韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 推动不可抗力和艰难情势理论从僵化的二元逻辑向适应性法律架构转型，为应对持续性地缘政治航运中断提供了新的理论工具；丰富了合同风险分配理论，引入动态、数据驱动的分析范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出可操作的DRAAMC条款设计，为国际商事合同的起草、谈判与争议解决提供具体方案；有助于降低因地缘政治航运中断引发的诉讼成本与商业不确定性，增强全球供应链的合约韧性。

title:
The Premium Student, The Discount Outcome

Credential Equality and Professional Exclusion in Western Graduate Labour Markets
affiliations: University of New South Wales (UNSW)

detail.title:
The Premium Student, The Discount Outcome

Credential Equality and Professional Exclusion in Western Graduate Labour Markets
detail.abstract: International students in Australia, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Canada arrive with academic credentials, technical competencies, and professional ambitions that are frequently comparable and, in many cases, superior to those of their domestic peers. Yet a persistent and reproducible gap in early career outcomes exists between these two cohorts. This paper argues that the disadvantage faced by international students is not incidental but is the product of deliberate institutional design. Universities across these four nations have constructed a model of international student recruitment that extracts enormous financial value from this cohort while systematically failing to deliver the career access and professional transition support that domestic students receive as a matter of course. This constitutes a form of institutionalised discrimination that is structurally embedded in recruitment pipelines, immigration policy frameworks, and social capital networks. This paper further introduces a three-segment analytical framework to identify which international students are most acutely harmed by this system. Drawing on labour market data, psychological literature on relative deprivation, and crosscountry employment outcomes research, the paper identifies students from medium to high income international households as the most structurally disadvantaged and least served cohort: too educated and professionally oriented to default to trade or manual labour pathways, yet too structurally excluded to penetrate the professional pipelines their credentials should qualify them for. This is the segment universities recruit most aggressively, charge most heavily, and support most inadequately. The paper concludes with a framework of targeted institutional reforms directed at universities, employers, and governments.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了国际学生面临的职业初期劣势并非偶然，而是大学、移民政策和社会资本网络构成的制度性歧视的结果。研究提出三阶段分析框架，指出中高收入家庭的国际学生是受伤害最深、最被忽视的群体——他们学历高、专业导向强，却被系统性地排除在职业通道之外。文章最后提出了针对大学、雇主和政府的改革建议。
AI.research_question: 为什么国际学生在职业初期的表现显著落后于本国同龄学生？这一劣势是否源于制度性设计而非偶然因素？
AI.motivation: 国际学生与本国学生在学术资质相当甚至更优的情况下，却存在持续且可复现的职业初期成果差距。这一现象在澳大利亚、美国、英国和加拿大四个主要留学目的国均普遍存在，具有跨国系统性特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度性歧视理论、相对剥夺心理学理论、社会资本网络理论、三阶段分析框架
AI.method: 跨国比较分析，整合劳动力市场数据、相对剥夺心理学文献和跨国就业成果研究，构建三阶段分析框架
AI.findings: 1）国际学生的职业劣势是制度性歧视的产物，嵌入在招生渠道、移民政策框架和社会资本网络中。2）中高收入家庭背景的国际学生是最受结构性伤害且最不被服务的群体：受教育程度和职业导向过高，无法退而求其次从事体力劳动；又因结构性排斥无法进入本应获得资格的专业职业通道。3）大学最积极招募恰恰是这个群体，收费最高且支持最不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 将国际学生职业劣势重新概念化为制度性歧视而非个体能力差异，提出三阶段分析框架以精准识别最受伤害的学生群体，丰富了相对剥夺理论在跨国教育情境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学、雇主和政府提供针对性的制度改革框架，以解决国际学生职业过渡支持的系统性缺失问题。

title: Artificial Intelligence in the Pharmaceutical Industry: Mapping Technological Trajectories Through Patent Citation and ShareholdingNetworks

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence in the Pharmaceutical Industry: Mapping Technological Trajectories Through Patent Citation and ShareholdingNetworks
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is a technology that has transformed the pharmaceuticalsector, yet how it is created, appropriated and controlled within the industry remainssparsely understood. This paper maps the incorporation of AI in pharmaceuticals bycombining two complementary network analyses on a single dataset: main path analysisof an AI-pharmaceutical patent citation network, and the corporate ownership (share-holding) network of the patent-holding firms. Grounded in a dynamic-capabilities andintellectual-monopoly framework, we build a citation network of 5,348 patents and6,054 citations (1974-2023) retrieved from PATSTAT through a keyword and IPC pro-tocol, weight its arcs with the Search Path Link Count, extract the most significanttrajectories with the key-route method, and overlay patent ownership and merger-and-acquisition (M&A) data from the Orbis database. The network is highly fragmented(985 components, the largest holding only 9.3% of patents), showing that AI diffusesinto many independent pharmaceutical niches rather than a single trajectory, and thata small set of central patents, not the largest portfolios, consolidate each trajectory.In the dominant trajectory, AI for diabetes treatment (1986-2021), pioneer central in-ventions are introduced by, or acquired by, the largest firms, while smaller specializedfirms drive incremental innovation before being absorbed, an ongoing concentrationconsistent with a transition to the specific phase of the life-cycle. Financial ownersact as indirect “knowledge intermediaries” linking competitors. Methodologically, inte-grating ownership networks into main path analysis offers a replicable way of tracinghow an emerging general-purpose technology is appropriated and monopolized, withimplications for innovation management and competition policy.

AI.tldr: 本文结合专利引文主路径分析与所有权网络分析，绘制了人工智能在制药行业中的创造、占有与控制格局，发现AI在制药领域呈现碎片化、多轨迹扩散，且大型企业通过收购主导了糖尿病治疗等关键轨迹，金融所有者充当了间接的“知识中介”。
AI.research_question: 人工智能在制药行业是如何被创造、占有和控制的？
AI.motivation: AI已深刻改变制药行业，但其在行业内部的创造、占有与控制机制尚缺乏系统理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论（dynamic-capabilities）与知识垄断框架（intellectual-monopoly framework）。
AI.method: 结合两种互补的网络分析：（1）基于关键词和IPC协议的PATSTAT专利数据（5,348项专利，6,054次引用，1974-2023年），使用Search Path Link Count加权弧段，采用关键路径法提取主要轨迹；（2）利用Orbis数据库的企业所有权（持股）与并购数据，整合专利持有企业的所有权网络。
AI.findings: （1）专利网络高度碎片化（985个组件，最大组件仅占9.3%专利），AI在制药行业呈多轨迹扩散而非单一路径；（2）每条轨迹由少数核心专利（而非最大专利组合）整合；（3）在主导轨迹（AI用于糖尿病治疗，1986-2021年）中，大型企业引入或收购先驱性核心发明，小型专业化企业在被收购前推动增量创新，呈持续集中趋势，符合生命周期向特定阶段过渡的特征；（4）金融所有者充当间接的“知识中介”，连接竞争企业。
AI.theory_contributions: 将所有权网络整合进主路径分析，为追踪通用目的技术的占有与垄断过程提供了可复制的分析方法，拓展了动态能力与知识垄断框架在AI与制药交叉领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创新管理与竞争政策提供实证依据，揭示了AI制药领域的知识流动与权力集中趋势，提示政策制定者关注小型创新企业被收购后的创新持续性以及金融资本对知识中介作用的影响。

title: Domain-Constrained Abstraction Learning for Interpretable Clinical Risk Prediction
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT University), affiliation not provided to SSRN and Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT University)

detail.title: Domain-Constrained Abstraction Learning for Interpretable Clinical Risk Prediction
detail.abstract: Predicting clinical risk from electronic health records (EHRs) is expected to enable personalised medicine and improve healthcare quality. However, relevant information in the EHRs is distributed across heterogeneous modalities, including laboratory measurements, clinical notes, medication orders, coded diagnoses, and social indicators. Many existing models pool all inputs into a single feature space and learn end-to-end. These approaches often achieve strong predictive performance, but they reinforce the common belief that improving model interpretability must reduce accuracy, a perceived transparency tax. This belief leads practitioners to choose black-box models, even in clinical settings where understanding the model's reasoning is essential. In this paper, we propose Domain-Constrained Abstraction Learning (DCAL), a modular prediction framework that routes clinically related inputs to dedicated specialist models. For each domain, constraints and feature definitions are derived through large language model (LLM)-guided clinical knowledge extraction. A meta-learner then integrates the resulting structured domain-level summaries to generate the final prediction. This framework produces an explicitly defined, fully inspectable prediction pathway, without relying on post-hoc explanation methods.We instantiate DCAL framework as an Interpretable Multi-Specialist Ensemble (IMSE) and evaluate it on all-cause unplanned 30-day readmission using 268,328 hospital admissions from MIMIC-IV. IMSE achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.73 on the temporal test set, with statistically significant improvements over both a monolithic multilayer perceptron (MLP; ΔAUC = +0.003, p = 0.037) and a monolithic gradient-boosted machine (GBM; ΔAUC = +0.003, p = 0.042). The specialists learn distinct internal representations (pairwise centred kernel alignment, CKA ≈ 0), and targeted input corruption reveals a clinically plausible hierarchy of domains (history ≫ pharmacy > laboratory). The resulting domain-specific summary features, such as severity tiers, organ dysfunction scores, and medication burden classes, depend on clinically coherent groupings that cannot be obtained through arbitrary feature decomposition. These results demonstrate that structuring intermediate representations by clinical domains preserves strong predictive performance while making model reasoning transparent and auditable at each stage of the pipeline. More broadly, findings suggest that correct clinical abstraction is the primary design objective, with competitive accuracy and transparency both emerging as consequences of that structure rather than as competing design goals.

AI.tldr: 提出Domain-Constrained Abstraction Learning (DCAL) 框架，通过将临床相关输入路由到专用专家模型，并在大语言模型引导下提取临床知识约束，实现了预测性能与可解释性的统一，打破了透明度税的传统认知。
AI.research_question: 如何在不牺牲预测准确性的前提下，构建一个可解释、可审计的临床风险预测模型？
AI.motivation: 电子健康记录中的信息模态异质性强，现有端到端黑箱模型虽预测性能好但牺牲了可解释性；临床场景中理解模型推理过程至关重要，但业界普遍认为解释性提升必然导致准确性下降（透明度税）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领域约束抽象学习（DCAL）；模块化预测框架；多专家集成学习；大语言模型引导的临床知识提取。
AI.method: 提出DCAL框架，实例化为可解释多专家集成模型（IMSE），利用LLM从临床指南中提取领域约束和特征定义，构建领域专用专家模型，再由元学习器整合领域级摘要进行最终预测。使用MIMIC-IV中268,328次住院数据进行30天全因非计划再入院预测评估。
AI.findings: IMSE在时间测试集上AUC达0.73，显著优于MLP（ΔAUC=+0.003, p=0.037）和GBM（ΔAUC=+0.003, p=0.042）。各专家学习到截然不同的内部表征（CKA≈0），领域重要性层次为：病史 > 药房 > 实验室。领域级摘要特征（如严重程度分层、器官功能障碍评分、用药负担等级）依赖于临床一致的聚类分组。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明预测准确性和透明度并非竞争目标，而是正确临床抽象（领域结构化）的共同产物；提出了一种可审计、可检查的预测路径设计范式，无需依赖事后解释方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床风险预测提供了一种兼顾高可解释性与高预测性能的实用框架，有助于提升临床信任度和模型部署可行性；展示了LLM在临床知识工程中的辅助应用价值。

title: Intergenerational Income Spillovers from Long-Term Care Insurance: Evidence from China
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics, Central University of Finance and Economics, Shandong Normal University and Central University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Intergenerational Income Spillovers from Long-Term Care Insurance: Evidence from China
detail.abstract: The accelerating global aging population has drawn increased attention to long-term care insurance policies. The potential spillover effects of these policies on labor supply and income distribution within insured households require further investigation. Using five waves of data (2011-2020) from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study, this study employs a staggered difference-in-differences model to examine the effects of LTCI policies on the labor supply of younger generations. The results show that the pilot LTCI policy increases labor force participation among younger generations by substituting informal family caregiving with formal social care services, thus facilitating positive intergenerational resource transfers. Moreover, heterogeneity analysis reveals a stronger redistributive effect in rural areas, low-income households, and families with incapacitated parents, highlighting the policy's role in promoting social equity. Additionally, mechanism analysis indicates that the policy boosts parental economic support for their children, thereby unlocking their labor potential, promoting household capital accumulation, and ultimately increasing children’s labor income. This study provides a micro-level framework for understanding how social security policies influence intra-household labor division decisions, offering practical insights into balancing the universality and precision of integrated social security systems.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2011-2020年中国健康与养老追踪调查数据，采用交错双重差分模型研究发现，长期护理保险试点政策通过以正式社会照护替代非正式家庭照护，显著提高了年轻一代的劳动力参与率，并促进了代际资源正向转移，尤其在农村、低收入家庭和失能老人家庭中具有更强的再分配效应。
AI.research_question: 长期护理保险政策如何影响参保家庭中年轻一代的劳动力供给？其内在机制和异质性效应如何？
AI.motivation: 全球人口老龄化加速背景下，长期护理保险政策的潜在溢出效应（对劳动力供给和收入分配的影响）尚未得到充分研究，需要进一步探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际资源转移理论、家庭劳动分工理论、社会保障政策的溢出效应理论
AI.method: 采用2011-2020年中国健康与养老追踪调查五期面板数据，使用交错双重差分模型（staggered DID）进行因果推断，并进行异质性分析和机制分析。
AI.findings: （1）长护险试点政策通过正式社会照护替代非正式家庭照护，提高了年轻一代的劳动力参与率；（2）政策在农村、低收入家庭和失能老人家庭中的再分配效应更强，促进了社会公平；（3）机制上，政策增加了父母对子女的经济支持，释放了子女的劳动潜力，促进家庭资本积累，最终提高了子女的劳动收入。
AI.theory_contributions: 从微观层面构建了社会保障政策如何影响家庭内部劳动分工决策的分析框架，丰富了代际资源转移和社会保险溢出效应的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平衡综合社会保障体系的普惠性与精准性提供了实践启示，为长护险政策的优化设计和推广提供了实证依据。

title: SmartMammoNet: A Hybrid Deep LearningFramework for Enhancement and Classification ofSmartphone-Captured Mammographic Images inTele-Radiology Applications
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: SmartMammoNet: A Hybrid Deep LearningFramework for Enhancement and Classification ofSmartphone-Captured Mammographic Images inTele-Radiology Applications
detail.abstract: The reliability of mammographic image quality is a prerequisite for early and accuratebreast cancer diagnosis, yet the proliferation of smartphone-based tele-radiology inresource-constrained environments introduces substantial challenges stemming from lowresolution capture, inconsistent illumination, and sensor noise. This paper presentsSmartMammoNet, a hybrid deep learning framework designed to address these challengesthrough an integrated pipeline of image enhancement and classification. The frameworkoperates on the Mini-MIAS dataset, where mammograms are re-captured from calibrateddisplay monitors using heterogeneous smartphone devices to simulate realistic teleradiology scenarios. The preprocessing pipeline incorporates Gaussian noise modelling,Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE), and a dedicated deeplearning-based denoising module, SmartMammo-Denoise, achieving a Peak Signal-toNoise Ratio (PSNR) of 62.61 dB—a statistically significant improvement overconventional median filtering (56.37 dB). The classification backbone integratesconvolutional layers with Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) attention blocks, residualconnections, and spatial attention mechanisms, enabling the model to selectively focus ondiagnostically relevant micro-structures such as masses and microcalcifications.SmartMammoNet attains a training accuracy of 98.7%, a validation accuracy of 96.4%, anda sensitivity of 95.8%, outperforming four established deep learning baselines.Comparative analysis confirms the superiority of the proposed approach in both imagefidelity and classification performance. These results establish SmartMammoNet as aclinically viable solution for mobile-based breast cancer screening in remote and lowresource healthcare settings.

AI.tldr: SmartMammoNet是一个混合深度学习框架，通过集成图像增强与分类流程，专门解决智能手机远程放射学中低分辨率、光照不均和传感器噪声导致的乳腺X线图像质量问题，在Mini-MIAS数据集上PSNR达62.61 dB，训练准确率98.7%，灵敏度95.8%，为资源匮乏环境下的移动乳腺癌筛查提供了临床可行的解决方案。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个混合深度学习框架，以有效解决智能手机远程放射学场景下乳腺X线图像质量退化问题，并实现可靠的乳腺癌分类诊断？
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的环境中，基于智能手机的远程放射学日益普及，但低分辨率采集、光照不均和传感器噪声严重影响了乳腺X线图像的可靠性，进而制约了乳腺癌的早期准确诊断。现有方法未能系统性地同时解决图像增强与分类这两个耦合问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合深度学习框架：集成高斯噪声建模、CLAHE预处理、专用深度学习降噪模块（SmartMammo-Denoise）、卷积层结合Squeeze-and-Excitation（SE）注意力机制、残差连接和空间注意力机制。
AI.method: 使用Mini-MIAS数据集，通过多种智能手机设备从校准显示器上重新采集乳腺X线图像以模拟真实远程放射学场景。预处理管线包括高斯噪声建模、CLAHE和SmartMammo-Denoise降噪模块。分类主干融合卷积层、SE注意力块、残差连接和空间注意力机制。与四种已有深度学习基线进行对比评估。
AI.findings: SmartMammoNet在PSNR上达到62.61 dB，显著优于传统中值滤波的56.37 dB；训练准确率98.7%，验证准确率96.4%，灵敏度95.8%，在图像保真度和分类性能上均优于四种基线模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将图像增强与分类任务深度融合的混合框架，验证了SE注意力机制与空间注意力机制在乳腺X线图像微结构（肿块、微钙化）特征提取中的有效性，为远程放射学图像质量退化问题提供了系统性的理论解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资源匮乏的偏远地区提供了一种基于智能手机的临床可行的乳腺癌筛查方案，显著提升了移动医疗场景下乳腺X线图像的诊断可靠性，有助于扩大乳腺癌早期筛查的可及性。

title: Domain-Constrained Abstraction Learning for Interpretable Clinical Risk Prediction
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT University), affiliation not provided to SSRN and Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT University)

detail.title: Domain-Constrained Abstraction Learning for Interpretable Clinical Risk Prediction
detail.abstract: Predicting clinical risk from electronic health records (EHRs) is expected to enable personalised medicine and improve healthcare quality. However, relevant information in the EHRs is distributed across heterogeneous modalities, including laboratory measurements, clinical notes, medication orders, coded diagnoses, and social indicators. Many existing models pool all inputs into a single feature space and learn end-to-end. These approaches often achieve strong predictive performance, but they reinforce the common belief that improving model interpretability must reduce accuracy, a perceived transparency tax. This belief leads practitioners to choose black-box models, even in clinical settings where understanding the model's reasoning is essential. In this paper, we propose Domain-Constrained Abstraction Learning (DCAL), a modular prediction framework that routes clinically related inputs to dedicated specialist models. For each domain, constraints and feature definitions are derived through large language model (LLM)-guided clinical knowledge extraction. A meta-learner then integrates the resulting structured domain-level summaries to generate the final prediction. This framework produces an explicitly defined, fully inspectable prediction pathway, without relying on post-hoc explanation methods.We instantiate DCAL framework as an Interpretable Multi-Specialist Ensemble (IMSE) and evaluate it on all-cause unplanned 30-day readmission using 268,328 hospital admissions from MIMIC-IV. IMSE achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.73 on the temporal test set, with statistically significant improvements over both a monolithic multilayer perceptron (MLP; ΔAUC = +0.003, p = 0.037) and a monolithic gradient-boosted machine (GBM; ΔAUC = +0.003, p = 0.042). The specialists learn distinct internal representations (pairwise centred kernel alignment, CKA ≈ 0), and targeted input corruption reveals a clinically plausible hierarchy of domains (history ≫ pharmacy > laboratory). The resulting domain-specific summary features, such as severity tiers, organ dysfunction scores, and medication burden classes, depend on clinically coherent groupings that cannot be obtained through arbitrary feature decomposition. These results demonstrate that structuring intermediate representations by clinical domains preserves strong predictive performance while making model reasoning transparent and auditable at each stage of the pipeline. More broadly, findings suggest that correct clinical abstraction is the primary design objective, with competitive accuracy and transparency both emerging as consequences of that structure rather than as competing design goals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DCAL框架，通过LLM引导的临床知识提取将EHR多模态数据按临床领域分流至专用模型，再通过元学习器整合结构化摘要进行预测。在MIMIC-IV上的30天再入院预测中，该方法在保持与黑箱模型相当的预测精度（AUC=0.73）的同时，实现了完全可解释的预测路径，打破了可解释性与准确性不可兼得的传统认知。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种既能保持高预测性能、又能提供完全可审计透明度的临床风险预测框架，从而打破"可解释性必须牺牲准确性"的认知？
AI.motivation: 现有EHR预测模型多将多模态数据混合输入单一特征空间进行端到端学习，虽然预测性能强，但牺牲了可解释性，导致从业者被迫选择黑箱模型。然而在临床场景中，理解模型推理过程至关重要。需要一种既能保持高性能、又无需依赖事后解释方法就能提供透明推理路径的预测框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领域约束抽象学习（DCAL）：将输入按临床领域分流至专用专家模型，每个领域通过LLM引导的临床知识提取生成约束和特征定义，元学习器整合领域级摘要进行最终预测。多专家集成模型（IMSE）作为DCAL的具体实例。
AI.method: 使用MIMIC-IV数据集（268,328次住院记录）进行全因非计划30天再入院预测。采用DCAL/IMSE框架，与多层感知机（MLP）和梯度提升机（GBM）两个黑箱基线模型对比。通过中心核对齐（CKA）评估领域表征差异，通过目标输入破坏分析领域重要性层级。
AI.findings: IMSE在时间测试集上达到AUC=0.73，显著优于MLP（ΔAUC=+0.003, p=0.037）和GBM（ΔAUC=+0.003, p=0.042）。各专家模型学习到几乎正交的内部表征（CKA≈0）。领域重要性层级为：病史 > 药房 > 实验室。生成的领域级摘要特征（如严重程度分级、器官功能障碍评分、药物负担等级）具有临床一致性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"正确的临床抽象是主要设计目标，准确性和透明性是其副产品"这一理论观点，挑战了可解释性与准确性是竞争目标的主流认知。2. 证明了通过临床领域结构化中间表征可以在不牺牲性能的情况下实现完全可审计的推理路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了DCAL/IMSE这一可直接部署的临床风险预测框架，兼具高性能与完全可解释性。2. 展示了LLM引导临床知识提取的实用方法。3. 通过领域重要性分析揭示了临床风险预测中不同信息源的实际权重（病史>药房>实验室），为临床决策支持系统设计提供指导。

title: Intrinsic Structural Relational Consistency and Region-Adaptive Supervision for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
affiliations: Zhongyuan University of Technology, Zhongyuan University of Technology, Zhongyuan University of Technology and Zhongyuan University of Technology

detail.title: Intrinsic Structural Relational Consistency and Region-Adaptive Supervision for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
detail.abstract: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) has shown promising results in 3D medical image segmentation by utilizing both labeled and readily available unlabeled images. However, most existing methods primarily focus on the supervision of label space, leaving the feature space insufficiently explored. Moreover, these methods often rely on pixel-level feature supervision and overlook the inherent contextual dependencies in the feature space. This limits their ability to perform fine segmentation on complex medical images. To address this limitation, we propose an Intrinsic Structural Relational Consistency (IRC) loss that constructs local affinity representations across multi-resolution feature spaces to explicitly capture hierarchical structural variations, achieving more refined segmentation performance. Furthermore, we introduce a Region-Adaptive Supervised Learning (ReAL) strategy. ReAL partitions the network predictions into consistent and inconsistent regions, dynamically applying tailored strategies to each region to facilitate more effective learning. Extensive experiments across three public datasets demonstrate that our method yields superior performance.

AI.tldr: 提出内在结构关系一致性损失（IRC）和区域自适应监督学习策略（ReAL），通过多分辨率特征空间的局部亲和表示和动态区域学习策略，提升半监督3D医学图像分割性能。
AI.research_question: 如何通过特征空间的显式结构建模和区域自适应学习，提升半监督3D医学图像分割的精细性能？
AI.motivation: 现有半监督3D医学图像分割方法主要关注标签空间的监督，对特征空间探索不足；且像素级特征监督忽略了特征空间中固有的上下文依赖关系，限制了复杂医学图像的精细分割能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 内在结构关系一致性（IRC）损失：构建跨多分辨率特征空间的局部亲和表示，显式捕获层级结构变化。2. 区域自适应监督学习（ReAL）策略：将网络预测划分为一致区域和不一致区域，动态应用定制化学习策略。
AI.method: 提出IRC损失函数和ReAL学习策略，在三个公开数据集上进行实验验证。
AI.findings: 所提方法在三个公开数据集上均取得了优越的分割性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出IRC损失，首次在多分辨率特征空间中通过局部亲和表示显式建模层级结构关系，弥补了特征空间监督的不足。2. 提出ReAL策略，根据预测一致性动态划分区域并差异化学习，丰富了半监督学习的方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 在3D医学图像分割任务上显著提升了分割精度，尤其适用于复杂医学图像场景，可降低对标注数据的依赖。

title: Cybersecurity Risk and Corporate Financial Policy: The Role of Product Market Competition
affiliations: Catholic University of Lille - IESEG School of Management, Maastricht University and University of Antwerp - Department of Accounting & Finance

detail.title: Cybersecurity Risk and Corporate Financial Policy: The Role of Product Market Competition
detail.abstract: We examine how firm-level cybersecurity risk influences corporate financial policy using a panel of close to 130,000 U.S. firm-quarter observations from 2002 to 2021. Firms facing greater cybersecurity risk maintain higher cash holdings on average, and especially so in highly competitive product markets. These findings are consistent with precautionary liquidity management and additionally reflect that competitive pressures amplify the financial consequences of potential cyber disruptions and can motivate larger cash buffers. We further observe that cybersecurity risk exposure is associated with lower capital expenditure on average, yet with higher investment in intangible capital; a finding that is also concentrated among firms operating in more competitive environments. Collectively, our evidence indicates that cybersecurity risk, intensified by market competition, has become a central determinant of corporate financial policy, driving firms toward higher liquidity and resilience-oriented investment strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了企业层面的网络安全风险如何影响公司财务政策。基于2002-2021年间近13万个美国公司季度观测数据，发现面临更高网络安全风险的企业持有更多现金，尤其是在高竞争产品市场中；同时，这些企业会减少资本支出但增加无形资本投资。网络安全风险已通过市场竞争的放大效应成为公司财务政策的核心决定因素。
AI.research_question: 企业层面的网络安全风险如何影响公司的财务政策（现金持有、资本支出、无形资本投资）？
AI.motivation: 随着数字化程度加深，网络安全威胁日益突出，但关于网络安全风险如何系统性地影响企业财务决策的实证证据有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预防性流动性管理理论；市场竞争加剧网络安全事件财务后果的理论逻辑。
AI.method: 基于2002-2021年近13万个美国公司季度观测数据的面板数据分析。
AI.findings: 1) 网络安全风险越高，企业现金持有量越高，且在竞争激烈市场中效应更强；2) 网络安全风险与资本支出负相关，但与无形资本投资正相关；3) 市场竞争放大了网络安全风险对财务政策的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将网络安全风险纳入企业财务政策的理论框架，揭示了市场竞争在放大网络安全风险财务影响中的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供网络安全风险管理与财务政策调整的实证依据；提示政策制定者关注竞争环境中网络安全风险的系统性影响。

title: How do state-owned shareholders curb stock manipulation
affiliations: Zhejiang Gongshang University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: How do state-owned shareholders curb stock manipulation
detail.abstract: Stock market manipulation has become a critical factor threatening the high-quality development of China’s capital market and harming the legitimate rights and interests of the general investing public. State-owned capital inherently functions as a “stabilizer” and “ballast” in the capital market. Whether its equity participation in private enterprises can help prevent market manipulation remains to be systematically examined. Taking non-financial private listed companies on China’s Shanghai and Shenzhen A-share markets from 2011 to 2021 as the research sample, this paper empirically examines whether the “reverse mixed-ownership reform”—state-owned capital acquiring equity stakes in private firms—helps curb stock market manipulation. The baseline results show that state-owned shareholders significantly reduces the severity of stock market manipulation in private enterprises. Mechanism tests reveal two mediating channels: state-owned shareholders curbs stock manipulation by restraining tunneling by large shareholders and by attracting greater analyst coverage, which in turn improves firms’ information transparency. Heterogeneity analyses show that the manipulation-deterring effect of state-owned shareholders is more pronounced for firms located in regions with weaker legal environments, and for firms characterized by affiliated shareholder relationships or boards with a lower proportion of independent directors—settings where monitoring and checks-and-balances are deficient. These findings suggest that attracting high-quality state investors, strengthening shareholder oversight, improving the quality of information disclosure, and refining the monitoring system for market manipulation can jointly advance the high-quality development of China’s capital market.

AI.tldr: 本文以2011-2021年中国沪深A股非金融民营上市公司为样本，实证检验国有资本参股民营企业（反向混改）能否抑制股票市场操纵行为。研究发现，国有股东显著降低了民营企业股价操纵的严重程度，主要通过抑制大股东掏空和吸引分析师关注、提升信息透明度两个渠道发挥作用。在法治环境较弱、存在关联股东关系、独立董事占比较低的企业中，这一抑制效应更为显著。
AI.research_question: 国有资本参股民营企业（反向混改）能否抑制股票市场操纵行为？其作用机制和异质性条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 股票市场操纵已成为威胁中国资本市场高质量发展和损害投资者权益的关键因素。国有资本天然具有资本市场"稳定器"和"压舱石"功能，但其参股民营企业能否帮助防范市场操纵尚缺乏系统检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国有资本治理功能理论、大股东掏空理论、信息不对称理论以及分析师中介理论，构建"国有股东参股—大股东掏空抑制/信息透明度提升—股价操纵减少"的分析框架。
AI.method: 以2011-2021年中国沪深A股非金融民营上市公司为研究样本，采用多元回归实证分析，通过中介效应检验机制路径，并进行异质性分析。
AI.findings: （1）国有股东显著降低了民营企业股票市场操纵的严重程度；（2）抑制作用通过两条中介路径实现：一是约束大股东掏空行为，二是吸引更多分析师跟踪以提升信息透明度；（3）在法治环境较弱的地区、存在关联股东关系以及独立董事占比较低的企业中，抑制效应更显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了"反向混改"经济后果的研究视角，从市场操纵这一新维度丰富了国有资本治理功能的理论认知，揭示了国有股东抑制股价操纵的微观机制路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为民营企业引入高质量国有投资者、强化股东监督、提升信息披露质量、完善市场操纵监控体系提供了政策启示，有助于推动中国资本市场高质量发展。

title: A Static Mean Field Game for Optimal Renewable Energy Investment
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Calgary - The School of Public Policy and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Static Mean Field Game for Optimal Renewable Energy Investment
detail.abstract: Mean Field Game (MFG) theory provides a mathematical framework for modeling the strategic behavior of a large number of interacting agents whose individual decisions are influenced by the aggregate behavior of the population. This framework is well-suited for studying decentralized investment decisions in competitive electricity markets, where the actions of individual wind farm developers collectively shape market outcomes.We develop a static MFG formulation for optimal wind energy capacity siting in Alberta, Canada. The revenue model for agents is based on the expected wind resource at a location and the covariance of this wind resource with other locations. Agents choose locations to maximize long-run revenue while accounting for spatial correlations in wind resource availability. Spatial wind dependence is incorporated through an empirically calibrated covariance structure, combining a PCA-based component estimated from historical weather station data with a parametric residual kernel, to capture variability across locations.The equilibrium investment problem can be formulated as a quadratic program, which we solve for four policy scenarios that progressively restrict the feasible siting area, incorporating viewscape and transmission constraints beyond a baseline of minimal siting restrictions. These policy and infrastructure-driven land use restrictions are represented as constraints on the agents' action space, allowing us to examine their economic implications through a comparison of the MFG equilibria across policy scenarios. Our findings highlight the trade-off between regulatory land-use objectives and economic efficiency in the use of renewable energy resources in the short and long term, and provide quantitative insights into how policy design shapes the spatial distribution and financial performance of wind investments. The static MFG formulation could be used to inform electricity system planning including, transmission planning and renewable energy development planning.

AI.tldr: 本文利用静态均值场博弈（MFG）框架，对加拿大阿尔伯塔省的风电容量选址问题建模，分析了四种政策场景下土地使用限制对风电投资空间分布和经济效率的影响，揭示了监管目标与经济效率之间的权衡关系。
AI.research_question: 在竞争性电力市场中，土地使用限制（如景观保护、输电约束）如何影响大量风电开发商分散化选址决策的均衡结果？不同政策场景下，土地使用限制与可再生能源经济效率之间的权衡关系如何？
AI.motivation: 大规模风电开发面临政策与基础设施约束（如景观保护、输电限制），但传统模型难以刻画大量分散决策者之间的策略互动。MFG框架能有效建模大量同质代理人的战略行为及其与人口聚合状态的相互影响，适合分析此类问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 均值场博弈（MFG）理论；空间相关性收益模型（基于PCA与残差核函数的协方差结构）；静态二次规划均衡求解。
AI.method: 利用历史气象数据构建PCA与残差核函数结合的协方差结构；将均衡选址问题转化为二次规划求解；设计四种政策场景（从最小限制到逐步加入景观和输电约束），比较MFG均衡结果。
AI.findings: 土地使用限制在保护景观和引导选址方面有效，但会降低风电投资的经济效率；政策限制改变了风电项目的空间分布和财务绩效；短期与长期之间存在权衡——严格限制可能短期提升局部效率，但长期可能抑制整体资源利用效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 将MFG理论应用于可再生能源选址这一新场景；提出结合PCA与残差核函数的协方差结构以刻画空间风能相关性；将政策约束形式化为MFG中的行动空间限制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电力系统规划（尤其是输电规划和可再生能源发展规划）提供定量分析工具；帮助政策制定者理解土地使用限制的经济代价，辅助平衡环保目标与经济效率。

title: Exploiting UHVDC Tie-Line Flexibility in Real-Time Scheduling of Large-Scale Renewable Energy Base Transmission System
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology and Huazhong University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Exploiting UHVDC Tie-Line Flexibility in Real-Time Scheduling of Large-Scale Renewable Energy Base Transmission System

keywords: Large-scale renewable energy base transmission system

detail.abstract: The stochastic optimal operation of the large-scale renewable energy base transmission system (LS-REBTS) plays a vital role in reliable power supply and efficient renewable energy utilization. This paper focuses on exploiting the flexibility of the ultra-high-voltage direct current (UHVDC) tie-line in real-time scheduling of LS-REBTS. Firstly, a benchmark LS-REBTS scheduling model adopting an experience-based UHVDC tie-line transmission plan is established. Then, a UHVDC tie-line flexibility model is constructed accounting for the limited power adjustment frequency and contracted day-ahead inter-regional trading energy. Next, a decoupled feasible boundary projection method considering the power maintaining property is proposed to reformulate the full-horizon daily energy transmission constraint, enabling the UHVDC tie-line flexibility to be fully exploited in real-time sequential decision-making. To effectively cope with uncertainties, an approximate dynamic programming (ADP) algorithm with categorized update (ADP-CU) is proposed to solve the scheduling model. Incorporating the prior-period UHVDC power as a feature state, the algorithm innovatively employs a categorized piece-wise linear function (PLF) update method that captures the distinct marginal values related to adjustable and non-adjustable periods. By embedding empirical knowledge during offline training, the ADP-CU algorithm achieves near-optimal real-time scheduling of LS-REBTS. Finally, numerical simulations on a practical LS-REBTS demonstrate the validity of the proposed scheduling model and the superiority of the ADP-CU algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种考虑UHVDC输电线路灵活性的大型可再生能源基地输电系统随机优化调度方法，并设计了带分类更新的近似动态规划算法（ADP-CU）来应对不确定性，实现近乎最优的实时调度。
AI.research_question: 如何利用UHVDC输电线路的灵活性，在大型可再生能源基地输电系统的实时调度中实现随机最优运行？
AI.motivation: 大型可再生能源基地输电系统的随机最优运行对可靠供电和高效利用可再生能源至关重要，但现有方法未能充分挖掘UHVDC输电线路的灵活性潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: UHVDC输电线路灵活性模型（考虑功率调整频率限制和日前跨区域交易合同约束）；解耦可行边界投影方法（考虑功率维持特性）；近似动态规划与分类更新方法（ADP-CU）。
AI.method: 建立基准调度模型；构建UHVDC灵活性模型；提出解耦可行边界投影方法重构全天能量约束；设计带分类更新的ADP算法（以先期UHVDC功率为特征状态，采用分类分段线性函数更新方法）。
AI.findings: ADP-CU算法通过在离线训练中嵌入经验知识，实现了大型可再生能源基地输电系统的近乎最优实时调度；实际算例验证了调度模型的有效性和算法的优越性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了UHVDC输电线路灵活性模型及解耦可行边界投影方法，将全天能量约束转化为适合实时序贯决策的形式；创新性地设计了基于分类PLF更新的ADP算法，区分了可调与非可调时段的不同边际价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大型可再生能源基地输电系统的实时调度提供了可操作的优化方法，提升了UHVDC输电线路的灵活利用和可再生能源消纳效率。

title: The Environmental and Distributive Consequences of Vaca Muerta in Neuquén
affiliations: Universidad Nacional de La Plata (UNLP)

detail.title: The Environmental and Distributive Consequences of Vaca Muerta in Neuquén
detail.abstract: Several studies have examined the economic impacts of hydrocarbon production in the Argentine province of Neuquén, home to Vaca Muerta, the country’s largest unconventional hydrocarbon field. All of these studies highlight significant positive effects on both regional and national GDP and employment levels. However, none of these studies has assessed the potential distributional and environmental consequences of Vaca Muerta within a consistent methodological framework. To address this gap, we employ a sequential macro-micro approach that combines a computable general equilibrium model with microsimulations. The macro model provides a consistent macroeconomic framework for analyzing the complex interactions among sectors and agents under resource and market constraints, whilst the micro model analyzes the impacts on labor supply and household income. We find that the development of Vaca Muerta could significantly increase the province’s level of economic activity and reduce poverty by nearly 21 percentage points between 2025 and 2040. However, GHG emissions would increase by 60% over the same period. Policies aimed at improving the energy efficiency of household consumption could reduce the increase in GHG emissions, but only marginally and at the household level. In contrast, greater reductions in GHG emissions can be achieved by introducing a carbon tax. These results could serve as a basis for developing just transition strategies for the development of Vaca Muerta.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了阿根廷内乌肯省Vaca Muerta非常规油气田开发的经济、分配和环境效应，发现其虽能显著降低贫困，但也会导致温室气体排放大幅增加，而碳税比家庭能效提升更能有效减排。
AI.research_question: Vaca Muerta油气开发对内乌肯省的经济分配效应和环境后果是什么？不同的政策干预（家庭能效提升 vs. 碳税）如何影响减排效果？
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅关注Vaca Muerta对GDP和就业的积极影响，缺乏在一致方法论框架下对其分配效应和环境后果的系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可计算一般均衡模型（CGE）与微观模拟的序贯宏观-微观方法，结合资源约束与市场约束下的跨部门与跨主体交互分析。
AI.method: 采用序贯宏观-微观方法：宏观层面使用CGE模型分析部门间与主体间复杂互动，微观层面使用微观模拟分析劳动力供给与家庭收入变化。
AI.findings: （1）2025-2040年间，Vaca Muerta开发可显著提升内乌肯省经济活动水平，贫困率降低近21个百分点；（2）同期温室气体排放增加60%；（3）家庭能效提升政策仅能微弱减少排放，且仅限于家庭层面；（4）碳税可带来更大程度的减排效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 在一致方法论框架下首次综合评估非常规油气开发的分配效应与环境后果，填补了现有研究仅关注经济总量效应的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Vaca Muerta开发制定公正转型策略提供了政策依据，表明碳税比家庭能效提升更有效，有助于平衡经济增长与减排目标。

title: State-Adaptive Conformal Recalibration for Reliable Probabilistic Wind Power Forecasting in Renewable Energy Applications
affiliations: University of KwaZulu-Natal, University of KwaZulu-Natal and University of KwaZulu-Natal

detail.title: State-Adaptive Conformal Recalibration for Reliable Probabilistic Wind Power Forecasting in Renewable Energy Applications
detail.abstract: Short-term wind-power forecasts support renewable-energy scheduling, reserve planning and grid operation, but point forecasts alone do not quantify the uncertainty surrounding future wind generation. This paper develops the SAFER framework, a Seasonality-Adaptive Forecast Error Recalibration approach for reliable probabilistic wind-power forecasting under state-dependent forecast uncertainty. The framework combines hourly Eskom wind-generation data from 1 April 2019 to 11 February 2024 with ERA5 meteorological predictors extracted over South African wind-resource corridors. A regional linear-regression model is used as a transparent point forecaster, after which a conformal recalibration layer estimates forecast-error quantiles by season, intraday period and generation state. Forecasts are evaluated at 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour horizons using point-forecast accuracy measures, empirical coverage, interval width, coverage error, Winkler scores, Diebold--Mariano tests and moving-block bootstrap confidence intervals. The regional meteorological design improves point forecasts relative to persistence, seasonal-naive, hourly-climatology and random-forest benchmarks. For 90% prediction intervals, SAFER improves empirical coverage at every horizon and reduces coverage error relative to global conformal prediction. The strongest calibration result occurs at the 3-hour horizon, where empirical coverage reaches 0.8996 against a 0.9000 target. Moving-block bootstrap validation confirms statistically significant coverage gains. Since the recalibration layer is applied after point forecasting, SAFER is model-agnostic and can be attached to linear, machine-learning or deep-learning forecasters without changing the underlying forecasting model. The results show that state-adaptive conformal recalibration provides a computationally lightweight way to improve probabilistic reliability while maintaining operationally useful interval widths.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SAFER框架，一种季节自适应预测误差重新校准方法，通过结合气象数据和状态自适应共形预测，实现可靠的概率风电功率预测。该方法在多个预测时域上显著提升了预测区间的经验覆盖率和可靠性，且模型无关、计算轻量。
AI.research_question: 如何实现可靠的概率风电功率预测，以量化不确定性并支持可再生能源调度和电网运行？
AI.motivation: 点预测无法量化未来风电生成的不确定性，而现有概率预测方法在状态依赖的预测不确定性下可靠性不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 季节自适应预测误差重新校准（SAFER）框架；共形预测（Conformal Prediction）；状态依赖的不确定性建模。
AI.method: 结合Eskom风电数据与ERA5气象预测因子，使用区域线性回归模型作为点预测器，然后通过共形校准层按季节、日内时段和发电状态估计预测误差分位数。评估指标包括点预测准确性、经验覆盖率、区间宽度、覆盖率误差、Winkler分数、Diebold-Mariano检验和移动块自助法置信区间。
AI.findings: 区域气象设计改进了点预测表现；SAFER在90%预测区间下各时域均提高了经验覆盖率并降低了覆盖率误差；3小时时域校准效果最佳，经验覆盖率达0.8996（目标0.9000）；移动块自助法验证了统计显著的覆盖率提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了状态自适应共形重校准方法，证明了在点预测后附加共形校准层可以显著提升概率预测的可靠性，且该方法模型无关。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种计算轻量、可附加于现有风电预测系统的概率校准方法，有助于提升可再生能源调度和电网运行决策的可靠性。

title: A PINN-VAE framework for adversarial generation of extreme operating scenarios in hydro–wind–solar complementary systems: A case study of the entire Yalong River Basin
affiliations: Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, Zhejiang University - College of Electrical Engineering, Beijing Institute of Technology and North China Electric Power University

detail.title: A PINN-VAE framework for adversarial generation of extreme operating scenarios in hydro–wind–solar complementary systems: A case study of the entire Yalong River Basin
detail.abstract: To address the scarcity of historical samples for extreme operating scenarios under high renewable energy penetration and the limited ability of traditional scenario generation methods to identify high-risk tail scenarios, this paper proposes a climate-conditioned adversarial scenario generation framework based on a dual-latent physics-informed variational autoencoder (PINN-VAE). Daily mean runoff and temperature are used as conditional variables, while the latent space is decoupled into a data latent space for learning historical statistical patterns and a physical latent space for capturing physical boundary features. A differentiable physical projection layer is further embedded to achieve physical constraints, thereby enhancing the physical consistency of the generated scenarios. On this basis, a multi-dimensional grid stress function is constructed, covering max ramp rate, power shortage risk, hydro compensation demand, simultaneous low wind–solar output, net-load variability, and peak shaving demand. Gradient-based adversarial search is then performed in the latent space to identify physically feasible high-stress tail scenarios. A case study of the Yalong River hydro–wind–solar complementary base shows that the proposed method improves the comprehensive stress index by 166% to 226% compared with Monte Carlo, K-means and other methods, while maintaining good physical feasibility and multi-seed stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于双潜藏物理信息变分自编码器（PINN-VAE）的气候条件对抗场景生成框架，通过解耦数据潜藏空间和物理潜藏空间，并嵌入可微物理投影层，实现了物理一致的高风险尾场景生成。以雅砻江水电-风电-光伏互补基地为例，该方法相比蒙特卡洛、K-means等方法，综合应力指标提升了166%至226%，同时保持了良好的物理可行性和多种子稳定性。
AI.research_question: 如何在高可再生能源渗透率下，解决极端运行场景历史样本稀缺以及传统场景生成方法识别高风险尾场景能力有限的问题？
AI.motivation: 高可再生能源渗透率下极端运行场景的历史样本稀缺，且传统场景生成方法难以有效识别高风险尾场景，亟需一种能够生成物理可行的高风险场景的新方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双潜藏物理信息变分自编码器（PINN-VAE）、物理信息神经网络（PINN）、变分自编码器（VAE）、对抗生成思想、物理约束投影层。
AI.method: 构建气候条件对抗场景生成框架：以日均径流和温度为条件变量；解耦潜藏空间为数据潜藏空间（学习历史统计规律）和物理潜藏空间（捕捉物理边界特征）；嵌入可微物理投影层实现物理约束；构建多维网格应力函数（涵盖最大爬坡率、缺电风险、水电补偿需求等6个维度）；在潜藏空间进行基于梯度的对抗搜索，找出物理可行的高应力尾场景。
AI.findings: 在雅砻江水电-风电-光伏互补基地案例中，该方法在综合应力指标上比蒙特卡洛、K-means等方法提升166%至226%，且具有良好的物理可行性和多种子稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了双潜藏空间解耦的PINN-VAE架构，将物理约束嵌入生成式模型的潜藏空间，为物理一致的高风险场景生成提供了新的理论范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高可再生能源渗透率电力系统提供了有效的极端场景生成工具，有助于提升系统在极端运行条件下的风险评估和应急响应能力。

title: Machine Learning for Power Systems: A Critical Review Bridging the Interpretability and Performance Gap
affiliations: Universidad del Valle, Universidad del Valle and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Machine Learning for Power Systems: A Critical Review Bridging the Interpretability and Performance Gap
detail.abstract: Modern power systems are becoming increasingly decentralized, data-rich, and operationally complex, which has accelerated the adoption of machine learning for forecasting, monitoring, protection, control, and decision support. However, existing review articles remain fragmented across methods, application domains, or governance perspectives, offering limited cross-domain analysis of how performance gains interact with interpretability requirements and deployment constraints. This review advances the position that appropriate ML model selection in power systems is a multi-criteria decision jointly constrained by predictive performance, transparency requirements, operational criticality, latency tolerance, and validation-stage readiness and that this balance is irreducibly application-dependent. This paper presents a critical review of 168 papers published between 2022 and 2026, organized through a three-dimensional taxonomy jointly covering ML paradigm families, power-system application domains, and domain-specific interpretability requirements. The literature is examined through the lenses of methodological diversity, operational relevance, validation realism, and deployment readiness. A central contribution is a domain-specific operational framework that maps task criticality, operator involvement, latency tolerance, and validation maturity to minimum explanation requirements, XAI family suitability, and expected deployment-stage readiness. The analysis shows that the acceptable balance between interpretability and performance is strongly application dependent, with greater transparency demands in safety-critical and operator-facing tasks. The review also highlights the limited evidence of deployment-oriented validation in much of the current literature and identifies priorities for more trustworthy and application-aware integration of machine learning in power systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过168篇文献的批判性综述，提出电力系统中机器学习模型选择需要同时考虑预测性能、可解释性、运行关键性、延迟容忍度和验证成熟度等多重标准，并构建了一个三维分类框架（ML范式族、应用领域、领域特定可解释性需求）以及一个面向运行的实操框架，揭示了可解释性与性能之间的平衡高度依赖具体应用场景。
AI.research_question: 在电力系统日益分散化、数据密集化和运行复杂化的背景下，如何在不同应用领域中平衡机器学习模型的预测性能与可解释性需求，以及这种平衡如何受到部署约束的影响？
AI.motivation: 现有综述文章在方法、应用领域或治理视角上存在碎片化问题，缺乏对性能提升、可解释性需求与部署约束之间跨领域交互作用的系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三维分类学（ML范式族、电力系统应用领域、领域特定可解释性需求）+ 面向运行的实操框架（任务关键性、操作者参与度、延迟容忍度、验证成熟度 → 最小解释需求、XAI家族适用性、预期部署阶段准备度）。
AI.method: 对2022–2026年间168篇论文进行批判性综述，通过三维分类学组织文献，并从方法多样性、运行相关性、验证真实性和部署准备度四个维度进行审视。
AI.findings: 可解释性与性能之间的可接受平衡强烈依赖于应用场景，安全关键型和面向操作者的任务对透明度的要求更高；当前文献中部署导向的验证证据有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个跨领域的系统性分析框架，将ML模型选择重新定义为多准则决策问题，并建立了应用特征与可解释性需求之间的映射关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电力系统从业者提供了面向具体应用场景的模型选择指南，明确了不同任务类型对可解释性的最低要求、XAI模型适用性以及预期部署准备度，有助于推动更可信、更贴合实际应用的ML集成。

title: Data-Driven Aging Characterization of Lead-Acid Batteries in Real Photovoltaic Installations Using Multi-Domain Time-Series Analysis". No other changes have been made to the manuscript
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Data-Driven Aging Characterization of Lead-Acid Batteries in Real Photovoltaic Installations Using Multi-Domain Time-Series Analysis". No other changes have been made to the manuscript
detail.abstract: Accurate characterisation of battery aging in real-world photovoltaic installations remains a key challenge for energy management and predictive maintenance. This study presents a multi-domain feature extraction framework applied to a four-year discharge voltage dataset (2017–2020) from 12 individual cells of a Valve-Regulated Lead-Acid (VRLA) battery array operated in collaboration with Sunlight Group. Five complementary analytical methods are applied independently to each cell: Hurst exponent analysis via Rescaled Range (R/S) statistics, Pearson cross-correlation with anomaly detection, Spectral Activity Index (SAI) analysis, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network prediction, and a five-method entropy suite comprising Sample Entropy (SampEn), Approximate Entropy (ApEn), Spectral Entropy (SpEn), Permutation Entropy (PermEn), and Multiscale Entropy (MSE), synthesised into an Entropy Complexity Index (CI). The CI increases by 137.7% from 2017 to 2018, indicating a synchronised degradation regime shift independently corroborated by all three non-entropy methods. LSTM models achieve R2 > 0.90 for 10 out of 12 cells; residual spectral entropy identifies cells with unmodelled degradation structure. The concurrent increase in Sample Entropy and collapse of Permutation Entropy, observed consistently across all 12 cells, is referred to as the dual entropy fingerprint of lead-acid battery aging. The extracted feature vector serves as input to a composite Health Score and Remaining Useful Life estimator, which will be reported in a companion paper currently under preparation by the same authors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多域特征提取框架，基于2017-2020年12个VRLA电池的放电电压数据，结合Hurst指数、Pearson相关性、光谱活动指数、LSTM预测及五种熵方法（综合为熵复杂度指数CI），发现CI从2017到2018增加137.7%，并识别出铅酸电池老化的"双熵指纹"（样本熵增加与排列熵崩溃）。
AI.research_question: 如何准确刻画光伏系统中铅酸电池的实时老化特征？
AI.motivation: 真实光伏场景下电池老化表征是能源管理与预测性维护的关键挑战，现有方法难以全面捕捉老化过程的复杂动态特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: Hurst指数（R/S重标极差分析）、Pearson互相关与异常检测、光谱活动指数（SAI）、LSTM神经网络、五方法熵套件（样本熵SampEn、近似熵ApEn、光谱熵SpEn、排列熵PermEn、多尺度熵MSE）综合为熵复杂度指数（CI）。
AI.method: 对12个VRLA单电池2017-2020年放电电压数据，独立应用五种互补分析方法：Hurst指数、Pearson互相关、SAI、LSTM预测、五熵合成CI指数。通过多域特征交叉验证发现退化模式。
AI.findings: 1) CI指数从2017到2018增加137.7%，指示同步退化状态转变，被三种非熵方法独立证实；2) LSTM模型对10/12个电池R²>0.90，残差光谱熵可识别未建模退化结构；3) 所有12个电池一致出现样本熵上升与排列熵崩溃，称为铅酸电池老化的"双熵指纹"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"双熵指纹"概念，揭示铅酸电池老化过程中样本熵与排列熵的同步反向变化规律；构建多域特征交叉验证框架，增强老化模式识别的可靠性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为光伏系统中VRLA电池的健康状态评估与剩余寿命预测提供特征提取基础；多域分析方法可推广至其他类型电池及分布式储能系统的智能运维。

title: A bi-level Stackelberg-Nash hybrid game for low-carbon dispatch of heterogeneous integrated energy systems: a knowledge-driven multi-objective optimization and DRO approach
affiliations: Wuhan University of Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Wuhan University of Technology, Wuhan University of Technology, Wuhan University of Technology and Wuhan University of Technology - School of Automation

detail.title: A bi-level Stackelberg-Nash hybrid game for low-carbon dispatch of heterogeneous integrated energy systems: a knowledge-driven multi-objective optimization and DRO approach
detail.abstract: With the growing penetration of distributed renewable energy sources, the cooperative operation of heterogeneous multi-energy microgrids faces interest conflicts, energy transmission barriers, and renewable volatility risks, posing major challenges to day-ahead low-carbon dispatch of integrated energy systems(IES). To address these issues, a bi-level Stackelberg-Nash hybrid game framework is proposed for hierarchical multi-microgrids, which integrates vertical price guidance and horizontal Nash bargaining aligned with the system topology. At the upper level, the microgrid operator (MGO) as the leader optimizes retail pricing strategies via a knowledge-driven adaptive multi-objective differential evolution (KD-MODE) algorithm. At the lower level, follower microgrids form a coalition integrating an electricity–hydrogen–gas–carbon coupled chain and peer-to-peer (P2P) energy sharing networks. The data-driven Wasserstein distance-based distributionally robust optimization(W-DRO) model is developed for coalition dispatch, with profits settled via Nash bargaining. Numerical case studies based on real-world data show that full-link multi-energy coupling and P2P sharing mechanism exploit dispatch flexibility, achieving eco-friendly operation and reducing the total expected operating cost by 14.23%. Concurrently, The bilevel game equilibrium generates the significant cooperative surpluses, enhancing overall system economics while ensuring fair gains for all IESs. Furthermore, the W-DRO model achieves an optimal trade-off between operational security and economic performance, and the KD-MODE algorithm delivers a Pareto front with superior convergence, uniformity and boundary coverage, and improves computational efficiency by 11%. This study provides solid theoretical support for low-carbon energy markets and delivers an energy-efficient decision-making paradigm for the refined operation of decentralized, multi-player integrated energy systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种双层Stackelberg-Nash混合博弈框架，用于解决多微电网协同低碳调度中的利益冲突、能源传输障碍和可再生能源波动风险问题，通过实验验证了该方法在降低成本、提升经济性和计算效率方面的有效性。
