title: Simulating Spatio-Temporal Hydrodynamics in Tidal Rivers: A Bayesian Optimized Hybrid LSTM-PINN Framework
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Simulating Spatio-Temporal Hydrodynamics in Tidal Rivers: A Bayesian Optimized Hybrid LSTM-PINN Framework
detail.abstract: Accurate and computationally efficient hydrodynamic modeling of macro-tidal estuaries is critical for environmental impact assessments and long-term forecasting under climate change scenarios. This study introduces a hybrid Long Short-Term Memory and Physics-Informed Neural Network (LSTM-PINN) to simulate the complex spatiotemporal hydrodynamics in tidal rivers. Driven by upstream fluvial discharge and downstream tidal harmonics, the model is physically regularized by the 1D Saint Venant Equations (SVEs). The framework automates the determination of optimum hyper-parameters and loss weights through Bayesian optimisation. Evaluated against in-situ sensors and TELEMAC numerical simulations on the experimental tidal reach in Seine Estuary (France), the optimised LSTM-PINN framework achieved high predictive accuracy (0.04 m < RMSE < 0.17 m, KGE > 0.94) for longitudinal water surface elevations during training (2010–2018) and holdout forecasting periods (2019–2020). Furthermore, the physics-constrained architecture demonstrated robust capabilities in missing data imputation and successfully derived physically consistent, macro-scale velocity fields. Hyperparameter optimization via the Optuna framework highlighted the necessity of treating the 1D SVEs as soft regularizers. Down-weighting the stiff momentum loss prevented the model from overfitting to the structural limitations of 1D depth-averaged assumptions of SVEs, with raw bathymetry. Furthermore, SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) feature attribution confirmed that the model learned the hydrodynamic relationships, heavily prioritizing the latent historical context of LSTM and downstream tidal boundaries over upstream fluvial discharge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合LSTM-物理信息神经网络（LSTM-PINN）框架，用于潮汐河流的水动力建模。该模型由上游河川流量和下游潮汐谐波驱动，并通过一维圣维南方程进行物理正则化。在塞纳河河口试验河段上，该框架实现了高精度水位预测（RMSE 0.04-0.17 m，KGE>0.94），具备缺失数据插补和速度场推导能力。超参数优化表明，一维圣维南方程作为软正则化器使用时需降低动量损失权重以避免过拟合。SHAP特征归因揭示了模型优先利用LSTM历史上下文和潮汐边界条件而非上游流量。
AI.research_question: 如何将LSTM深度学习与物理信息神经网络相结合，实现对宏观潮汐河口复杂时空水动力的高精度、高效率建模？
AI.motivation: 宏观潮汐河口的水动力建模对于环境影响评估和气候变化情景下的长期预测至关重要，但传统数值模型计算成本高，而纯数据驱动模型缺乏物理一致性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合LSTM-物理信息神经网络（LSTM-PINN）；一维圣维南方程（SVEs）作为软物理正则化器；贝叶斯优化超参数调优；SHAP特征归因解释。
AI.method: LSTM-PINN混合模型，以上游河川流量和下游潮汐谐波为驱动，以一维圣维南方程为物理约束，采用Optuna框架进行贝叶斯超参数优化；在塞纳河河口试验河段，以原位传感器和TELEMAC数值模拟为基准进行验证。
AI.findings: ①优化后的LSTM-PINN在训练期（2010-2018）和预测期（2019-2020）均实现了高精度水位预测（RMSE 0.04-0.17 m，KGE>0.94）；②模型具备稳健的缺失数据插补能力和物理一致的大尺度速度场推导能力；③超参数优化揭示一维SVEs应作为软正则化器，降低动量损失权重可避免模型过拟合于一维水深平均假设的结构局限；④SHAP归因显示模型优先学习LSTM历史上下文和下游潮汐边界，而非上游河川流量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了LSTM-PINN混合框架用于潮汐水动力建模，验证了物理信息神经网络中一维圣维南方程作为软正则化器的有效性，揭示了物理约束权重设置对模型性能的关键影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观潮汐河口提供了高精度、计算高效的水动力建模工具；具备缺失数据插补能力，可应用于实际监测数据不完整场景；SHAP可解释性分析增强了模型在工程应用中的可信度。

title: Optimizing Greenhouse Energy and Microclimate Control Under Harsh Climates Using a Quantum PSO Algorithm

detail.title: Optimizing Greenhouse Energy and Microclimate Control Under Harsh Climates Using a Quantum PSO Algorithm
detail.abstract: As global food security becomes increasingly critical due to population growth and climate change, greenhouses play a vital role in producing high-quality crops in controlled environments. This paper aims to develop and implement an advanced and comprehensive energy management platform based on the Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization (QPSO) algorithm that is capable of performing specialized monitoring and control services for smart greenhouses. The control platform comprises communication-assisted decision-making and control modules developed and tuned for heterogeneous power distribution systems that accommodate renewable energy generators, HVAC, energy storage device, pumps, water reservoir CO2 injector, dehumidifier, smart meters, and sensors. The main objective is to formulate and implement a dynamic nonlinear QPSO (NQPSO) framework embedded in a predictive model to optimally control the operation of the greenhouse and manage the power flow, ensuring highly efficient use of energy. The framework aims to ensure optimal conditions for crop growth by accurately regulating indoor microclimate variables while minimizing energy exchange with the grid during periods of low renewable energy generation, thus ensuring efficient operation. The predictive NQPSO framework is compared with classical optimization Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Pyomo with Ipopt as a solver through extensive numerical simulations, demonstrating its superior performance and effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于量子粒子群优化（QPSO）算法的智能温室能源管理平台，通过动态非线性QPSO框架预测模型优化温室运行与能量流，在保证作物最佳生长环境的同时最大限度减少与电网的能量交换，仿真验证其优于传统PSO和Pyomo求解器。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种基于QPSO算法的智能温室能源管理平台，以在调控室内微气候变量以实现作物最优生长的同时，最大限度地降低与电网的能量交换，实现高效能源利用？
AI.motivation: 全球人口增长和气候变化使得粮食安全日益严峻，温室在可控环境中生产高质量作物至关重要。现有能源管理方法在应对异构配电系统和多设备协同控制方面存在局限，亟需更先进的优化框架以提升能源效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 量子粒子群优化（QPSO）算法；动态非线性QPSO（NQPSO）预测模型；经典粒子群优化（PSO）算法；Pyomo优化建模语言及Ipopt求解器。
AI.method: 提出NQPSO框架嵌入预测模型，以动态非线性方式优化温室运行与控制功率流；通过广泛的数值仿真，将NQPSO与经典PSO及Pyomo（Ipopt求解器）进行对比验证。
AI.findings: NQPSO框架在温室能源管理中的性能优于经典PSO和Pyomo（Ipopt求解器），能够更有效地调节室内微气候、降低与电网的能量交换，实现更高的能源利用效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 将量子粒子群优化算法应用于温室能源管理领域，并进一步提出了动态非线性QPSO（NQPSO）框架，丰富了智能优化算法在农业能源系统中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个集通信辅助决策与控制模块于一体的综合能源管理平台，可实际部署于智能温室，协同管理可再生能源发电机、HVAC、储能设备、水泵、CO2注入器、除湿机等多种设备，提升温室运营的能源效率与经济性。

title: Multi-Branch Horizontal Well Closed-Loop Geothermal System Multi-Objective Optimization and Economic Feasibility Analysis
affiliations: Liaoning Petrochemical University, Liaoning Petrochemical University, Xinjiang Oilfield Company, Xinjiang Oilfield Company, Xinjiang Oilfield Company and Xinjiang Oilfield Company

detail.title: Multi-Branch Horizontal Well Closed-Loop Geothermal System Multi-Objective Optimization and Economic Feasibility Analysis
detail.abstract: To efficiently develop deep geothermal resources, a novel multi-branch horizontal well closed-loop geothermal system (MBHW-CLGS) was proposed. The proposed design effectively expands the formation heat exchange area by optimizing the wellbore structure. The working fluid velocity within the branches was reduced to prolong the heat exchange time, thereby improving the heat extraction and economic performance of the system. A three-dimensional unsteady-state heat transfer model was established to verify the advantages of MBHW-CLGS. In this model, outlet temperature, heat extraction power, power generation, and levelized cost of energy (LCOE) were selected as evaluation criteria. The results indicated that the power generation of the proposed system was 3.803 and 1.411 times that of the traditional U-shaped and horizontal well CLGS, respectively, while the LCOE decreased by 67.94% and 16.32%, respectively. Then, the effects of the number of horizontal branches, branch well spacing, branch well diameter, volumetric flow rate, injection temperature, and geothermal gradient on the heat extraction and economic performance of the system were investigated. The influence of working fluid transport, flow distribution, and internal flow velocity on heat exchange within the multi-branch system was clarified. In summary, the multi-branch horizontal well configuration displayed significant advantages in closed-loop geothermal development, providing a theoretical reference for the structural design and parameter optimization of deep hot dry rock geothermal projects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型多分支水平井闭路地热系统（MBHW-CLGS），通过优化井身结构扩大换热面积、降低分支内工质流速以延长换热时间，从而提升取热性能和经济性。三维非稳态传热模型验证表明，该系统发电量分别是传统U形和水平井CLGS的3.803倍和1.411倍，平准化能源成本（LCOE）分别降低67.94%和16.32%。研究还探讨了分支数量、间距、直径、流量、注入温度和地温梯度等因素的影响，为干热岩地热项目设计提供了理论参考。
AI.research_question: 多分支水平井闭路地热系统（MBHW-CLGS）相比传统U形和水平井闭路地热系统，在取热性能和经济性方面能否实现显著提升？
AI.motivation: 深层地热资源的开发效率亟待提升，传统闭路地热系统存在换热面积有限、换热时间不足等瓶颈，亟需通过创新井身结构设计来提高地热开采的经济性和可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三维非稳态传热模型；闭路地热系统热交换理论；平准化能源成本（LCOE）经济性评价方法。
AI.method: 建立三维非稳态传热模型，以出口温度、取热功率、发电量和LCOE为评价指标，对比MBHW-CLGS与传统系统的性能差异，并进行多参数敏感性分析（分支数量、间距、直径、流量、注入温度、地温梯度）。
AI.findings: （1）MBHW-CLGS发电量分别为传统U形和水平井CLGS的3.803倍和1.411倍；（2）LCOE分别降低67.94%和16.32%；（3）阐明了多分支系统中工质输送、流量分配和内部流速对换热的影响机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了多分支水平井结构对闭路地热系统换热性能的增强机理，阐明了分支参数与工质流动特性对取热效率的影响规律。
AI.practical_contributions: 为深层干热岩地热项目的井身结构设计和参数优化提供了理论依据和工程参考，有助于降低地热发电成本、提高开发经济性。

title: An MDMHP-Based Framework for Estimating Cascading Dam-Break Probability and Life Loss Subject to Maximum Check Floods
affiliations: Beijing University of Technology, Beijing University of Technology, Beijing University of Technology, Beijing University of Technology, China Institute of Water Resources and Hydropower Research (IWHR) - State Key Laboratory of Simulation and Regulation of Water Cycle in River Basin, Beijing University of Technology, Beijing University of Technology, Beijing University of Technology and Beijing University of Technology

detail.title: An MDMHP-Based Framework for Estimating Cascading Dam-Break Probability and Life Loss Subject to Maximum Check Floods
detail.abstract: Climate change intensifies Maximum Check Flood (MCF) occurrence frequency, threating the cascade reservoir systems in the river basin. However, few studies have quantified the breach risk and casualties in short-distance cascade floods formed by upstream large dams and downstream small dams. This study developed the MDMHP system, integrating Monte Carlo simulation, the DB-IWHR model, the Muskingum model, the HEC-RAS model, and the PG-TCANet-LTD surrogate model, preserving the physical causal chain from inflow to downstream response. Parameter quantification was performed through Sobol analysis, with Monte Carlo sampling applied to highly sensitive parameters; the DB-IWHR, Muskingum, and HEC-RAS models executed full-process physical simulations; the PG-TCANet-LTD surrogate model was trained to enable batch two-dimensional inundation simulations, achieving 93.6% consistency in flood prediction and increasing single two-dimensional simulation speed by 3000 times; spatial grid-based statistics were used to assess death risk probabilities under three warning scenarios. Applied to the Changhe Dam-Huangjinping cascade flood, the downstream breach probability after upstream overtopping reached 99.7%; expected casualties decreased from 5,816 without warning to 2,500 with a 0.5-hour warning, and further dropped to 541 with a 1-hour warning, representing a reduction of over 90% compared to no warning. This framework addresses quantification challenges and provides support for for the risk management of cascading dam-break floods in cascade reservoir systems.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了MDMHP系统，集成多种模型用于量化气候变化下梯级水库溃坝风险与人员伤亡，以长河坝-黄金坪梯级洪水为案例，发现上游溃坝后下游溃决概率达99.7%，提前1小时预警可减少90%以上预期伤亡。
AI.research_question: 如何量化气候变化下梯级水库（上游大坝-下游小坝）的溃坝风险与人员伤亡？
AI.motivation: 气候变化加剧了最大检验洪水发生频率，威胁梯级水库系统安全，但现有研究很少量化短距离梯级洪水的溃坝风险与人员伤亡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 蒙特卡洛模拟、DB-IWHR模型、马斯京根模型、HEC-RAS模型、PG-TCANet-LTD替代模型
AI.method: 通过Sobol分析进行参数定量，对高敏感参数进行蒙特卡洛采样；DB-IWHR、马斯京根、HEC-RAS执行全过程物理模拟；训练PG-TCANet-LTD替代模型实现批量二维淹没模拟（预测一致性93.6%，速度提升3000倍）；基于空间网格统计评估三种预警情景下的死亡风险概率。
AI.findings: 应用于长河坝-黄金坪梯级洪水：上游漫顶后下游溃决概率达99.7%；无预警时预期伤亡5816人，0.5小时预警降至2500人，1小时预警降至541人（减少超90%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了从入库到下游响应的完整物理因果链量化框架，解决了梯级水库溃坝风险与伤亡量化难题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为梯级水库系统溃坝洪水风险管理提供了量化工具支持，验证了提前预警对降低人员伤亡的显著效果。

title: A Hierarchical Deep Q-Learning Approach for Picker Routing in Two-Block Warehouses
affiliations: Oklahoma State University, Prince of Songkla University, Prince of Songkla University and Oklahoma State University

detail.title: A Hierarchical Deep Q-Learning Approach for Picker Routing in Two-Block Warehouses
detail.abstract: Order picking represents the vast majority of total warehouse operating expenses, with picker travel distance comprising the dominant cost component. Exact algorithms solve the single-block picker routing problem in linear time, and polynomial-time methods exist for two-block warehouses, but these methods must be re-executed from scratch for every new pick list. Heuristic policies avoid these limitations but at the cost of solution quality. This paper proposes a hierarchical Double Deep Q Network (DDQN) framework for picker routing in two-block warehouses. The framework decomposes the problem into two levels: within-aisle traversal costs are obtained in closed form, and a neural network learns a global aisle-sequencing policy over a compact aisle-level Markov Decision Process with state space (𝑁 ⋅ 2^{4𝑁}), where 𝑁 is the number of aisles. The agent selects macro-actions that specify the target aisle-block pair and one of three traversal actions (Return, Through, or Gap), each corresponding to a classical routing heuristic. Hard action masking enforces warehouse feasibility by construction, which removes the need for penalty-based workarounds and speeds up training. We evaluate the framework on a full factorial set of 30 two-block warehouse configurations spanning 5 to 30 aisles and pick lists of 30 to 90 items, with 30 replications each. Across all configurations, the learned policy produces shorter routes than the better of the S-shape and largest-gap heuristics, by 3.0% to 15.4%, and stays within roughly 1% to 10% of the exact two-block dynamic-programming optimum. The gap to the optimum grows gradually with aisle count and pick list size, while the advantage over the heuristics persists across the full range of layouts and order densities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分层双深度Q网络（DDQN）框架，用于解决双块仓库的拣货路径规划问题。该框架将问题分解为两层：通道内行走成本通过闭式解获得，神经网络则学习全局通道排序策略。在30种仓库配置上的实验表明，该方法的路径长度比S形和最大间隙启发式算法短3.0%至15.4%，与精确最优解的差距约为1%至10%。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种高效的启发式强化学习方法，在双块仓库中实现接近最优的拣货路径规划，同时避免精确算法每次需从头计算以及传统启发式算法解质量不高的局限？
AI.motivation: 订单拣选是仓库运营的主要成本来源，其中拣货员行走距离占比最大。虽然单块仓库的拣货路径已有线性时间精确算法，双块仓库也有多项式时间方法，但这些方法每次面对新拣货列表都必须重新计算。启发式策略虽避免了这一限制，但解的质量较差。因此，需要一种既能快速适应新任务又能保持较高解质量的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层强化学习（Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning）、双深度Q网络（DDQN）、马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）；将拣货路径问题分解为通道内成本求解（闭式解）和通道间排序决策（强化学习）两个层级。
AI.method: 提出分层DDQN框架：底层通过闭式解计算通道内的三种遍历策略（Return、Through、Gap）的行走成本；上层构建紧凑的通道级MDP（状态空间为𝑁⋅2^{4𝑁}），神经网络学习选择目标通道-块对及相应的遍历动作。采用硬动作掩码确保仓库可行性约束。在30种仓库配置（5至30条通道、30至90个品项）上进行全因子实验评估。
AI.findings: 在所有配置下，学习到的策略生成的路由比S形和最大间隙启发式中更好的那个短3.0%至15.4%；与精确的双块动态规划最优解差距约为1%至10%；差距随通道数量和拣货列表规模增加而逐渐扩大，但相对于启发式算法的优势在所有布局和订单密度下持续存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将分层强化学习框架系统性地应用于双块仓库拣货路径问题；提出了一个紧凑的通道级MDP表示，将状态空间压缩至𝑁⋅2^{4𝑁}；引入硬动作掩码机制确保仓库可行性，避免惩罚函数带来的训练不稳定问题；将经典的启发式遍历策略（Return、Through、Gap）作为宏动作，实现了理论启发式知识与深度强化学习的有效融合。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可实际部署的拣货路径规划方法，在保证接近最优路径质量的同时避免了精确算法的重新计算开销；该方法的路径质量显著优于常用的S形和最大间隙启发式算法，可直接降低仓库运营成本；框架适用于不同规模（5-30条通道）和订单密度的仓库，具有良好的通用性。

title: Proposing the Best Alternatives for Environmental Pollution (Fine Particle and Noise) Control Due to Development Activities
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Proposing the Best Alternatives for Environmental Pollution (Fine Particle and Noise) Control Due to Development Activities
detail.abstract: Rapid urbanization and infrastructural development in developing nations have significantly escalated fine particulate matter (PM₂.₅) and noise pollution, posing severe public health and environmental challenges. Although various mitigation strategies exist, empirical evaluations of their cost-effectiveness and performance under tropical, real-world conditions remain limited. This study presents a field-based, dual-pollutant assessment conducted at the Khulna University of Engineering & Technology (KUET) campus, Bangladesh, an active institutional construction site housing approximately 8,100 residents. Data was collected over 30 pre-monsoon working days in April–May 2024. Real-time PM₂.₅ and noise levels were monitored across five scenarios: an uncontrolled baseline and four mitigation conditions (water application, screen installation, tree buffer, and motor vehicle control). Structural equation modeling (SEM) identified dump trucks, mixer trucks, and bulldozers/excavators as dominant PM₂.₅ drivers, with relative humidity serving as the primary meteorological amplifier. Baseline PM₂.₅ (mean: 206.10 µg/m³) exceeded WHO guidelines (15 µg/m³) more than thirteen-fold. Water application achieved the greatest short-term PM₂.₅ reduction (43.98%; Cost-Effectiveness Ratio = 16.16 USD/%reduction), while tree buffer planting had the lowest CER (70.49 USD/%reduction/year), due to efficiencies, the study suggests water application for both short and long term as effective control measures. For construction noise (mean: 77.3 dB), regression analysis identified the drill/cutting machine as the sole statistically significant source (β = 5.24, p < 0.001). Pathway-level acoustic enclosures consistently delivered the best noise cost-effectiveness across both short- and long-term scenarios (CER = 7.47 USD/%reduction). These findings provide a directly applicable, evidence-based framework for sustainable construction management in developing-world institutional and urban settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究在孟加拉国KUET校园建筑工地进行了实地双污染物评估，发现基线PM₂.₅（均值206.10 µg/m³）超标WHO标准13倍以上，洒水是最具成本效益的PM₂.₅控制措施（成本效益比16.16美元/%减排），而通道级隔音围护是噪声控制的最优方案（成本效益比7.47美元/%减排）。
AI.research_question: 在热带发展中国家实际建设条件下，不同缓解策略对PM₂.₅和噪声污染的成本效益及表现如何？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家快速城市化和基础设施建设导致PM₂.₅和噪声污染严重，但针对热带真实条件下缓解策略的成本效益实证评估十分有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构方程模型（SEM）识别污染源驱动因素；回归分析识别噪声源；成本效益分析评估不同缓解策略的经济有效性。
AI.method: 2024年4-5月（30个季风前工作日）在KUET校园建筑工地现场采集实时PM₂.₅和噪声数据；设置一个未控制基线场景和四种缓解条件（洒水、屏幕安装、树木缓冲带、机动车控制）；采用结构方程模型和回归分析进行统计建模。
AI.findings: 1) 自卸卡车、搅拌车和推土机/挖掘机是PM₂.₅主要驱动源，相对湿度是主要气象放大因素；2) 基线PM₂.₅均值206.10 µg/m³，超标WHO标准13倍以上；3) 洒水短期PM₂.₅减排效果最佳（43.98%），成本效益比16.16 USD/%减排；4) 树木缓冲带年成本效益比70.49 USD/%减排；5) 施工噪声均值77.3 dB，钻/切割机是唯一统计显著噪声源（β=5.24）；6) 通道级隔音围护在短期和长期均实现最佳噪声成本效益（7.47 USD/%减排）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家热带环境下的建筑工地双污染物（PM₂.₅+噪声）成本效益评估提供了首个系统性实地证据框架，验证了不同缓解策略在真实条件下的相对效能排序。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议洒水作为PM₂.₅短期和长期的有效控制措施，通道级隔音围护作为噪声控制最优方案，为发展中国家机构和城市环境的可持续施工管理提供了可直接应用的成本效益框架。

title: A Multi-Objective Energy-Efficient and Integrity-Aware Resource Management Framework for Cloud Computing
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Charotar University of Science and Technology

detail.title: A Multi-Objective Energy-Efficient and Integrity-Aware Resource Management Framework for Cloud Computing
detail.abstract: Cloud computing is now a pillar in the paradigm of the provision of scalable and on-demand computing services, but due to the quick increase in the provision of cloud infrastructures, the issues associated with energy consumption and data integrity have become a concern. The other primary issue with the existing resource management strategies is that they either address the aspect of energy efficiency or security, but not the trade-off between the two important goals. To combat this drawback, the paper presents a new multi-objective and energy efficient and integrity sensitive resource management system to a cloud computing environment. It is proposed to combine the three architectural items, which are energy-aware scheduling, monitoring of integrity, and machine learning-based workload prediction. The mathematical model is built in order to maximally reduce the energy usage and data security risk, and meet the resource capacity and Service Level Agreement (SLA) requirements. The integrity-aware resource management algorithm will be created to allocate resources dynamically and do virtual machine consolidation and minimize unnecessary migrations without jeopardizing system security. The framework will be tested on the Cloud Sim simulation environment and the input workload traces of Google Cluster in the real world. According to experimental findings, the offered methodology yields a considerable decrease in energy usage (around 20–30%) and reduced the overhead of integrity validation and enhanced the use of the CPU and adherence to SLA. In addition, the framework is highly scaled and adaptable to the changing workload conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向云计算环境的多目标资源管理框架，通过融合能量感知调度、完整性监控和机器学习工作负载预测，在降低能耗（20-30%）的同时保障数据安全与SLA合规性。
AI.research_question: 如何在云计算资源管理中同时优化能源效率与数据完整性，实现两者间的有效权衡？
AI.motivation: 现有资源管理策略要么关注能效，要么关注安全，缺乏同时兼顾两者的方案，无法有效应对能效与安全之间的权衡问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多目标优化理论、能量感知调度、完整性监控机制、机器学习工作负载预测模型、资源容量与SLA约束理论。
AI.method: 提出完整性感知的资源管理算法，实现动态资源分配与虚拟机整合；采用Cloud Sim模拟环境及Google Cluster真实工作负载轨迹进行实验验证。
AI.findings: 该框架在能耗上降低了20-30%，减少了完整性验证开销，提高了CPU利用率和SLA遵从度，且具有良好的可扩展性与对动态工作负载的适应性。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了能效与数据完整性联合优化的多目标理论模型，为云资源管理中的安全-能效权衡问题提供了新的解决思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为云服务提供商提供了一套可实际部署的资源管理方案，能在保障数据安全的同时显著降低运营成本和能耗。

title: Primal-Dual Reinforcement Learning for Constrained Maintenance Planning in Assembly Lines with Replacement by Second-Hand Equipment
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Primal-Dual Reinforcement Learning for Constrained Maintenance Planning in Assembly Lines with Replacement by Second-Hand Equipment
detail.abstract: The European market for second-hand industrial machinery is growing, yet many machines are underused or discarded prematurely. These second-hand machines with uncertain degradation levels have higher failure risks, and many manufacturers are hesitant to adopt them. In serial production systems, a single machine failure can halt the entire line, leading to substantial economic losses. This paper addresses the challenge of integrating second-hand machines into multi-machine maintenance and replacement planning while ensuring system reliability. We formulate a Markov decision process that captures stochastic machine degradation, discrete maintenance and replacement actions, and system-wide failure probabilities. To handle the resulting constrained problem, we develop a conservative approximation of the probabilistic failure constraint that enables the decomposition of the global problem into per-machine subproblems. Building on a primal-dual constrained MDP framework, we propose an algorithm that efficiently updates both per-machine policies and Lagrange multipliers, with theoretical guarantees on convergence and constraint satisfaction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach scales to up to 100 machines and outperforms a deep Q-network baseline by achieving faster convergence and systematically maintaining failure-rate constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在串行生产系统中，如何将存在退化不确定性的二手设备整合到多设备维护与更换规划中。通过构建马尔可夫决策过程模型，并开发基于拉格朗日松弛的保守近似方法，实现了大规模问题的有效分解与求解，实验证明该方法在100台设备规模下仍能高效运行并满足故障率约束。
AI.research_question: 如何在确保系统可靠性的前提下，将退化状态不确定的二手设备整合到多设备串行生产系统的维护与更换规划中？
AI.motivation: 欧洲二手工业设备市场不断增长，但许多设备被闲置或过早报废。二手设备退化水平不确定、故障风险更高，制造商对其使用持谨慎态度。在串行生产系统中，单台设备故障会导致整条生产线停工，造成巨大经济损失。因此需要开发能够处理二手设备整合问题的维护与更换规划方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）；约束马尔可夫决策过程（Constrained MDP）；原始-对偶优化框架；拉格朗日松弛与分解
AI.method: 构建马尔可夫决策过程模型，刻画随机退化、离散维护/更换动作及系统级故障概率。对概率故障约束进行保守近似，实现全局问题向单机子问题的分解。基于原始-对偶约束MDP框架，提出同时更新单机策略和拉格朗日乘子的算法，并给出收敛性与约束满足的理论保证。通过大规模实验（最多100台设备）与深度Q网络基线方法进行对比验证。
AI.findings: 所提算法可扩展至100台设备规模；与深度Q网络基线相比，收敛速度更快，并能系统性维持故障率约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了针对二手设备整合的约束MDP建模方法；开发了基于保守近似的约束松弛与问题分解技术；提供了原始-对偶算法的收敛性与约束满足性理论保证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制造业企业提供了在串行生产系统中有效整合二手设备的决策支持工具；有助于延长设备使用寿命、减少资源浪费，推动循环经济；可扩展至大规模设备系统，具备实际部署价值。

title: Sourcing indirect materials under asymmetric recovery capabilities: Competition, collaboration, and sustainability in semiconductor supply chains
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Sourcing indirect materials under asymmetric recovery capabilities: Competition, collaboration, and sustainability in semiconductor supply chains
detail.abstract: Indirect materials, such as chemicals and solvents, contribute substantially to manufacturers' Scope~3 emissions because they are consumed during production and generate waste requiring recovery or disposal. Unlike components, the post-use waste of indirect materials becomes the input to recovery activities, creating a closed-loop interaction between sourcing decisions, recovery effort, and environmental performance. However, existing studies have largely overlooked supplier competition under asymmetric recovery capabilities and endogenous recovery effort in indirect materials sourcing. We investigate a semiconductor supply chain in which a manufacturer sources proprietary chemicals from an international supplier without local recovery capability and a domestic supplier with recovery capability. We develop a game-theoretic model in which the manufacturer designs a price-based allocation rule to determine sourcing proportions, while the domestic supplier endogenously determines its recovery effort. We further compare dual and single sourcing and extend the model through backward integration to coordinate recovery effort. The results show that the manufacturer's price competition factor generally intensifies supplier competition, although this effect becomes non-monotonic when recovery effort is costly or recovered chemicals face stringent performance requirements. Intensified competition can reduce raw material consumption by shifting sourcing toward recovered chemicals. We further find that the manufacturer prefers single sourcing only when it possesses sufficiently strong bargaining power; otherwise, dual sourcing remains more profitable. Finally, backward integration improves recovery coordination and reduces Scope~3 emissions but increases raw material consumption, revealing a fundamental trade-off between environmental sustainability and resource efficiency. These findings provide managerial insights into sustainable indirect materials sourcing under asymmetric recovery capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了半导体制造商在回收能力不对称的供应商之间采购间接材料时的最优策略，发现竞争加剧可减少原材料消耗，但后向整合虽降低Scope 3排放却增加原材料消耗，揭示了环境可持续性与资源效率之间的根本权衡。
AI.research_question: 在间接材料采购中，供应商回收能力不对称且回收努力内生的情况下，制造商的采购决策（双源vs单源）、价格竞争机制及后向整合对供应链环境绩效的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 间接材料（如化学品）的采购涉及闭环回收互动，但现有研究忽视了供应商回收能力不对称和内生回收努力对采购决策的影响，特别是半导体行业中间接材料的环境影响巨大。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，包括价格分配规则、供应商竞争、回收努力内生决策、后向整合协调机制。
AI.method: 博弈论建模与分析，比较双源采购与单源采购，并通过后向整合进行扩展分析。
AI.findings: (1) 价格竞争因子通常加剧供应商竞争，但回收成本高或回收化学品性能要求严格时呈非单调效应；(2) 加剧竞争可通过将采购转向回收化学品减少原材料消耗；(3) 制造商仅在拥有足够强议价能力时偏好单源采购；(4) 后向整合改善回收协调、减少Scope 3排放，但增加原材料消耗，揭示了环境可持续性与资源效率的权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在间接材料采购中纳入回收能力不对称和内生回收努力，揭示了价格竞争与回收努力的复杂互动机制，以及后向整合带来的资源效率-环境可持续性权衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制造商在间接材料采购中管理供应商竞争、设计采购分配规则、选择单源或双源策略以及评估后向整合的环保后果提供了管理启示。

title: Observation Frequency as a Trading-Environment Design Variable in Cointegration-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning for Cryptocurrency Statistical Arbitrage

detail.title: Observation Frequency as a Trading-Environment Design Variable in Cointegration-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning for Cryptocurrency Statistical Arbitrage
detail.abstract: This study examines observation frequency as a methodological design variable in cointegration-based deep reinforcement learning (DRL) cryptocurrency statistical arbitrage. Financial DRL studies often treat the intraday sampling interval as a fixed preprocessing choice, although it determines the number of market states, reward transitions, exposure-adjustment opportunities, turnover events, and formation observations available to the agent. To test whether temporal discretization affects trading performance, the same economic scenario is reconstructed across five observation frequencies: 15 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour, 2 hours, and 4 hours. Each scenario preserves a six-day formation window and a one-day trading horizon, while the number of observations varies with the sampling interval. The empirical design evaluates DQN, PPO, and A2C agents across four fixed cryptocurrency asset panels, two action-space specifications, and three random seeds, producing 360 matched DRL runs. Results show that observation frequency significantly affects total return, Sharpe ratio, maximum drawdown, annualized volatility, and turnover. Friedman repeated-measures tests indicate significant frequency effects for total return, χ² (4) = 99.43, p < .001, and Sharpe ratio, χ² (4) = 77.07, p < .001. The strongest effect appears in turnover, χ² (4) = 270.88, p < .001, indicating that sampling frequency changes trading behavior as well as measured performance. The 15-minute setting produces the largest average losses and highest turnover, whereas the 2-hour and 4-hour settings reduce losses and trading intensity. However, mean returns remain negative across all five frequencies. The findings show that observation frequency is not a neutral data-formatting decision; it is part of the DRL trading-environment design.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在基于协整的深度强化学习加密货币统计套利中，观察频率（即日内采样间隔）作为方法设计变量的影响。通过重构相同的经济场景（六天形成期、一天交易期），比较15分钟、30分钟、1小时、2小时和4小时五种频率，发现频率显著影响总回报、夏普比率、最大回撤、年化波动率和换手率。15分钟设置产生最大平均亏损和最高换手率，而2小时和4小时设置减少亏损和交易强度，但所有频率的平均回报均为负。结论：观察频率不是中性的数据格式化决策，而是DRL交易环境设计的一部分。
AI.research_question: 在基于协整的深度强化学习加密货币统计套利中，观察频率（日内采样间隔）作为方法设计变量是否显著影响交易绩效？
AI.motivation: 金融DRL研究通常将日内采样间隔视为固定的预处理选择，忽视其决定了智能体可获取的市场状态数量、奖励转换、暴露调整机会、换手事件和形成期观测数量。本研究旨在检验时间离散化是否会影响交易绩效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协整套利理论；深度强化学习（DRL）中的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）框架；时间离散化对MDP状态空间、奖励结构和交易行为的理论影响。
AI.method: 五个观察频率（15分钟、30分钟、1小时、2小时、4小时）；固定资产面板（四个加密货币组合）；两种动作空间规格；三种随机种子；DQN、PPO、A2C三种DRL智能体；共360组匹配的DRL运行；Friedman重复测量检验。
AI.findings: 1. 观察频率显著影响总回报、夏普比率、最大回撤、年化波动率和换手率。2. Friedman检验表明频率对总回报（χ²(4)=99.43, p<.001）和夏普比率（χ²(4)=77.07, p<.001）有显著影响。3. 换手率受频率影响最强（χ²(4)=270.88, p<.001）。4. 15分钟设置产生最大平均亏损和最高换手率，2小时和4小时设置减少亏损和交易强度。5. 所有频率的平均回报均为负。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了观察频率并非中性的数据预处理步骤，而是DRL交易环境设计的核心组成部分，为金融DRL方法论提供了关于时间离散化重要性的理论证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密货币统计套利实践者提供了采样频率选择的实证依据：高频采样（如15分钟）可能导致更大亏损和更高换手率，而较低频率（如2-4小时）可减少损失和交易强度，有助于优化DRL交易系统的参数设计。

title: A Modified Multiple Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm with Adaptive Evaporation and Obstacle-Aware Heuristics for UAV Path Planning in Complex 2D and 3D Environments

detail.title: A Modified Multiple Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm with Adaptive Evaporation and Obstacle-Aware Heuristics for UAV Path Planning in Complex 2D and 3D Environments
detail.abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) path planning in obstacle-rich environments remains a challenging problem in autonomous navigation. Existing metaheuristic approaches evaluate obstacle avoidance only after a complete path has been constructed, leaving the search process unaware of infeasibility during solution generation. This work proposes the Modified Multiple Ant Colony Optimization (MACO) algorithm to address this limitation. MACO incorporates six coordinated enhancements to the standard Multiple Ant Colony Optimization (MACO) framework, with the obstacle-aware heuristic constituting its principal contribution. By penalizing infeasible edges during path construction rather than after completion, the proposed strategy guides the search toward feasible regions from the earliest iterations. MACO is evaluated against standard ACO, Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO), and Genetic Algorithm (GA) across six benchmark scenarios in 2D and 3D environments, including fixed and random start-end configurations, mandatory intermediate waypoints, and continuous 3D trajectory optimization in environments containing buildings, radar exclusion zones, and dynamic flying objects. In the most challenging 3D scenario, MACO achieves the lowest path cost of 462.22, improving upon ACO, PSO, GWO, and GA by 17.68%, 1.57%, 55.82%, and 11.11%, respectively. MACO is the only algorithm to produce feasible paths in all six scenarios, whereas PSO and GWO generate infeasible trajectories in the most complex case. Across 75 independent trials per scenario, MACO consistently attains the lowest mean cost and coefficient of variation. Pairwise Wilcoxon signed-rank tests confirm statistically significant improvements ($\alpha = 0.05$), demonstrating that MACO provides a reliable and high-performance solution for autonomous UAV navigation in complex environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出改进型多蚁群优化算法（MACO），通过在路径构建过程中引入障碍感知启发式策略，显著提升了无人机在复杂障碍环境中的路径规划性能，在多个基准场景中优于传统元启发式算法。
AI.research_question: 如何改进元启发式算法，使其在无人机路径规划中能够在路径构建阶段而非完成后感知障碍物，从而提高复杂环境中路径的可行性与优化质量？
AI.motivation: 现有元启发式方法仅在完整路径构建后才评估障碍规避情况，搜索过程在解生成时无法感知不可行性，导致效率低下且易产生不可行路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多蚁群优化（MACO）框架；障碍感知启发式策略；元启发式优化理论
AI.method: 提出改进型MACO算法，包含六项协调增强机制，核心是通过惩罚不可行边来引导搜索向可行区域进行；在2D和3D环境中的六个基准场景下，与标准ACO、PSO、GWO、GA进行对比实验，共进行75次独立试验，采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验进行统计显著性验证。
AI.findings: MACO在最具挑战性的3D场景中取得最低路径成本462.22，相较ACO、PSO、GWO、GA分别提升17.68%、1.57%、55.82%、11.11%；MACO是唯一在所有六个场景中均生成可行路径的算法；在所有场景中MACO均取得最低平均成本和变异系数；Wilcoxon检验证实改进具有统计显著性（α=0.05）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了障碍感知启发式策略，将障碍规避从路径后评估转变为路径构建过程中的主动引导，为元启发式算法在约束优化问题中的应用提供了新的设计范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为复杂障碍环境下的无人机自主导航提供了可靠、高性能的路径规划解决方案，适用于包含建筑物、雷达禁区和动态飞行物等实际场景。

title: Optimisation of Charging Infrastructure for Battery Electric Multiple Units
affiliations: University of Leeds

detail.title: Optimisation of Charging Infrastructure for Battery Electric Multiple Units
detail.abstract: Battery electric trains are increasingly proposed as a cost-effective alternative to full railway electrification on routes where capital constraints prohibit continuous overhead line installation. This paper presents a coupled simulation–optimisation framework that combines a physics-based MATLAB train dynamics model, incorporating Davis resistance, aerodynamic drag, gradient forces, auxiliary heating/ cooling loads, and regenerative braking, with a GAMS mixed-integer programme that minimises 20-year whole-life infrastructure cost subject to SoC feasibility constraints. The framework is applied to three UK routes of differing topology, and results show that partial OHL electrification is always cost-optimal. Sensitivity analyses identify grid connection cost, ambient temperature, and battery degradation as the most consequential design parameters. Annual carbon savings relative to diesel multiple units are significant but depend on regional electricity grid carbon intensity. The findings further suggest that BEMU deployment is unlikely to increase passenger fares and may instead enable fares to be held constant or reduced.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种耦合仿真-优化的框架，用于设计电池电动列车（BEMU）与部分架空接触网（OHL）的组合方案，以在资本受限的铁路路线上实现成本最优的电气化过渡。
AI.research_question: 电池电动列车与部分架空接触网电气化如何在保证电池荷电状态约束的前提下，实现20年全生命周期基础设施成本最优？
AI.motivation: 在资本约束无法实现全线电气化的铁路路线上，电池电动列车被视为一种有成本效益的替代方案，但缺乏系统性的优化框架来设计电池尺寸与接触网布置的联合方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 列车动力学模型（Davis阻力、空气阻力、坡道力、辅助负荷、再生制动）、混合整数规划、全生命周期成本分析、电池退化模型。
AI.method: 将MATLAB物理列车动力学模型与GAMS混合整数规划相结合，形成耦合仿真-优化框架；应用于英国三条不同拓扑的路线；进行敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 部分架空线电气化始终是成本最优方案；电网连接成本、环境温度和电池退化是最关键的设计参数；与柴油列车相比碳排放显著降低但取决于区域电网碳强度；BEMU部署不太可能推高票价，反而可能保持或降低票价。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出电池电动列车与部分电气化基础设施的联合优化框架，将物理列车动力学与混合整数规划系统性地整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为铁路运营商和决策者提供了在资本约束下实现铁路电气化成本效益最大化的定量工具，揭示了关键敏感性因素，并提供了票价影响的证据。

title: An Ant Colony Optimization Framework for the Electric Vehicle Routing Problem with a Machine-Learning-Based Extension
affiliations: University of Defence in Brno

detail.title: An Ant Colony Optimization Framework for the Electric Vehicle Routing Problem with a Machine-Learning-Based Extension
detail.abstract: This study addresses the Electric Vehicle Routing Problem (EVRP), in which vehicle routes must satisfy customer demand while respecting limited battery capacity and the availability of recharging stations. An ant-colony-based framework is proposed to separate customer selection from recharging-station handling. Customers are selected through a clustered constructive mechanism, whereas recharging stations are considered by a dedicated procedure when required by the current battery state. Several recharging modes are examined, including a probabilistic mode in which station selection is guided by pheromone information. The framework is further extended by machine-learning-based edge guidance. In the ML-enhanced variant, learned edge probabilities are incorporated into pheromone initialization, candidate ordering, cluster selection, customer selection, and probabilistic recharging-station selection. The proposed algorithms are evaluated on an extended EVRP benchmark set and compared with selected learning-based, evolutionary, local-search, and ACO-based methods. The results show that the standalone variant is competitive with existing approaches, while the ML-enhanced variant achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods, especially on larger benchmark instances. The findings indicate that learned edge-level information can improve EVRP search guidance when integrated into a feasibility-preserving metaheuristic framework. Methodologically, the study contributes to hybrid OR-ML optimization by showing how learned edge-level information can be embedded into a constructive metaheuristic without replacing its feasibility-preserving search logic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于蚁群优化的框架来解决电动汽车路径规划问题（EVRP），并进一步引入机器学习增强的边缘引导信息。独立变体已具有竞争力，而ML增强变体在大型实例上表现最佳，表明学习到的边级信息可以改善元启发式搜索，同时保留其可行性保障机制。
AI.research_question: 如何有效解决电动汽车路径规划问题（EVRP），特别是在考虑电池容量限制和充电站可用性的条件下，设计高效的车辆路径方案？
AI.motivation: 电动汽车路径规划问题面临电池容量有限和充电站布局的约束，传统方法在处理这类复杂约束时存在效率瓶颈。现有方法在客户选择与充电站处理上的集成不够灵活，且较少利用机器学习来增强启发式搜索的引导效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 蚁群优化（ACO）元启发式框架；机器学习（ML）增强的边缘引导机制；混合OR-ML优化方法论。
AI.method: 采用基于蚁群的框架，将客户选择（通过聚类构建机制）与充电站处理（基于电池状态的专用程序）分离。研究多种充电站选择模式，包括基于信息素的概率模式。进一步扩展：将学习到的边概率融入信息素初始化、候选排序、聚类选择、客户选择和充电站概率选择等多个环节。在扩展的EVRP基准集上进行评估，与学习型、进化算法、局部搜索和ACO方法进行比较。
AI.findings: 独立蚁群变体与现有方法相比具有竞争力；ML增强变体在整体性能上优于所有比较方法，尤其在更大规模的基准实例上表现突出。学习到的边级信息在嵌入到保留可行性搜索逻辑的元启发式框架后，能够有效改善EVRP的搜索引导。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了如何将学习到的边级信息嵌入到构造性元启发式算法中，同时不取代其保留可行性搜索逻辑；为混合OR-ML优化提供了方法论贡献，证明了机器学习引导与元启发式框架的互补整合路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一种在电池容量和充电站约束下高效求解电动汽车路径规划问题的可行方案；ML增强变体在大规模实例上的优异表现具有实际应用价值，可为物流和配送行业中的电动汽车车队调度提供决策支持。

title: The Business Effects of Low-Emission Zones: The Non-Case of Stockholm, Sweden
affiliations: HFI, Institute of Retail Economics, affiliation not provided to SSRN and HFI, Institute of Retail Economics

detail.title: The Business Effects of Low-Emission Zones: The Non-Case of Stockholm, Sweden
detail.abstract: In 2024, a Class 3 low-emission zone (LEZ) was announced for central Stockholm, permitting only electric, fuel-cell, and Euro VI gas vehicles. We undertook a longitudinal treatment–control survey of firms located inside and outside the proposed LEZ. Shortly after the first survey wave, however, the policy was suspended and ultimately cancelled, creating a rare opportunity to examine responses to both anticipated regulation and its withdrawal. Firms within the proposed LEZ were significantly more skeptical about the policy’s economic consequences, yet substantially more likely to adapt operations before implementation. Although firms inside the zone initially exhibited higher exit rates, these differences disappeared after controlling for underlying business conditions. Following the cancellation, firms within the proposed LEZ became more optimistic about Stockholm’s economic development. The findings suggest that business responses to urban environmental policies depend strongly on policy design, local context, and perceived compatibility with existing commercial structures.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用斯德哥尔摩低排放区政策从宣布到暂停再到取消的独特自然实验，发现区内企业虽对政策经济后果更持怀疑态度，却更积极调整运营；政策取消后，区内企业对城市经济前景更加乐观。
AI.research_question: 企业如何应对城市低排放区政策的宣布、暂停与取消？
AI.motivation: 利用政策宣布后意外暂停并取消的罕见自然实验，探究企业对环境规制预期变化的行为响应及心理反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策预期理论、企业行为适应理论、制度经济学视角下的规制不确定性。
AI.method: 纵向配对调查，对位于拟议低排放区内外的企业进行多波次追踪，采用处理-对照组设计进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 区内企业对政策经济后果更怀疑，但适应性调整比例更高；区内企业初期退出率更高，但控制经营条件后差异消失；政策取消后，区内企业对城市经济前景更乐观。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政策预期与政策取消对企业行为的非对称影响，丰富了环境规制不确定性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市环境政策制定者提供了企业异质性响应的实证依据，提示政策设计需注重与企业现有商业结构的兼容性及地方情境适配。

title: Resilience in Entrepreneurship
affiliations: Falmouth University

detail.title: Resilience in Entrepreneurship
detail.abstract:
Resilience in Entrepreneurship examines how organizations survive, adapt, and create long-term value under conditions of uncertainty, disruption, and failure. Challenging the conventional emphasis on growth and efficiency, the book argues that resilience—not optimization alone—is the primary determinant of entrepreneurial longevity. Drawing on more than two decades of leadership experience across the United Kingdom, Singapore, the United Arab Emirates, and India, it explores how different institutional and business environments shape organizational adaptability, governance, decision-making, and strategic renewal.


The book introduces practical frameworks for building resilient enterprises by developing adaptive capabilities, resource flexibility, and systems-based management. It also identifies the “Heroic Effort Trap,” in which excessive dependence on founders and key leaders undermines organizational durability. By integrating international business perspectives with entrepreneurial practice, the work demonstrates that resilience is a strategic capability that enables firms to absorb shocks, recover from setbacks, and sustain performance over time. The book contributes to contemporary discussions on entrepreneurship, organizational resilience, leadership, and long-term business sustainability in increasingly volatile environments.

AI.tldr: 本书挑战了传统创业研究中对增长和效率的单一强调，提出韧性（而非单纯优化）是企业长期生存的首要决定因素。作者基于在英国、新加坡、阿联酋和印度超过二十年的领导经验，分析了不同制度与商业环境如何塑造组织的适应性、治理、决策和战略更新。书中引入了构建韧性企业的实用框架，包括适应性能力、资源灵活性和系统化管理，并指出了"英雄式努力陷阱"——过度依赖创始人和关键领导者会损害组织的持久性。
AI.research_question: 企业如何在不确定性、 disruption 和失败条件下生存、适应并创造长期价值？韧性如何成为创业企业长期生存的首要决定因素？
AI.motivation: 传统的创业研究过于强调增长和效率，忽视了韧性在企业长期生存中的关键作用。作者以超过二十年的跨国领导经验为基础，试图弥补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业韧性理论；组织适应性理论；资源灵活性理论；系统化管理理论；国际商业视角与创业实践的整合框架。
AI.method: 基于作者在英国、新加坡、阿联酋和印度超过二十年的领导经验，采用跨制度与商业环境的比较分析，结合国际商业视角与创业实践。
AI.findings: 韧性是一种战略能力，能够使企业吸收冲击、从挫折中恢复并维持长期绩效；"英雄式努力陷阱"（过度依赖创始人和关键领导者）会损害组织持久性；不同制度环境会塑造不同的组织适应性、治理和决策模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统创业研究对增长和效率的单一强调，提出韧性是创业企业长期生存的首要决定因素；识别并概念化了"英雄式努力陷阱"这一新现象；将国际商业视角与创业韧性理论进行整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了构建韧性企业的实用框架，包括适应性能力、资源灵活性和系统化管理；帮助企业家识别和避免"英雄式努力陷阱"；为在不同制度环境下进行战略决策和治理提供了实践指导。

title: Developmental Capacity-Access Gaps: A Meta-Capacity Perspective on System Growth and Transformation

detail.title: Developmental Capacity-Access Gaps: A Meta-Capacity Perspective on System Growth and Transformation
detail.abstract:
Existing theories of growth and transformation in complex systems primarily emphasize resources, competencies, institutional arrangements, and adaptive capabilities as key determinants of development. However, these approaches provide limited explanatory power for a persistent empirical paradox: systems frequently fail to reach intended developmental states despite the presence of sufficient resources, strategic intent, and motivational alignment.

This paper introduces the concept of the Developmental Capacity–Access Gap (CAGdev) as a structural framework for explaining such failures. CAGdev is defined as the difference between a system’s target structural complexity (SC_target) and its accessible meta-capacity (MC), where meta-capacity is conceptualized as a distributed property across subsystems:

MC = Σ MCᵢ

Accordingly:

CAGdev = SC_target − MC

The framework proposes that system development is constrained not only by aggregate capacity, but by its distribution across heterogeneous subsystems and their structural alignment with target complexity. When CAGdev exceeds a system’s adaptive range, transformation efforts tend to result not in successful transition, but in compensatory dynamics, structural stagnation, or systemic instability and collapse.

Unlike traditional growth models that focus on static resource accumulation or isolated capability enhancement, the CAGdev framework emphasizes the relational and distributed constraint structure between desired system states and subsystem-aggregated coordination capacity.

The model is scale-invariant and applies across multiple levels of analysis, including individuals, organizations, and socio-political systems.

By reframing development as a function of distributed capacity–complexity alignment rather than resource availability alone, the paper offers a complementary explanation for why structurally well-resourced systems may nevertheless fail to achieve higher-order transitions in complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"发展能力-可及性差距"（CAGdev）概念框架，将系统发展失败归因于目标结构复杂度与子系统可及的元能力总和之间的结构性错配，而非传统理论强调的资源、能力或制度不足。
AI.research_question: 为什么拥有充足资源、战略意图和动机一致性的系统，仍频繁无法达到预期的发展状态？
AI.motivation: 现有复杂系统增长与转型理论（资源、能力、制度安排、适应性等）无法充分解释"资源充足但发展失败"这一经验悖论，需要一种新的结构性解释框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 发展能力-可及性差距（CAGdev）框架：将元能力（MC）定义为各子系统元能力之和，发展差距CAGdev = 目标结构复杂度（SC_target）− 可及元能力（MC）。当CAGdev超过系统的适应范围时，转型努力会导致补偿性动力学、结构停滞或系统不稳定与崩溃。
AI.method: 概念性理论建构，基于对现有发展理论的批判性分析，提出一个新的结构性数学化框架，并宣称该模型具有尺度不变性，适用于个体、组织和社会政治系统等多层次分析。
AI.findings: 系统发展的约束不仅来自总能力，更来自能力在不同子系统间的分布及其与目标复杂度的结构对齐程度。资源充裕的系统仍可能因能力分布错配而无法实现高阶复杂度转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 将发展重新定义为分布式能力-复杂度对齐的函数而非单纯资源可得性的函数；提供了解释"资源充足但发展失败"悖论的互补性理论机制；框架具有跨层次、尺度不变的普适性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织发展、经济转型、社会治理等领域的实践者提供诊断工具：识别发展失败时应关注能力在子系统间的分布与结构对齐程度，而非仅关注资源总量或单一能力提升。

title: Quasi-experimental Methods when Randomization Is Impossible: Difference-in-Differences, Synthetic Control, and Regression Discontinuity for Marketing and Financial Decision Systems

detail.title: Quasi-experimental Methods when Randomization Is Impossible: Difference-in-Differences, Synthetic Control, and Regression Discontinuity for Marketing and Financial Decision Systems
detail.abstract: Randomized experiments are the reference standard for causal measurement in marketing and finance, yet many of the questions that matter most cannot be randomized: brand campaigns saturate entire markets, pricing and credit policies are constrained by regulation and fairness, interventions contaminate control groups through spillovers, and many decisions are one-time events. This article provides a practitioner-oriented synthesis of three quasi-experimental designs that recover causal effects from observational variation: difference-indifferences , the synthetic control method, and regression discontinuity. For each design, it develops the identifying assumption in business terms, specifies estimation and its modern refinements, catalogs the principal threats to validity with the diagnostics that detect them, and illustrates application to recurring marketing and financial questions, including geographic campaign rollouts, brand-crisis quantification, credit and loyalty-tier cutoffs, and policy changes affecting entire portfolios. A comparative decision framework then maps the structure of the available variation-who was treated, when, and by what assignment rule-to the appropriate design, and a final section addresses implementation pitfalls, including serial correlation in panel inference, staggeredadoption bias in two-way fixed-effects estimators, donor-pool contamination in synthetic controls, and manipulation of running variables at decision thresholds. The article argues that these designs convert the operational records firms already possess into a portfolio of credible natural experiments, and that the binding constraint on their adoption is design literacy rather than data.

AI.tldr: 本文系统介绍了三种准实验设计（双重差分、合成控制法、断点回归）在营销和金融领域因果推断中的应用，为企业利用现有运营数据构建可信自然实验提供了实践指南。
AI.research_question: 在无法进行随机实验的情况下，如何利用准实验设计从观测数据中恢复营销和金融领域的关键因果效应？
AI.motivation: 许多关键的营销和金融问题（如品牌广告、定价政策、信贷决策等）无法通过随机实验评估，但现有准实验方法分散在不同文献中，缺乏面向实践者的系统性整合与比较框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反事实因果框架；三种准实验设计的识别假设：平行趋势假设（DID）、线性因子模型/凸组合假设（SCM）、连续性假设/局部随机化（RDD）。
AI.method: 综合文献综述与比较分析方法，对DID、SCM、RDD三种方法从识别假设、估计方法、现代改进、威胁与诊断、应用场景五个维度进行系统梳理，并提供基于"谁被处理、何时处理、分配规则"三个维度的决策框架。
AI.findings: 1. 三种设计适用于不同变异性结构：DID适用于分组-时间变异，SCM适用于单一处理单元，RDD适用于基于阈值的分配；2. 常见实施陷阱包括序列相关、交错采纳偏差、供体池污染、运行变量操纵等；3. 企业运营数据中蕴含大量可转化为自然实验的变异来源，主要障碍是设计素养而非数据获取。
AI.theory_contributions: 将分散的准实验方法整合为统一的分析框架，阐明了不同方法之间的适用条件与边界，深化了对观测数据中因果识别策略的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销和金融从业者提供了选择和应用准实验设计的系统决策指南，包括具体方法的诊断工具、常见陷阱防范以及如何将企业运营数据转化为自然实验的实用路径。

title: Does the Path (Dependence) Lead to Stars? Cixin Liu On Competing Technologies
affiliations: European University Institute - Department of Law (LAW)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has nothing to declare.

detail.abstract: CLEP#5 - The interconnected challenges of the 21st-century global economy necessitate a reevaluation of competition law systems worldwide in the spirit of multidisciplinarity. It means not only reviewing in light of its intellectual roots in jurisprudence, microeconomics, and ethics, but also recognising the rapidly increasing number of valuable insights from contemporary studies on information and complexity. The Competition Law, Economics, and Philosophy series comments on this process. It is a mix of these three disciplines, seasoned with a bit of literature, science, technology, and personal experience.

AI.tldr: 本文呼吁在跨学科精神下重新审视全球竞争法体系，主张融合法学、微观经济学、伦理学以及信息与复杂性科学的当代洞见，并通过"竞争法、经济学与哲学"系列，融合三学科及文学、科技与个人经验展开评论。
AI.research_question: 21世纪全球经济相互关联的挑战如何促使竞争法体系进行跨学科的重估？
AI.motivation: 21世纪全球经济的复杂性与互联性使传统竞争法体系面临挑战，需要超越单一学科视角，整合法学、经济学、伦理学以及信息与复杂性科学的最新成果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争法、经济学与哲学的跨学科框架，结合法学、微观经济学、伦理学，并融入信息理论与复杂性科学。
AI.method: 跨学科评论与理论整合，融合法学、经济学、哲学、文学、科学技术与个人经验。
AI.findings: 竞争法体系需要在跨学科精神下重新评估，信息与复杂性科学为竞争法提供了新的有价值的视角。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了竞争法、经济学与哲学三位一体的跨学科分析框架，拓展了竞争法研究的理论边界，纳入信息理论与复杂性科学。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球竞争法体系的改革与重估提供了跨学科的方法论指南，推动政策制定者考虑多元学科视角。

title:
Biodiversity Impact and Dependency Assessment in the Financial Industry –
A Literature Review
affiliations: , University of Jyväskylä - University of Jyväskylä School of Business and Economics, University of Jyväskylä, University of Jyväskylä and Natural Resources Institute Finland

detail.title:
Biodiversity Impact and Dependency Assessment in the Financial Industry –
A Literature Review
detail.abstract: As key intermediaries in the transition to a sustainable economy, financial institutions face the complex challenge of translating biodiversity impacts and dependencies into standardized metrics informing capital allocation. This study investigates how financial institutions operationalize the concept of double materiality, encompassing their exposure to nature-related risks alongside biodiversity impacts, by evaluating the current landscape of biodiversity impact and dependency assessment tools (BIDAT). Through a scoping literature review of empirical case studies, we analyse these tools as governance innovations, using diffusion of innovation theory to examine their market applicability, accessibility, and acceptability. Our analysis reveals that BIDATs are primarily utilized by early adopters to estimate exposure to physical and transition risks. However, systemic diffusion remains constrained by critical sociotechnical barriers. A fundamental barrier to the applicability of tools is the spatial mismatch between the global nature of financial portfolios and the inherently local nature of biodiversity. Furthermore, high operational complexity and resource demand hinder accessibility, while the fragmented array of metrics and the absence of a single consensus-based indicator threaten market acceptability. Consequently, the financial industry remains in a state of innovation resistance. Transitioning BIDATs from niche applications to mainstream conventions will depend on resolving data granularity issues and fostering interdisciplinary collaboration to create robust, standardized biodiversity metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献综述，评估金融机构使用的生物多样性影响与依赖评估工具（BIDAT），发现其面临空间错配、操作复杂、指标碎片化等障碍，导致金融业处于创新抵抗状态，需通过数据精细化与跨学科合作推动工具主流化。
AI.research_question: 金融机构如何通过生物多样性影响与依赖评估工具（BIDAT）将双重实质性（double materiality）概念操作化？
AI.motivation: 金融机构作为可持续经济转型的关键中介，面临将生物多样性影响和依赖转化为标准化指标以指导资本配置的复杂挑战，但目前尚缺乏对这些工具系统性评估的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新扩散理论（Diffusion of Innovation Theory），用于分析BIDAT的市场适用性（applicability）、可及性（accessibility）和可接受性（acceptability）。
AI.method: 范围综述（Scoping literature review），对实证案例研究进行系统性文献分析。
AI.findings: (1) BIDAT主要由早期采用者用于估算物理风险和转型风险敞口；(2) 系统扩散受到社会技术壁垒制约：空间错配（全球投资组合 vs. 本地化生物多样性）、高操作复杂性和资源需求、指标碎片化且缺乏共识性标准；(3) 金融业整体处于创新抵抗状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 将创新扩散理论应用于金融领域的生物多样性评估工具研究，揭示了BIDAT从利基应用向主流惯例转型所需克服的三大障碍（适用性、可及性、可接受性）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构、政策制定者和工具开发者识别了BIDAT主流化的关键瓶颈（数据粒度、指标标准化），指出需通过跨学科合作建立稳健的生物多样性指标。

title:
The Lost Product Layer in AI
 A Workflow-aware Framework for Moving beyond Chatbot-first AI
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
The Lost Product Layer in AI
 A Workflow-aware Framework for Moving beyond Chatbot-first AI
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence has become one of the most powerful technological shifts in software. Large language models can write, summarize, code, classify, search, reason, automate, and assist across many domains. Yet despite this capability, the software industry still has relatively few AI-native products that users rely on deeply, repeatedly, and naturally in their everyday workflows beyond areas such as customer support, coding assistance, writing, search, and chatbot-style interaction. This paper argues that the gap is not primarily a model capability problem, but a product-experience problem. Teams often begin with model capabilities rather than user workflows, producing chatbots, dashboards, agents, summaries, and feature-heavy interfaces that impress in demos but fail to embed in daily practice. The paper introduces the idea of the "lost product layerˮ in AI the weakening of product judgment, user segmentation, interaction discipline, feedback loops, and workflow understanding in AI product development. It proposes Product-Native AI as a conceptual framework for integrating AI into products through stable user experiences, adaptive intelligence, contextual cues, subtle interaction design, product discipline, and real user behavior. The central argument is that AI-native products should not be built by adding AI features everywhere. They should be built by identifying the right user moment, placing intelligence where it naturally belongs, and gradually discovering new workflows through feedback. This paper provides a two-stage adoption pathway, Workflow Fit to Workflow Emergence, and ten operational principles for teams moving from capability-led to workflow-native AI integration.

AI.tldr: 本文指出AI产品未能深度融入用户日常工作的核心问题在于产品体验设计而非模型能力不足，提出了"丢失的产品层"概念和"产品原生AI"框架，并给出了从工作流适配到工作流涌现的两阶段采纳路径与十条操作原则。
AI.research_question: 为什么当前AI产品难以让用户深度、重复且自然地嵌入日常工作中？如何从产品体验层面构建真正的AI原生产品？
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型能力强大，但软件行业中真正被用户深度依赖的AI原生产品依然稀少；许多团队从模型能力出发而非用户工作流出发，导致产品在演示中令人印象深刻却无法融入日常实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: "丢失的产品层"（The Lost Product Layer）、"产品原生AI"（Product-Native AI）框架、工作流适配到工作流涌现的两阶段模型。
AI.method: 概念性研究/观点论文，通过对行业实践观察与批判性分析提出理论框架和操作原则。
AI.findings: AI原生产品的建构应从识别正确的用户时刻入手，将智能自然地置于合适位置，通过反馈逐步发现新的工作流；而非在所有地方添加AI功能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"丢失的产品层"概念来诊断AI产品开发中产品判断、用户细分、交互纪律、反馈循环和工作流理解的弱化问题；构建了"产品原生AI"框架，强调稳定的用户体验、自适应智能、情境线索、微妙交互设计、产品纪律和真实用户行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了从能力驱动转向工作流原生AI集成的两阶段采纳路径（工作流适配→工作流涌现）以及十条操作原则，为AI产品团队提供了可落地的设计指南。

title: Understanding Illicit Drug Use in the UK: Associations Between Consumption Patterns, Self-Regulation, and Risk Perception
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University College London - Department of Civil, Environmental & Geomatic Engineering and University College London

detail.title: Understanding Illicit Drug Use in the UK: Associations Between Consumption Patterns, Self-Regulation, and Risk Perception
detail.abstract: Background Understanding the behavioural drivers of illicit drug use is critical for informing effective public health interventions. Whilst prevalence is well documented, less attention has been given to how patterns of use relate to harm perception, self-regulation, and lifestyle integration. Methods A cross-sectional survey was conducted to examine drug use behaviours, perceptions, and self-regulatory capacity in the UK. Participants were categorised by consumption status, frequency of use, and behavioural patterns, including polydrug use and co-consumption with alcohol. Non-parametric tests and regression analyses were used to assess associations. Results Drug use was significantly associated with age and sex, with younger individuals and males more likely to report consumption. Consumers reported higher perceived thresholds for harm compared to non-consumers. Frequency of use was a key determinant of behavioural outcomes, with more frequent users reporting greater difficulty in regulating both the frequency and quantity of consumption. Polydrug use and alcohol co-consumption were associated with stronger lifestyle integration, reduced perceived risk, and a greater likelihood of continued use. More frequent users were also more likely to report increased consumption during periods of financial hardship and emotional distress. Conclusions Patterns of use, particularly frequency, polydrug use, and alcohol co-consumption, are key markers of risk and reduced self-regulation. These findings support the need for targeted, behaviourally informed harm-reduction strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过英国横断面调查，研究了药物使用行为与危害感知、自我调节及生活方式整合的关系。发现使用频率、多药并用和与酒精共同消费是风险升高和自我调节能力下降的关键标志。
AI.research_question: 药物使用模式（频率、多药并用、与酒精共消费）如何与危害感知、自我调节能力和生活方式整合相关联？
AI.motivation: 虽然药物使用的普遍性已有充分记录，但使用模式与危害感知、自我调节及生活方式整合之间的关系关注较少，理解这些行为驱动力对制定有效的公共卫生干预措施至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 危害感知理论、自我调节理论、生活方式整合理论
AI.method: 横截面调查设计，将参与者按消费状态、使用频率和行为模式（包括多药并用和与酒精共消费）分类，采用非参数检验和回归分析评估关联。
AI.findings: 1. 药物使用与年龄和性别显著相关，年轻人和男性更可能报告消费；2. 消费者比非消费者报告更高的危害感知阈值；3. 使用频率越高，越难调节消费频率和数量；4. 多药并用和与酒精共消费与更强的生活方式整合、更低的风险感知和更高的持续使用可能性相关；5. 频繁使用者在经济困难和情绪困扰期间更可能增加消费。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了使用频率、多药并用及酒精共消费作为风险和自我调节能力下降的关键行为标记，丰富了危害感知和自我调节理论在成瘾行为领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 支持制定基于行为洞察的针对性减害策略，特别关注频繁使用者、多药并用者和在压力情境下易增加消费的人群。
